## app/api/availability/route.js

```javascript
import { DEMO } from '@/lib/config';
import { demoSlots } from '@/lib/demo';
import { adminClient, fail, publicAffiliate } from '@/lib/server';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export async function GET(request) {
  try {
    if(DEMO)return Response.json({slots:demoSlots()});
    const db=adminClient(),slug=new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('affiliate');let affiliate=null;
    if(slug){const {data,error}=await db.from('affiliates').select('*').eq('slug',slug).eq('active',true).single();if(error)return fail(new Error('This referral page is unavailable.'),404);affiliate=publicAffiliate(data);}
    const {data,error}=await db.rpc('available_slots');if(error)throw new Error('Appointment times are temporarily unavailable.');
    return Response.json({slots:data,affiliate},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
  }catch(e){return fail(e,503);}
}
```

## app/api/bookings/route.js

```javascript
import { DEMO, documentsLink } from '@/lib/config';
import { validateBooking } from '@/lib/validation';
import { adminClient, encryptPolicy, mapBooking, sameOrigin, fail, issueGift, issueDocumentToken, verifyTurnstile, requestHash, saveServiceOption } from '@/lib/server';
import { claimAndSend } from '@/lib/notifications';
export async function POST(request) {
  try{
    sameOrigin(request);if(DEMO)return fail(new Error('Use the browser demo booking flow.'),409);
    const raw=await request.json();if(raw.website)return fail(new Error('Unable to process this booking.'));
    await verifyTurnstile(request,raw.captcha,'booking');
    const b=validateBooking(raw),db=adminClient();
    const {data,error}=await db.rpc('create_booking',{p_name:b.name,p_email:b.email,p_phone:b.phone,p_doctor:b.doctor,p_start:b.start,p_service:b.service,p_affiliate:b.affiliateId,p_source:b.source,p_first_visit:b.firstVisit,p_insurance:b.insurance,p_policy:encryptPolicy(b.policy),p_brands:b.brands,p_sms:b.smsConsent,p_request_hash:requestHash(request)});
    if(error)throw new Error(error.message.includes('rate limit')?'Too many booking attempts. Please contact the clinic.':error.message.includes('affiliate')?'This referral is no longer available.':'That appointment time is no longer available. Please choose another.');
    // The "Complete your file" token goes only to this patient: back to their browser and into their confirmation email.
    const saved=mapBooking(await issueGift(db,await saveServiceOption(db,data[0],b.serviceOption))),documentsToken=await issueDocumentToken(db,data[0]);
    const notifications=await claimAndSend(db,{...saved,documentsLink:documentsLink(documentsToken)},'confirmation');
    return Response.json({booking:{id:saved.id,reference:saved.reference,doctor:saved.doctor,start:saved.start,duration:saved.duration,service:saved.service,serviceOption:saved.serviceOption,affiliateId:saved.affiliateId,name:saved.name,giftCard:saved.giftCard,documentsToken},notifications},{status:201,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
  }catch(e){return fail(e);}
}
```

## app/api/documents/route.js

```javascript
import { DEMO, DOCUMENT_TYPES, DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES, DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES } from '@/lib/config';
import { validateDocuments, fileSignatureOk } from '@/lib/validation';
import { adminClient, sameOrigin, fail, hashToken, audit } from '@/lib/server';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
// "Complete your file". The patient proves which booking they are completing with the single-use token issued with the
// booking (it reaches only their browser and confirmation email). Nothing here returns a storage path or URL.
//  - JSON {token}: is this link still usable? Answers {valid}. Lets the page say so before the patient fills it in.
//  - multipart (token, residencyStatus, file[], kind[]): validates every file, then claims the token, uploads the
//    files to the private 'booking-documents' bucket and records them. Any failure undoes the uploads and frees the
//    token again, so the patient can retry.
const USED='This link has expired or has already been used. Please contact the clinic.';
const tokenOf=value=>{const t=String(value||'');if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(t))throw new Error(USED);return t;};
export async function POST(request){
  try{
    sameOrigin(request);if(DEMO)return fail(new Error('Use the browser demo form.'),409);
    const db=adminClient(),now=new Date().toISOString();
    if(!request.headers.get('content-type')?.includes('multipart/form-data')){
      const {token}=await request.json();let valid=false;
      try{const {data}=await db.from('booking_document_tokens').select('booking_id').eq('token_hash',hashToken(tokenOf(token))).is('used_at',null).gt('expires_at',now).maybeSingle();valid=!!data;}catch{}
      return Response.json({valid},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
    }
    // Refuse a request bigger than the most the form can send before reading it into memory.
    if(Number(request.headers.get('content-length')||0)>DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES*DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES+1048576)throw new Error(`Please upload at most ${DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES} files of ${DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES/1048576} MB each.`);
    const form=await request.formData(),token=tokenOf(form.get('token'));
    const uploads=form.getAll('file'),kinds=form.getAll('kind');
    if(uploads.length>DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES)throw new Error(`Please upload at most ${DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES} files in total.`);
    if(uploads.some(f=>!f||typeof f.arrayBuffer!=='function')||kinds.length!==uploads.length)throw new Error('Please choose your files again.');
    const {residencyStatus,files}=validateDocuments({residencyStatus:String(form.get('residencyStatus')||''),files:uploads.map((f,i)=>({name:f.name,size:f.size,type:f.type,kind:String(kinds[i])}))});
    // The same signature check as the affiliate photo upload: the bytes must match the type the browser claimed.
    const bytes=await Promise.all(uploads.map(async f=>Buffer.from(await f.arrayBuffer())));
    files.forEach((f,i)=>{if(bytes[i].length!==f.size||bytes[i].length>DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES||!fileSignatureOk(f.type,bytes[i]))throw new Error(`“${f.name}” does not look like a real ${DOCUMENT_TYPES[f.type].toUpperCase()} file.`);});
    // Claim the link. Only one request can win: the update matches only an unused, unexpired token.
    const {data:claimed,error:ce}=await db.from('booking_document_tokens').update({used_at:now}).eq('token_hash',hashToken(token)).is('used_at',null).gt('expires_at',now).select('booking_id');
    if(ce||!claimed?.length)throw new Error(USED);
    const bookingId=claimed[0].booking_id,stored=[];
    // A booking can have several links (the emailed one and any issued on /my-booking). Undo frees only this one.
    const undo=async()=>{if(stored.length)await db.storage.from('booking-documents').remove(stored);await db.from('booking_document_tokens').update({used_at:null}).eq('token_hash',hashToken(token));};
    const {data:existing}=await db.from('booking_documents').select('id').eq('booking_id',bookingId).eq('kind','government-id').limit(1);
    if(existing?.length)throw new Error('Your file is already complete. To change it, please contact the clinic.');
    try{
      const rows=[];
      for(const [i,f] of files.entries()){
        const path=bookingId+'/'+crypto.randomUUID()+'.'+DOCUMENT_TYPES[f.type];
        const {error}=await db.storage.from('booking-documents').upload(path,bytes[i],{contentType:f.type,upsert:false});
        if(error)throw new Error('Your files could not be uploaded. Please try again.');
        stored.push(path);rows.push({booking_id:bookingId,kind:f.kind,file_path:path,original_name:f.name,size:f.size,mime:f.type});
      }
      const {error:de}=await db.from('booking_documents').insert(rows);if(de)throw new Error('Your files could not be saved. Please try again.');
      const {error:be}=await db.from('bookings').update({residency_status:residencyStatus}).eq('id',bookingId);if(be){await db.from('booking_documents').delete().in('file_path',stored);throw new Error('Your file could not be saved. Please try again.');}
    }catch(e){await undo();throw e;}
    // The file is complete, so every other link for this booking closes too.
    await db.from('booking_document_tokens').update({used_at:now}).eq('booking_id',bookingId).is('used_at',null);
    await audit(db,null,'documents',bookingId);
    return Response.json({ok:true,count:files.length},{status:201,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
  }catch(e){return fail(e);}
}
```

## app/api/lookup/route.js

```javascript
import { DEMO } from '@/lib/config';
import { validateLookup, lookupView, needsDocumentsLink, LOOKUP_NOT_FOUND } from '@/lib/lookup';
import { emrAdapter } from '@/lib/emr';
import { adminClient, mapBooking, sameOrigin, fail, verifyTurnstile, requestHash, issueDocumentToken } from '@/lib/server';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
// /my-booking: find a booking by its reference and the email it was made with. Turnstile, a honeypot and a limit of
// 10 attempts per IP per hour (counted in the database, like bookings) stop guessing. "Not found" and "wrong email"
// return the same error, and the response holds only lookupView's fields: never contact details, insurance,
// documents or the affiliate. If the government ID is still missing, a fresh single-use "Complete your file" token
// is issued for this patient, who has just proven the reference and email.
export async function POST(request){
  try{
    sameOrigin(request);if(DEMO)return fail(new Error('Use the browser demo lookup.'),409);
    const raw=await request.json();if(raw.website)return fail(new Error(LOOKUP_NOT_FOUND),404);
    await verifyTurnstile(request,raw.captcha,'lookup');
    const {reference,email}=validateLookup(raw),db=adminClient();
    const {data,error}=await db.rpc('lookup_booking',{p_reference:reference,p_email:email,p_request_hash:requestHash(request)});
    if(error)throw new Error(error.message.includes('rate limit')?'Too many attempts. Please try again in an hour, or call the clinic.':'Booking lookup is temporarily unavailable. Please call the clinic.');
    if(!data?.length)return fail(new Error(LOOKUP_NOT_FOUND),404);
    const row=data[0],b=mapBooking(row);
    const [affiliate,id]=await Promise.all([
      b.giftCard&&b.affiliateId?db.from('affiliates').select('name,gift_code').eq('id',b.affiliateId).maybeSingle():{data:null},
      db.from('booking_documents').select('id').eq('booking_id',b.id).eq('kind','government-id').limit(1)
    ]);
    // The EMR, once connected, is the source of truth for status, doctor and time. Until then it returns null.
    let emr=null;try{emr=await emrAdapter().getAppointment(b.reference);}catch(e){console.error('EMR lookup failed:',e?.message);}
    const view=lookupView(b,{affiliate:affiliate.data?{name:affiliate.data.name,code:affiliate.data.gift_code}:null,fileComplete:!!id.data?.length,emr});
    const documentsToken=needsDocumentsLink(view)?await issueDocumentToken(db,row):null;
    return Response.json({booking:{...view,...(documentsToken?{documentsToken}:{})}},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
  }catch(e){return fail(e);}
}
```

## app/api/reminders/route.js

```javascript
import { adminClient, mapBooking, fail } from '@/lib/server';
import { claimAndSend } from '@/lib/notifications';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export async function GET(request){
  const secret=process.env.CRON_SECRET;if(!secret||secret.length<32||request.headers.get('authorization')!=='Bearer '+secret)return fail(new Error('Unauthorized.'),401);
  try{const db=adminClient(),now=Date.now();const {data,error}=await db.from('bookings').select('*').eq('status','Booked').gte('start',new Date(now).toISOString()).lte('start',new Date(now+26*3600000).toISOString());if(error)throw new Error('Could not load reminders.');let count=0;for(const row of data){const hours=(new Date(row.start).getTime()-now)/3600000;const kind=hours<=2?'same-day':hours>=22?'day-before':null;if(kind){await claimAndSend(db,mapBooking(row),kind);count++;}}return Response.json({processed:count});}catch(e){return fail(e,500);}
}
```

## app/api/workspace/route.js

```javascript
import { identity, requireStaff, sameOrigin, fail, mapBooking, mapAffiliate, mapPricing, encryptPolicy, audit, issueGift, issueDocumentToken } from '@/lib/server';
import { clean, validateStatus, validateSlug, validateBooking, safePhoto, validateGiftCode, validateDoctor } from '@/lib/validation';
import { claimAndSend } from '@/lib/notifications';
import { clinic, documentsLink, services } from '@/lib/config';
import { validateCompletion, validatePricing } from '@/lib/commission';
import { AFFILIATE_COLUMNS, restrictAffiliateRow } from '@/lib/affiliate';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export async function GET(request){
  try{const u=await identity(request);const db=u.db;
    // Affiliates get only their own referrals, as the restricted rows in lib/affiliate.js (id, name, status, start,
    // commission, payout, paid_at): never contact details, service, insurance, documents or procedure amounts.
    if(u.role==='affiliate'){
      const [a,b]=await Promise.all([db.from('affiliates').select('*').eq('id',u.affiliateId).single(),db.from('bookings').select(AFFILIATE_COLUMNS).eq('affiliate_id',u.affiliateId).order('start',{ascending:false})]);
      if(a.error||b.error)throw new Error('Unable to load your referrals.');
      return Response.json({user:{role:u.role,affiliateId:u.affiliateId},affiliates:[mapAffiliate(a.data)],bookings:b.data.map(restrictAffiliateRow),templates:[],slots:[]},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
    }
    requireStaff(u);
    const [a,b,t,s,j]=await Promise.all([db.from('affiliates').select('*').order('created_at'),db.from('bookings').select('*').order('start',{ascending:false}).limit(2000),db.from('message_templates').select('*').order('id'),db.rpc('available_slots'),db.from('notification_jobs').select('booking_id,kind,status,result,created_at').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100)]);
    if(a.error||b.error||t.error||s.error||j.error)throw new Error('Unable to load the workspace.');
    // Uploaded documents for these bookings (names and sizes only; never storage paths). Before migration 005 has run
    // the table is missing, so the workspace still loads, just without documents.
    const d=await db.from('booking_documents').select('id,booking_id,kind,original_name,size,mime,uploaded_at').order('uploaded_at').limit(16000);
    if(d.error)console.error('Documents not loaded:',d.error.code);
    const docs=new Map();for(const r of d.data||[])docs.set(r.booking_id,[...(docs.get(r.booking_id)||[]),r]);
    // Procedure prices (migration 007). Missing before it has run: the workspace still loads, with no prices.
    const pr=await db.from('procedure_costs').select('*');if(pr.error)console.error('Pricing not loaded:',pr.error.code);
    return Response.json({user:{role:'staff'},procedureCosts:(pr.data||[]).map(mapPricing),affiliates:a.data.map(mapAffiliate),bookings:b.data.map(r=>mapBooking(r,docs.get(r.id))),templates:t.data,slots:s.data,jobs:j.data},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
  }catch(e){return fail(e,401);}
}
export async function POST(request){
  try{sameOrigin(request);const u=await identity(request),db=u.db;
    if(request.headers.get('content-type')?.includes('multipart/form-data')){
      const form=await request.formData(),file=form.get('file'),id=u.role==='affiliate'?u.affiliateId:String(form.get('affiliateId'));
      if(!file || typeof file.arrayBuffer!=='function' || file.size>2*1024*1024 || !['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp'].includes(file.type))throw new Error('Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP image smaller than 2 MB.');
      const bytes=Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());const valid=(file.type==='image/png'&&bytes.subarray(0,8).toString('hex')==='89504e470d0a1a0a')||(file.type==='image/jpeg'&&bytes[0]===255&&bytes[1]===216)||(file.type==='image/webp'&&bytes.subarray(0,4).toString()==='RIFF'&&bytes.subarray(8,12).toString()==='WEBP');if(!valid)throw new Error('The file does not match its image type.');
      const {data:a}=await db.from('affiliates').select('id').eq('id',id).single();if(!a)throw new Error('Affiliate not found.');
      const key=id+'/'+crypto.randomUUID()+'.'+(file.type==='image/jpeg'?'jpg':file.type.split('/')[1]);const {error}=await db.storage.from('affiliate-photos').upload(key,bytes,{contentType:file.type});if(error)throw new Error('Could not upload this image.');
      const {data:url}=db.storage.from('affiliate-photos').getPublicUrl(key);const {error:update}=await db.from('affiliates').update({photo:url.publicUrl}).eq('id',id);if(update)throw new Error('Could not save this image.');await audit(db,u.id,'photo',id);return Response.json({ok:true});
    }
    const {action,payload:p}=await request.json();let error=null;
    if(action==='profile'){
      const id=u.role==='affiliate'?u.affiliateId:p.id;const name=clean(p.name,120);if(name.length<2)throw new Error('Please enter a name.');({error}=await db.from('affiliates').update({name,bio:clean(p.bio,500)}).eq('id',id));
    }else{
      requireStaff(u);
      if(action==='status'){
        const status=validateStatus(p.status);({error}=await db.from('bookings').update({status}).eq('id',p.id));
        if(!error&&status==='No-show'){const {data:b}=await db.from('bookings').select('*').eq('id',p.id).single();if(b)await claimAndSend(db,mapBooking(b),'no-show');}
      }else if(action==='complete'){
        // Staff send only what the patient was billed and the discount. The database snapshots the operation cost and
        // the affiliate's rate, calculates net and commission, marks the visit Attended and writes the audit entry.
        const {gross,discount}=validateCompletion(p);
        const {error:ce}=await db.rpc('complete_appointment',{p_id:String(p.id||''),p_gross:gross,p_discount:discount,p_actor:u.id});
        if(ce)throw new Error(ce.message.includes('locked')?'This referral has been paid, so its commission is locked.':ce.message.includes('not found')?'Booking not found.':'Could not save this appointment. Check the amounts and try again.');
        return Response.json({ok:true});
      }else if(action==='pricing'){
        if(!services.some(s=>s.id===p.service))throw new Error('Unknown procedure.');
        const {retailPrice,operationCost}=validatePricing(p);
        ({error}=await db.from('procedure_costs').upsert({service:p.service,retail_price:retailPrice,operation_cost:operationCost,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()}));
      }else if(action==='payout'){
        if(!Array.isArray(p.ids)||!p.ids.length||p.ids.length>100)throw new Error('Select up to 100 referrals.');({error}=await db.rpc('approve_payout',{p_ids:p.ids,p_actor:u.id}));
      }else if(action==='affiliate'){
        const name=clean(p.name,120),email=clean(p.email,254);if(name.length<2||!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email))throw new Error('Enter a name and valid email.');const slug=validateSlug(p.slug);const rate=Number(p.commissionRate||0);if(!Number.isFinite(rate)||rate<0||rate>100)throw new Error('Commission rate must be between 0 and 100.');const giftCode=validateGiftCode(p.code);
        const {data:exists}=await db.from('affiliates').select('id').eq('slug',slug).maybeSingle();if(exists)throw new Error('That referral page name already exists.');
        const {data:invite,error:inviteError}=await db.auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail(email,{redirectTo:clinic.site+'/login?set-password=1'});if(inviteError)throw new Error('Could not invite this email. Check whether it already has an account.');
        const {data:a,error:ae}=await db.from('affiliates').insert({name,email,slug,bio:clean(p.bio,500),photo:safePhoto(p.photo),commission_rate:rate,commission_note:clean(p.commissionNote,300),...(giftCode?{gift_code:giftCode}:{})}).select('id').single();
        if(ae)throw new Error('The invitation was sent, but the affiliate record could not be created. Staff must review this account in Supabase.');
        const {error:pe}=await db.from('profiles').insert({id:invite.user.id,role:'affiliate',affiliate_id:a.id});if(pe){await db.from('affiliates').update({active:false}).eq('id',a.id);throw new Error('The invitation was sent, but workspace access could not be created. Staff must review this inactive account in Supabase.');}
      }else if(action==='toggle-affiliate'){
        const {data:a}=await db.from('affiliates').select('active').eq('id',p.id).single();if(!a)throw new Error('Affiliate not found.');({error}=await db.from('affiliates').update({active:!a.active}).eq('id',p.id));
      }else if(action==='template'){
        const subject=clean(p.subject,150),body=clean(p.body,3000);if(!subject||!body)throw new Error('Enter a subject and message.');({error}=await db.from('message_templates').update({subject,body}).eq('id',p.id));
      }else if(action==='slot'){
        const start=new Date(p.start),duration=Number(p.duration);if(!Number.isFinite(start.getTime())||start<=new Date()||![15,30,45,60,90].includes(duration))throw new Error('Choose a future time and a valid duration.');const doctor=validateDoctor(p.doctor);({error}=await db.from('appointment_slots').insert({doctor,start:start.toISOString(),duration}));if(error?.code==='23505')throw new Error('This optometrist already has this time.');
      }else if(action==='booking'){
        const b=validateBooking(p,true);const {data,error:e}=await db.rpc('create_booking',{p_name:b.name,p_email:b.email,p_phone:b.phone,p_doctor:b.doctor,p_start:b.start,p_service:b.service,p_affiliate:b.affiliateId,p_source:b.source,p_first_visit:b.firstVisit,p_insurance:b.insurance,p_policy:encryptPolicy(b.policy),p_brands:b.brands,p_sms:b.smsConsent,p_request_hash:null});error=e;if(!e){const token=await issueDocumentToken(db,data[0]);await claimAndSend(db,{...mapBooking(await issueGift(db,data[0])),documentsLink:documentsLink(token)},'confirmation');}
      }else if(action==='document-url'){
        // A signed link to one uploaded document, valid for 5 minutes. Only staff reach this point.
        const {data:doc}=await db.from('booking_documents').select('id,booking_id,file_path').eq('id',String(p.id||'')).maybeSingle();if(!doc)throw new Error('Document not found.');
        const {data:signed,error:se}=await db.storage.from('booking-documents').createSignedUrl(doc.file_path,300);if(se||!signed?.signedUrl)throw new Error('This document could not be opened. Please try again.');
        await audit(db,u.id,'document-view',doc.id);return Response.json({url:signed.signedUrl},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
      }else throw new Error('Unknown action.');
    }
    if(error)throw new Error('Could not save the change. Check the selected records and try again.');await audit(db,u.id,action,p.id||'batch');return Response.json({ok:true});
  }catch(e){return fail(e);}
}
```

```css
:root{--paper:#f6f5f2;--white:#fff;--ink:#14181d;--muted:#5b6067;--line:#dcdbd6;--soft:#eeede9;--gold:#b49a67;--gold-text:#7a6230;--tint:#ece4d2;--danger:#8a2727;--serif:'Bodoni Moda Variable',Didot,'Bodoni 72',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Jost Variable','Futura','Avenir Next',system-ui,sans-serif;--radius:2px;--ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:6rem}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:1rem/1.6 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit}
button,a,input,select,textarea{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}

small{font-size:.875rem}

textarea{resize:vertical}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--gold-text);outline-offset:2px}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold-text);outline-offset:4px}

.prose{max-width:800px;padding-block:5rem}
.prose h1{font-size:3.5rem}
.prose h2{font-size:1.8rem;margin-top:2.5rem}
.prose p{max-width:70ch}
@media(max-width:1100px){.workspace{grid-template-columns:210px minmax(0,1fr)}.workspace-header{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.affiliate-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.workspace-main{padding:2rem 1.5rem}}
@media(max-width:800px){.workspace{display:block}.sidebar{height:auto;position:relative;padding:1.2rem 1.5rem;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);gap:1rem}.sidebar>.logo{margin-bottom:.5rem}.workspace-label{display:none}.sidebar nav{flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;padding-bottom:.3rem}.sidebar nav a{white-space:nowrap;font-size:.85rem;padding:.65rem .9rem}.sidebar-bottom{position:absolute;right:1.5rem;top:1.15rem;flex-direction:row;gap:1rem;align-items:center;font-size:.8rem}.sidebar-bottom button{min-height:30px}.workspace-main{padding:2rem 1.5rem}.workspace-header h1{font-size:2.4rem}.referral-panel{padding:1.5rem;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}.referral-panel h2{font-size:1.65rem}.template-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.panel{padding:1.5rem}.payout-summary{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem}.view-tabs small{font-size:.7rem}.month-grid>button,.month-grid>span{min-height:70px;padding:.5rem}.month-grid small{font-size:.6rem}.calendar-heading h2{font-size:1.1rem}.calendar-heading .button{font-size:.7rem;min-height:40px}.link-page .qr{width:180px;height:180px}.modal{padding:1.5rem}.prose{padding-block:3rem}.prose h1{font-size:2.7rem}}
@media(max-width:480px){.container{width:calc(100% - 2.5rem)}.form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.form-actions .button{flex:1;padding:.85rem 1rem}.workspace-main{padding:1.75rem 1.25rem}.sidebar{padding:1.1rem 1.25rem}.sidebar-bottom{right:1.25rem;gap:.6rem}.sidebar-bottom>a{display:none}.stats{gap:.65rem}.stats article{padding:1rem .8rem}.stats p{font-size:.8rem}.stats strong{font-size:1.9rem}.filters .field{min-width:calc(50% - 1rem)}.filters .field:first-child{flex-basis:100%}.profile-image{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.affiliate-card-header{gap:.75rem}.affiliate-link{align-items:flex-start}.month-grid small{font-size:.6rem;line-height:1.2}.view-tabs small{max-width:130px}.modal-head h2{font-size:1.5rem}.link-value{font-size:.95rem}.prose h1{font-size:2.5rem}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*,*:before,*:after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
/* Staff: "File complete" / "Missing ID" and the Documents section of booking details */
.file-badge{display:block;width:max-content;margin-top:.3rem}
.booking-documents{margin-top:1.5rem;padding-top:1.25rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.booking-documents h3{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;font-size:1.1rem;margin:0 0 .75rem}
.document-list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:.75rem 0 0;display:grid;gap:.5rem}
.document-list li{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding:.6rem .8rem;background:#f6f5f2}
.document-list small{display:block;color:#5f625c;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
/* Staff: commission calculator (Payouts and booking details) and the Pricing page */
.calc-link{display:block;margin-top:.25rem}
.calculator{margin-top:1.5rem;padding-top:1.25rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.booking-details+.calculator,.modal .stack>.calculator{border-top:0;padding-top:0;margin-top:0}
.calculator h3{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;font-size:1.1rem;margin:0 0 1rem}
.calc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.75rem 1rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.calc-output{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:.15rem;padding:.6rem .8rem;background:#f6f5f2}
.calc-output span{font-size:.8rem;color:#5f625c}
.calc-output output{font-size:1.05rem}
.calc-output.total{background:#202221;color:#fff}
.calc-output.total span{color:#c9cbc6}
.calc-output.total output{font-size:1.3rem}
.pricing-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:1rem}
.price-row{display:grid;gap:.75rem;align-content:start}
.price-row h2{font-size:1.15rem;margin:0}
@media(max-width:480px){.calc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
/* Affiliate overview: a short note under each figure, e.g. "counts once completed" */
.stats small{display:block;margin-top:.35rem;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
/* Staff: affiliate performance (table, cards on phones), the affiliate page and the overview strip */
.sort-button{border:0;background:none;padding:0;font:inherit;font-weight:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.sort-button:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.affiliate-name{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.affiliate-name img{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;flex:none}
.affiliate-name:hover strong{text-decoration:underline}
.affiliate-name small{display:block;color:#5f625c}
.row-actions{display:flex;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.upload-inline{cursor:pointer}
.upload-inline:focus-within{outline:3px solid var(--gold-text,#8a6d2b);outline-offset:2px}
.top-affiliates{margin-bottom:1.75rem}
.top-affiliates ol{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:.75rem}
.top-affiliates a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;padding:.9rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--white);border-radius:4px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.top-affiliates a:hover{border-color:#9fa0a0}
.top-affiliates img{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.top-affiliates small{display:block;color:#5f625c}
.top-affiliates .rank{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.4rem;width:1.2rem;text-align:center}
.affiliate-hero{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.25rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.affiliate-hero img{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.affiliate-hero>div:first-of-type{flex:1;min-width:14rem}
.affiliate-hero h2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;margin:0 0 .3rem}
.stats-six{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}
.stats-six strong{font-size:1.8rem}
.appointments-table td,.appointments-table th,.performance-table td,.performance-table th{white-space:nowrap}
.calc-row td{background:#f6f5f2;white-space:normal}
.calc-row .calculator{max-width:560px;margin:0;border:0;padding:.5rem 0}
.affiliate-preview{border:1px dashed #b9b8b2;padding:1.25rem;border-radius:4px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.stats-six{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:700px){
 .stats-six{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
 .performance-table table,.performance-table tbody,.performance-table tr,.performance-table td,.appointments-table table,.appointments-table tbody,.appointments-table tr,.appointments-table td{display:block;width:100%}
 .performance-table thead,.appointments-table thead{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
 .performance-table tr,.appointments-table tbody>tr:not(.calc-row){border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:.75rem;padding:.5rem .75rem;background:var(--white)}
 .performance-table td,.appointments-table td{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;border:0;padding:.35rem 0;white-space:normal;text-align:right}
 .performance-table td::before,.appointments-table td::before{content:attr(data-label);color:#5f625c;font-size:.85rem;text-align:left}
 .performance-table td[data-label="Affiliate"],.appointments-table td[data-label="Patient"]{display:block;text-align:left}
 .performance-table td[data-label="Affiliate"]::before,.appointments-table td[data-label="Patient"]::before{content:none}
 .performance-table,.appointments-table{border:0;overflow:visible}
}
/* Keep absolutely positioned screen-reader text inside a scrolling table from widening the page */
.table-wrap{position:relative}
.stats-six strong{font-size:1.5rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow-wrap:normal}
/* The workspace sidebar is narrow (240px, 210px on tablets): a slightly smaller wordmark keeps the mark inside it. */
.sidebar .logo { --word: 1.4rem; }
```

```javascript
import { Header,Footer } from '@/components/ui';
import { clinic,DEMO } from '@/lib/config';
export const metadata={title:'Privacy notice'};
export default function Page(){return <><Header/><main className="container prose" id="main-content"><p className="eyebrow">YOUR INFORMATION</p><h1>Booking privacy notice</h1><p className="notice">Draft notice for clinic review. Eyecon must confirm its legal entity, privacy contact, retention period and service-provider arrangements before live patient use.</p><h2>Information used for your appointment</h2><p>The booking form asks for your name, contact details, selected appointment and first-visit status. Optional insurance information and favourite brands help clinic staff prepare for your visit.</p><h2>Personal referrals</h2><p>If you book through an affiliate, that affiliate can see your name and referral status. Affiliates do not receive your appointment type, insurance information, prescription, email address, phone number, residency status or uploaded documents through this platform.</p><h2>Identification and documents</h2><p className="notice">For clinic review before launch. Confirm or replace every bracketed passage.</p><p>[After you book, we ask you to complete your file: your residency status, a valid government ID and, optionally, other documents such as diplomas, certificates or English language test results. We collect these because [the clinic’s reason for collecting each item]. You can skip this step and bring them to your visit instead. Files are stored in a private location that only authorised clinic staff can open, through links that expire after five minutes. We keep them for [retention period] and then delete them. You can ask to see, correct or delete your documents by contacting [privacy contact].]</p><h2>Appointment reminders</h2><p>Email confirms your booking. SMS reminders are optional and require your consent. Contact the clinic if you would like to withdraw SMS consent. Message and data rates may apply.</p><h2>Access to records</h2><p>Authorised clinic staff manage bookings and optional insurance details. In live mode, policy numbers are encrypted before storage. The clinic must approve the hosting region, retention policy and access arrangements.</p><h2>Contact the clinic</h2>{clinic.email?<a href={'mailto:'+clinic.email}>{clinic.email}</a>:<p>A designated privacy contact will be published before launch.</p>}{DEMO&&<><h2>Design preview</h2><p>This version uses sample records and browser storage. Use fictional information only. Clear site data or reset the demo on the sign-in page to remove demo bookings.</p></>}</main><Footer/></>;}
```

## app/shop/[slug]/page.js

```javascript
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { BrandPage } from '@/components/shop';
import { collections } from '@/lib/config';
// Every brand page is built at build time; any other slug is the site's not-found page.
export const dynamicParams=false;
export function generateStaticParams(){return collections.map(c=>({slug:c.slug}));}
const findBrand=slug=>collections.find(c=>c.slug===slug);
export async function generateMetadata({params}){const brand=findBrand((await params).slug);return brand?{title:{absolute:`${brand.name} · Shop Frames · Eyecon Optometry`},description:brand.blurb}:{};}
export default async function Page({params}){const {slug}=await params;if(!findBrand(slug))notFound();return <BrandPage slug={slug}/>;}
```

## app/site.css

```css
/* Eyecon public experience: header, landing page, booking flow, footer.
   Tokens live in globals.css (:root). Display type is Bodoni Moda, interface type is Jost. */

/* ---------- Type and base ---------- */
body { font: 400 1.0625rem/1.65 var(--sans); letter-spacing: .005em; }
h1, h2 { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 420; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -.015em; font-optical-sizing: none; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 5.6vw, 5.75rem); }
h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.4vw, 3.4rem); }
h3 { font-weight: 500; }
.eyebrow { font-size: .8rem; letter-spacing: .14em; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.pending-text { color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; font-size: .9rem; }

/* ---------- Buttons and links ---------- */
.button {
  position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .6rem;
  min-height: 52px; padding: .85rem 1.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 500 .95rem/1.3 var(--sans); letter-spacing: .04em;
  text-decoration: none; text-align: center; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate;
  transition: color .35s var(--ease), border-color .35s var(--ease), transform .2s var(--ease);
}
.button::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--gold);
  transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .45s var(--ease);
}
.button:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }
.button:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--ink); }
.button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.button.secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border-color: #b9b8b2; }
.button.secondary::before { background: var(--ink); }
.button.secondary:hover { color: var(--paper); border-color: var(--ink); }
.button:disabled { opacity: .45; }
.button:disabled::before { display: none; }
.text-link {
  border: 0; background: none; padding: .2rem 0; min-height: 32px; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none;
  background-image: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor); background-size: 100% 1px; background-position: 0 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat;
  transition: background-size .35s var(--ease), color .2s;
}
.text-link:hover { color: var(--gold-text); background-size: 30% 1px; }

/* ---------- Preview bar (demo only) ---------- */
.preview-bar { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: .5rem 1rem; background: #0d1014; color: #c9ccd1; font-size: .8rem; }
.preview-bar a { color: #e3d4b1; }

/* ---------- Logo ---------- */
.logo { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: max-content; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
.logo span { font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 20; letter-spacing: .32em; margin-right: -.32em; }
/* The mark: as tall as the capitals (Bodoni Moda's capitals measure .77em), on the baseline, about one letter's width
   after the N (the .32em letter spacing plus .38em). The mark and the N's trailing letter spacing hang into the logo's right padding, so EYECON and
   Optometry stay centred on each other. Deep gold on light backgrounds; the lighter accent gold on dark ones. */
.logo { --word: 1.7rem; --mark-h: .77em; --mark-gap: .38em; padding-right: calc(var(--word) * (.32 + .38 + .77 * 1.5)); }
.logo span { white-space: nowrap; font-size: var(--word); }
.logo-mark { display: inline-block; height: var(--mark-h); width: calc(var(--mark-h) * 1.5); margin-left: var(--mark-gap); margin-right: calc(-1 * (var(--mark-gap) + var(--mark-h) * 1.5)); vertical-align: baseline; overflow: visible; color: var(--gold-text); }
.site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .logo-mark, .login-editorial .logo-mark { color: var(--gold); }
.logo small { font-size: .62rem; letter-spacing: .45em; margin-right: -.45em; margin-top: .45rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }

/* ---------- Header: sticky, compacts on scroll ---------- */
.site-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 30; background: rgba(246, 245, 242, .82); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color .3s, background .3s; }
.site-header.scrolled { border-bottom-color: var(--line); background: rgba(246, 245, 242, .92); }
.header-inner { max-width: 1480px; margin: auto; padding: 1.25rem clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.75rem); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; transition: padding .3s var(--ease); }
.site-header.scrolled .header-inner { padding-block: .7rem; }
.header-actions { display: flex; gap: 1.75rem; align-items: center; }
.call-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; text-decoration: none; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.call-link:hover { color: var(--gold-text); }
.call-link.pending { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; cursor: default; }
.header-actions .button { min-height: 46px; padding: .7rem 1.4rem; font-size: .88rem; white-space: nowrap; }
/* Over the hero photograph: no footprint in the layout, transparent with light text until the page scrolls 40px */
.site-header.overlay { height: 0; border: 0; background: none; backdrop-filter: none; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; color: #fff; transition: color .3s; }
.site-header.overlay .header-inner { --pad: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.75rem); max-width: none; padding-inline: max(var(--pad), calc((100% - 1480px) / 2 + var(--pad))); border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: padding .3s var(--ease), background .3s, border-color .3s; }
.site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .logo small, .site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .call-link.pending { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .85); }
.site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .logo, .site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .call-link { text-shadow: 0 1px 14px rgba(20, 24, 29, .45); }
.site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .call-link:hover { color: #e3d4b1; }
.site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .button { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--paper); }
.site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .button:hover { border-color: var(--gold); }
.site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) :focus-visible { outline-color: #fff; }
.site-header.overlay.scrolled { color: var(--ink); }
.site-header.overlay.scrolled .header-inner { background: rgba(246, 245, 242, .92); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(14px); border-bottom-color: var(--line); }

/* ---------- Referral and gift ---------- */
.referral { display: flex; gap: .9rem; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
.referral img { width: 56px; height: 56px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--paper), 0 0 0 2px var(--gold); }
.referral small, .referral strong { display: block; }
.referral small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; letter-spacing: .03em; }
.referral strong { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 500; }
.gift { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.2rem; max-width: 34rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem 1rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #d8c9a6; background: linear-gradient(105deg, #f3ecdc, #faf7f0 60%, #f1e8d4); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.gift-value { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 2.3rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--gold-text); padding-right: 1.1rem; border-right: 1px solid #d8c9a6; }
.gift strong { display: block; font-weight: 500; }
.gift small { display: block; font-size: .8rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #6a5a39; margin-top: 2px; }
/* The card number line: each part stays whole and the line wraps between parts */
.gift small > span { white-space: nowrap; }
.gift-serial { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: .95em; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.gift-terms { color: var(--gold-text); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.gift-terms:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.gift.compact { padding: .8rem 1rem .8rem .8rem; }
.gift.compact .gift-value { font-size: 1.8rem; padding-right: .9rem; }

/* ---------- Hero: full-bleed photograph with the copy set inside it ---------- */
.hero { --r: 150px; position: relative; isolation: isolate; height: 100svh; min-height: 640px; overflow: hidden; background: #1c1917; color: #fff; touch-action: pan-y; }
.hero-photo { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: block; }
.hero-photo img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: 62% 28%; transform: scale(1.04); }
.hero > .hero-photo { z-index: -4; }
.hero-photo.soft img { filter: blur(7px) brightness(1.03) contrast(.94); }

/* Focus lens: a sharp, slightly magnified copy of the same photograph, clipped to a circle that follows the pointer */
.hero-lens { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -3; clip-path: circle(var(--r) at var(--x) var(--y)); animation: lens-open 1.4s .35s var(--ease) both; transition: clip-path .5s var(--ease); }
.hero-lens-zoom { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: scale(1.12); transform-origin: var(--x) var(--y); transition: transform-origin .5s var(--ease); }
.hero-lens img { filter: contrast(1.05); }
.lens-ring { position: absolute; left: var(--x); top: var(--y); z-index: -1; width: calc(var(--r) * 2); height: calc(var(--r) * 2); margin: calc(var(--r) * -1) 0 0 calc(var(--r) * -1); border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .78); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(20, 24, 29, .08), 0 18px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, .25), inset 0 0 40px rgba(255, 255, 255, .12); pointer-events: none; animation: ring-in 1.4s .35s var(--ease) both; transition: left .5s var(--ease), top .5s var(--ease); }
.hero.tracking .hero-lens, .hero.tracking .hero-lens-zoom, .hero.tracking .lens-ring { transition: none; }
.lens-hint { --pad: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.75rem); position: absolute; top: 6.75rem; right: max(var(--pad), calc((100% - 1480px) / 2 + var(--pad))); margin: 0; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .92); font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(20, 24, 29, .6); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .8s 1.2s; }
.hero.used .lens-hint { opacity: 0; }
/* Scroll cue: a hairline at the bottom centre with a light travelling down it (desktop only) */
.scroll-cue { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 0; width: 1px; height: 44px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .3); pointer-events: none; animation: cue-in .8s 1.1s both; }
.scroll-cue::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #fff; transform: translateY(-100%); animation: cue 2.6s 1.6s var(--ease) infinite; }
@keyframes cue-in { from { opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes cue { 0% { transform: translateY(-100%); } 60%, 100% { transform: translateY(100%); } }
@keyframes lens-open { from { clip-path: circle(0 at var(--x) var(--y)); } }
@keyframes ring-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.4); } }
/* A gentle gradient rising from the bottom edge */
.hero::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -2; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(20, 24, 29, .5), rgba(20, 24, 29, .24) 11%, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0) 24%), linear-gradient(to top, rgba(20, 24, 29, .5), rgba(20, 24, 29, .26) 40%, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0) 82%); }
/* The copy sits in the lower middle: the free space above and below it is split so its centre lands about 68% down */
/* The copy never blocks the lens: only its links, buttons and chip take the pointer */
.hero-copy { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 2rem clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3rem) 1.25rem; }
.hero-copy::before { content: ''; flex: 86 1 0; }
.hero-copy::after { content: ''; flex: 14 1 0; min-height: 1.5rem; }
.hero-text { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; max-width: 100%; text-align: center; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 24, 29, .35), 0 2px 22px rgba(20, 24, 29, .45); }
/* Soft dark glow behind the copy, fading out well before the edges of the photograph */
.hero-text::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -42% -45%; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; background: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(20, 24, 29, .45), rgba(20, 24, 29, .4) 60%, rgba(20, 24, 29, .18) 84%, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0)); }
.hero h1 { margin: 0 0 .9rem; max-width: 18ch; color: #fff; font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4.8vw, 4.75rem); }
.hero-description { max-width: 34rem; margin: 0 0 1.35rem; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .88); font-size: 1.15rem; }
.hero-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .9rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: .2rem 0 1.1rem; }
.hero-copy a, .hero-copy button, .hero-copy .referral { pointer-events: auto; }
.hero .button { text-shadow: none; }
.hero-actions .button { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--paper); }
.hero-actions .button:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--ink); }
.hero-actions .button.outline { background: rgba(20, 24, 29, .2); color: #fff; border-color: #fff; }
.hero-actions .button.outline:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--gold); }
.hero :focus-visible { outline-color: #fff; }
.hero-rating { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; margin: 0; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .92); font-size: .92rem; text-decoration: none; }
.hero-rating strong { color: #fff; font-weight: 500; }
.hero-rating:hover span { color: #fff; }
.hero .stars { color: #e3d4b1; }

/* Affiliate chip and gift card: dark glass over the photograph */
.hero .referral { gap: .7rem; margin: 0 0 1.1rem; padding: .35rem 1.15rem .35rem .35rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .28); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(20, 24, 29, .5); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); text-align: left; text-shadow: none; }
.hero .referral img { width: 40px; height: 40px; box-shadow: none; }
.hero .referral small { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .78); font-size: .74rem; line-height: 1.3; }
.hero .referral strong { font-size: .98rem; line-height: 1.3; }
.hero .gift { max-width: 32rem; margin: 0 0 1.2rem; padding: .6rem 1.7rem .6rem 1.4rem; border: 1px solid rgba(180, 154, 103, .75); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(20, 24, 29, .55); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.2); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.2); color: #fff; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; }
.hero .gift-value { color: #e3d4b1; border-right-color: rgba(180, 154, 103, .55); }
.hero .gift small { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .8); }
.hero .gift-terms { color: #e3d4b1; }
.hero .gift-terms:hover { color: #fff; }

/* Page-load sequence: the one orchestrated moment on the page */
.hero-text > * { animation: rise .9s var(--ease) both; }
.hero-text > *:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .08s; }
.hero-text > *:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .16s; }
.hero-text > *:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: .24s; }
.hero-text > *:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: .32s; }
.hero-text > *:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: .4s; }
@keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

/* ---------- Collections carousel ---------- */
.collections { padding: 5.5rem 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--white); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
/* The story lines up with the page container; the track runs on to the right edge of the window */
.collections-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 24rem) minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 5rem); padding-left: max(1.5rem, calc((100vw - 1250px) / 2)); }
.collections-title { margin: 0 0 2.5rem; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.carousel-count { margin: 0 0 .9rem; font-size: .85rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
/* Every story shares one grid cell, so the active one crossfades in and the block never changes height */
.brand-stories { display: grid; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
.brand-story { grid-area: 1 / 1; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity .45s var(--ease), visibility 0s .45s; }
.brand-story.active { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transition: opacity .6s .12s var(--ease), visibility 0s; }
.brand-story h3 { margin: 0 0 1rem; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 4.4vw, 4.4rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -.015em; }
.brand-story p { margin: 0; max-width: 23rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.05rem; }
.carousel-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; margin-top: 2.75rem; }
.carousel-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 1px solid #b9b8b2; border-radius: var(--radius); background: none; color: var(--ink); transition: background .3s var(--ease), color .3s, border-color .3s; }
.carousel-arrow:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
.carousel-arrow:disabled { opacity: .35; }
.carousel-progress { position: relative; flex: 1; height: 2px; margin-left: 1rem; overflow: hidden; background: var(--line); }
.carousel-progress span { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--ink); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .6s var(--ease); }

.brand-track { --gap: 1.25rem; --card: calc((100% - var(--gap) * 2) / 2.5); display: flex; gap: var(--gap); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: none; }
.brand-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.brand-track:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold-text); outline-offset: 6px; }
.brand-track li { flex: 0 0 var(--card); scroll-snap-align: start; }
/* Empty space after the last card, so it can travel all the way to the start of the track */
.brand-track .brand-track-end { flex-basis: calc(100% - var(--card) - var(--gap)); scroll-snap-align: none; }
.brand-card { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.brand-card:focus-visible { outline-offset: -3px; }
.brand-media { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; overflow: hidden; background: var(--soft); }
.brand-media > * { filter: grayscale(1); opacity: .55; transition: filter .6s var(--ease), opacity .6s var(--ease), transform 1.2s var(--ease); }
.brand-media img { object-fit: cover; }
/* The active card is in full colour and drifts slowly closer */
.brand-card[aria-current] .brand-media > * { filter: none; opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.06); transition: filter .6s var(--ease), opacity .6s var(--ease), transform 6s ease-out; }
.brand-placeholder { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .9rem; padding: 1.75rem; text-align: center; background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--soft), var(--tint)); }
.brand-placeholder::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: .9rem; border: 1px solid rgba(180, 154, 103, .55); }
.brand-placeholder strong { font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.2vw, 2.1rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.1; }
.brand-placeholder small { font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold-text); }

/* ---------- Sections ---------- */
.section { padding-block: 6rem; }
.section-intro { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3rem; align-items: end; margin-bottom: 3rem; }
.section-intro h2 { margin: 0; }
.section-intro p { color: var(--muted); max-width: 32rem; margin: 0; }

/* ---------- Appointments: an eye chart beside a detail panel ---------- */
.appointments { padding-top: 6rem; }
.chart-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, .8fr); gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 6rem); align-items: start; padding-bottom: 6rem; }
.chart { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.chart li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
/* Each line is a size smaller than the one above, like the rows of an eye chart */
.chart-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; width: 100%; padding: 1.15rem .25rem; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: clamp(calc(1.9rem - var(--i) * .14rem), calc(4.2vw - var(--i) * .4vw), calc(3.4rem - var(--i) * .32rem)); line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -.01em; opacity: .35; filter: blur(1.5px); transition: opacity .35s var(--ease), filter .35s var(--ease); }
.chart-row.active { opacity: 1; filter: none; }
.chart-row:focus-visible { outline-offset: -3px; }
/* While a line is pinned, hovering another only lifts it a little as a preview */
.chart-row.preview { opacity: .62; filter: blur(.5px); }
.chart-pin { display: inline-block; width: .5rem; height: .5rem; margin-right: .9rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold); vertical-align: middle; animation: detail-in .35s var(--ease) both; }
.chart-arrow { position: relative; flex: none; width: 3rem; height: 1px; background: var(--gold); opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-1rem); transition: opacity .35s var(--ease), transform .35s var(--ease); }
.chart-arrow::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; top: -3px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-top: 1px solid var(--gold); border-right: 1px solid var(--gold); transform: rotate(45deg); }
.chart-row:hover .chart-arrow, .chart-row:focus-visible .chart-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

.service-panel { position: sticky; top: 6.5rem; }
.service-detail { animation: detail-in .35s var(--ease) both; }
.service-detail.leaving { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; animation: detail-out .35s var(--ease) both; }
@keyframes detail-in { from { opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes detail-out { to { opacity: 0; } }
.service-photo { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; background: var(--tint); }
.service-photo img { object-fit: cover; }
.service-photo-fallback { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #f3ecdc, var(--tint)); color: var(--gold-text); }
.service-meta { margin: 0 0 .6rem; font-size: .8rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold-text); }
.service-detail h3 { margin: 0 0 1.1rem; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.2vw, 2.1rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.12; }
.service-points { margin: 0 0 1.75rem; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.service-points li { position: relative; padding: .6rem 0 .6rem 1.6rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); }
.service-points li:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.service-points li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 1.25rem; width: .8rem; height: 1px; background: var(--gold); }

/* Phone layout (shown below 860px): chips over a swipeable track of cards */
.appointment-mobile, .only-mobile { display: none; }

/* Urgent concerns: an ink strip across the full width */
.urgent-strip { background: var(--ink); color: #fff; }
.urgent-strip .container { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem 2rem; padding-block: 1.75rem; }
.urgent-strip p { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 2vw, 1.8rem); line-height: 1.2; }
.urgent-strip .button { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--paper); }
.urgent-strip .button:hover { border-color: var(--gold); }
.urgent-strip :focus-visible { outline-color: #fff; }
.urgent-pending { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; color: #c9ccd1; font-style: italic; }

/* ---------- Doctors: full-bleed portrait cards on ink ---------- */
.doctors { padding: 7rem clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.75rem); background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-top: 1px solid #2a3037; }
.doctors-intro { max-width: 44rem; margin: 0 auto 3.5rem; text-align: center; }
.doctors-intro h2 { margin: 0 0 1rem; color: var(--paper); }
.doctors-intro p { margin: 0; color: #b8bcc2; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.doctor-grid { --gap: 24px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: var(--gap); max-width: 1240px; margin-inline: auto; }
.doctor-card { position: relative; isolation: isolate; flex: 0 0 calc((100% - var(--gap) * (var(--per-row) - 1)) / var(--per-row)); max-width: 608px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 6px; background: #2a3037; container-type: inline-size; }
.doctor-card img { z-index: -2; object-fit: cover; object-position: 50% 10%; transition: transform 1.2s var(--ease); }
/* A soft gradient over the lower 55% keeps the white text readable on any photograph; the text block carries its own
   as well, so a long name or a two-line description that pushes the text higher is still backed. */
.doctor-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 45% 0 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0), rgba(20, 24, 29, .3) 35%, rgba(20, 24, 29, .58) 70%, rgba(20, 24, 29, .72)); }
.doctor-card-text { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 6rem 1.5rem 2rem; text-align: center; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 14px rgba(20, 24, 29, .5); background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0), rgba(20, 24, 29, .62) 5.5rem, rgba(20, 24, 29, .74)); }
.doctor-card h3 { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 0 .7rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.08; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
.doctor-card h3 em { font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-style: italic; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 8.2cqw, 2.4rem); }
.doctor-card h3 span { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 8.8cqw, 2.6rem); font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .08em; margin-right: -.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.doctor-card-text p { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; line-clamp: 2; overflow: hidden; max-width: 26rem; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .88); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; }
.doctor-pill { text-shadow: none; min-height: 46px; padding: .6rem 1.6rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .9); color: var(--ink); font: 500 .92rem/1.2 var(--sans); letter-spacing: .03em; transition: background .3s var(--ease); }
.doctor-pill:focus-visible { outline-color: #fff; }
.doctor-card-text { transition: opacity .3s var(--ease), visibility 0s; }
.doctor-card.open .doctor-card-text { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity .3s var(--ease), visibility 0s .3s; }
/* Intro panel: slides up over roughly the lower 62% of the card, growing if its content needs more room */
.doctor-panel { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 62%; max-height: 100%; padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem; overflow-y: auto; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); text-align: left; visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(100%); transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16, .84, .44, 1), visibility 0s .45s; }
.doctor-card.open .doctor-panel { visibility: visible; transform: none; transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16, .84, .44, 1), visibility 0s; }
.doctor-panel:focus { outline: none; }
.doctor-close { position: absolute; top: .7rem; right: .7rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: var(--ink); transition: background .2s; }
.doctor-close:hover { background: var(--soft); }
.doctor-panel-name { margin: 0 3rem .6rem 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1.15; }
.doctor-panel-intro { margin: 0 0 1.1rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: .98rem; line-height: 1.55; }
.doctor-facts { margin: 0 0 1.4rem; }
.doctor-facts div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6.5rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1rem; padding: .6rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.doctor-facts div:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.doctor-facts dt { color: var(--muted); font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 2; }
.doctor-facts dd { margin: 0; font-size: .98rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.doctor-panel .button { width: 100%; margin-top: auto; }
/* Phone-only pieces (shown below 860px): dots under the track, and the intro as a bottom sheet */
.doctor-dots, .doctor-sheet, .doctor-sheet-backdrop { display: none; }
@media (hover: hover) {
  .doctor-card:hover img { transform: scale(1.04); }
  .doctor-card:hover .doctor-pill { background: #fff; }
}

/* ---------- In their words: rating seal, featured review, review wall ---------- */
.voices { padding: 7rem 0; background: var(--paper); overflow: hidden; }
.voices-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28% minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem); }
.rating-seal { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .3rem; width: 200px; height: 200px; margin-inline: auto; border: 1px solid rgba(180, 154, 103, .6); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--ink); text-align: center; text-decoration: none; }
.rating-seal strong { font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: 3.6rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; }
.rating-seal .stars { margin: .2rem 0 .25rem; color: var(--gold); }
.rating-seal > span:not(.stars):not(.seal-arc):not(.seal-title) { font-size: .74rem; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.rating-seal:focus-visible { outline-offset: 6px; }
/* On hover a short champagne arc travels slowly round the ring */
.seal-arc { position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 50%; background: conic-gradient(var(--gold) 0 16%, transparent 16%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 3px), #000 calc(100% - 2.5px)); mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 3px), #000 calc(100% - 2.5px)); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .5s var(--ease); }
.rating-seal:hover .seal-arc, .rating-seal:focus-visible .seal-arc { opacity: 1; animation: seal-turn 8s linear infinite; }
@keyframes seal-turn { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.rating-seal.empty { gap: .7rem; }
.seal-title { max-width: 8rem; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.15; }
.rating-seal.empty .text-link { font-size: .88rem; }

.voices-label { margin: 0 0 1.5rem; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold-text); }
/* Marks invented design-preview content wherever it is shown */
.sample-tag { margin: 0; font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--muted); }
.voices-label + .sample-tag { margin: -1rem 0 1.5rem; }
.voice-stage { position: relative; }
.voice-stage:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold-text); outline-offset: 10px; }
.voice { margin: 0; animation: detail-in .35s var(--ease) both; }
.voice.leaving { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; animation: detail-out .35s var(--ease) both; }
.voice blockquote { margin: 0; }
.voice blockquote p, .voice-empty { max-width: 28ch; margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 2.6vw, 2.6rem); line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.01em; text-wrap: balance; }
.voice figcaption { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .5rem .8rem; margin-top: 1.5rem; font-size: .95rem; }
.voice figcaption strong, .review-card footer strong { font-weight: 500; }
.service-pill { padding: .15rem .6rem; border: 1px solid #c4c3bd; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .78rem; white-space: nowrap; }
.review-source { color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; }
.voice-empty { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
.voice-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; margin-top: 1.75rem; }
.voice-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid #b9b8b2; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: var(--ink); transition: background .3s var(--ease), color .3s, border-color .3s; }
.voice-arrow:hover { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
.voice-count { margin-left: .8rem; font-size: .82rem; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

/* Review wall: two rows of cards drifting slowly in opposite directions, fading out at both edges */
.review-wall { margin-top: 5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
.review-row { --fade: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 9%, #000 91%, transparent); overflow: hidden; -webkit-mask-image: var(--fade); mask-image: var(--fade); }
.review-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold-text); outline-offset: -3px; }
.review-belt { display: flex; width: max-content; animation: drift 60s linear infinite; }
.review-row.reverse .review-belt { animation-direction: reverse; }
.review-row:hover .review-belt, .review-row:focus .review-belt, .review-row:focus-within .review-belt { animation-play-state: paused; }
@keyframes drift { to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
.review-set { display: flex; gap: 1rem; margin: 0; padding: 0 1rem 0 0; list-style: none; }
.review-card { position: relative; flex: 0 0 320px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .9rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; }
.review-stars { position: relative; display: flex; color: var(--gold); }
.review-card .review-text { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 4; line-clamp: 4; overflow: hidden; margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; }
.review-card footer { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .4rem .6rem; margin-top: auto; padding-top: .9rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: .92rem; }
.review-card .review-source { margin-left: auto; }
.review-dots { display: none; }
.mentions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .9rem 1.5rem; margin-top: 3rem; }
.mentions p { margin: 0; font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.mention-pills, .insurer-pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.mention-pills li, .insurer-pills li { padding: .4rem .95rem; border: 1px solid #c4c3bd; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .9rem; white-space: nowrap; }

/* ---------- Your visit, prepared: a visit card with a tear-off stub ---------- */
.prepared { padding-bottom: 7rem; background: var(--paper); }
.prepared > .container { padding-top: 6rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.prepared-intro { margin-bottom: 3rem; text-align: center; }
.prepared-intro h2 { margin: 0 0 .8rem; font-size: clamp(2rem, 3vw, 2.6rem); }
.prepared-intro p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); }
.ticket { --notch: 22px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 248px; max-width: 1200px; margin-inline: auto; background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; }
.ticket-main { min-width: 0; }
.ticket-strip { margin: 0; padding: .85rem 2rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: .74rem; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold-text); }
.ticket-columns { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.ticket-columns.two { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.ticket-col { min-width: 0; padding: 2rem 1.75rem 2.25rem; }
.ticket-col + .ticket-col { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
.ticket-col h3 { margin: 0 0 .9rem; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.15; }
.ticket-col > p { margin: 0 0 1.25rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: .97rem; }
.ticket-col > .pending-text { margin: 0; }
.ticket-col > .sample-tag { margin: .8rem 0 0; font-size: .74rem; }
.bring-list, .know-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.bring-list li, .know-list div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: .1rem .9rem; padding: .8rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: .97rem; }
.bring-list li:last-child, .know-list div:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.bring-list svg, .know-list svg { color: var(--gold); }
.know-list svg { grid-row: span 2; }
.know-list dt { font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.know-list dd { margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
/* The stub: past a perforation, with a semicircle notch (in the page colour) where it meets the top and bottom edges */
.ticket-stub { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2rem 1.5rem 1.75rem; border-left: 1px dashed #c4c3bd; border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0; background: #f7f1e3; text-align: center; }
.ticket-stub::before, .ticket-stub::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: calc(var(--notch) / -2 - 1px); width: var(--notch); height: var(--notch); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--paper); }
.ticket-stub::before { top: calc(var(--notch) / -2 - 1px); clip-path: inset(50% -1px -1px -1px); }
.ticket-stub::after { bottom: calc(var(--notch) / -2 - 1px); clip-path: inset(-1px -1px 50% -1px); }
.stub-figure { margin: auto 0 .4rem; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: 3.6rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--gold-text); }
.stub-figure.words { font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--ink); }
.stub-line { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; }
.stub-note { margin: .35rem 0 0; color: #6a5a39; font-size: .88rem; }
.ticket-stub .button { width: 100%; margin-top: auto; padding-inline: .75rem; font-size: .88rem; }
.stub-line + .button, .stub-note + .button { margin-top: 1.5rem; }
.ticket-stub > :first-child { margin-top: auto; }
.ticket-stub .button { margin-bottom: 0; }
.ticket-stub { gap: 0; }
details { border-block: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 1.1rem 0; margin-top: 2rem; }
summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500; list-style: none; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
summary::after { content: '+'; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1; transition: transform .3s var(--ease); }
details[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(45deg); }
details p { margin: 1rem 0 0; color: var(--muted); }

/* Closing call to action */
.final-cta { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); text-align: center; padding: 6rem 0; }
.final-cta h2 { font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4.6vw, 4.4rem); margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.final-cta p { color: #b8bcc2; margin-bottom: 2.25rem; }
.final-cta h2 + .button { margin-top: 1rem; }
.final-cta .button { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--paper); }
.final-cta .button:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--gold); }

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
.footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.footer-inner { max-width: 1480px; margin: auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 3rem; padding: 3.5rem clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.75rem) 2rem; }
.footer-brand { align-self: start; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1rem; }
.footer-about { margin: 0; max-width: 32ch; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--muted); }
.footer-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: .45rem; }
.footer-col h2 { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.footer-col p { margin: 0; font-size: .95rem; }
.footer-col a { font-size: .95rem; text-decoration: none; }
.footer-col a:hover { color: var(--gold-text); }
.footer-legal { max-width: 1480px; margin: auto; padding: 0 clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.75rem) 2.5rem; font-size: .82rem; color: var(--muted); }

/* ---------- Mobile booking bar ---------- */
.mobile-book { display: none; }

/* ---------- Empty and loading ---------- */
.empty-page { min-height: 60vh; padding-block: 6rem; }
.empty-page h1 { font-size: 3rem; }
.empty-page .button { margin-top: 1rem; }

/* ---------- Booking flow ---------- */
.booking-shell { max-width: 1280px; margin: 3.5rem auto 6rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: .8fr 1.2fr; gap: 6rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; }
.booking-aside { position: sticky; top: 7rem; align-self: start; }
.booking-aside h1 { font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 4vw, 4rem); margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.booking-aside > p { max-width: 24rem; color: var(--muted); }
.booking-aside .referral { margin-top: 2.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.booking-help { margin-top: 3rem; padding-top: 1.75rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: .2rem 1rem; align-items: center; }
.booking-help svg { grid-row: span 2; color: var(--gold-text); }
.booking-help h3 { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; }
.booking-help p, .booking-help a { margin: 0; font-size: .92rem; color: var(--muted); }
.booking-panel { min-width: 0; }
.booking-panel h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 3vw, 2.6rem); margin: 0 0 1.75rem; outline: none; }
.booking-ref { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; font-size: .9rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; color: var(--muted); }
.booking-ref img { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; }
.booking-ref strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }

/* Progress */
.progress { margin-bottom: 2.75rem; }
.progress-track { height: 2px; background: var(--line); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.progress-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; background: var(--ink); transition: width .6s var(--ease); }
.stepper { list-style: none; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); padding: 0; margin: .85rem 0 0; }
.stepper li { font-size: .82rem; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .02em; transition: color .3s; }
.stepper li[aria-current] { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }
.stepper li.done { color: var(--ink); }
.stepper li .num { font-family: var(--serif); margin-right: .35rem; }

/* Step content enters when the step changes (answers the person's action) */
.step { animation: step-in .5s var(--ease) both; }
@keyframes step-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(14px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

/* Step 1: service */
.service-choices { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: .75rem; }
.service-choice { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .6rem; cursor: pointer; background: var(--white); padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); min-height: 150px; transition: border-color .25s, box-shadow .25s, transform .25s var(--ease); }
.service-choice:hover { border-color: #b9b8b2; transform: translateY(-2px); }
.service-choice svg { color: var(--gold-text); }
.service-choice strong { display: block; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; }
.service-choice small { display: block; font-size: .86rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
.service-choice input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.service-choice::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 1.1rem; right: 1.1rem; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #b9b8b2; transition: all .25s var(--ease); }
.service-choice.selected { border-color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink); }
.service-choice.selected::after { border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--white); }
.service-choice:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid var(--gold-text); outline-offset: 3px; }
```
