```css
.urgent-note { margin-top: 1.5rem; font-size: .92rem; color: var(--muted); }
.urgent-note a { color: var(--ink); }

/* Step 2: date and time */
.week-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 0; margin: 1.25rem 0 1.5rem; padding: 4px; background: var(--soft); border-radius: 999px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.week-tabs button { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted); min-height: 42px; padding: .5rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .92rem; transition: background .3s var(--ease), color .3s; }
.week-tabs button:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.week-tabs .active { background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(20, 24, 29, .12); }
.day-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(84px, 1fr)); gap: .55rem; margin-bottom: 1.75rem; }
.day-grid button { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: .1rem; padding: .8rem .2rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius); transition: border-color .2s, background .25s, color .25s; }
.day-grid button small { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.day-grid button span { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.2; }
.day-grid button:hover { border-color: #9fa0a0; }
.day-grid .active { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-color: var(--ink); }
.day-grid .active small { color: #b8bcc2; }
.empty-range { padding: 1.25rem; background: var(--soft); color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
.time-label { font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 .7rem; }
.time-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: .55rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.time-grid button { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius); font-size: .95rem; transition: border-color .2s, background .25s, color .25s; animation: step-in .35s var(--ease) both; }
.time-grid button:hover { border-color: #9fa0a0; }
.time-grid .active { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-color: var(--ink); }
.selection-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 1.15rem; background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 2px solid var(--gold); font-size: .95rem; margin-top: .5rem; }
.selection-summary svg { color: var(--gold-text); }
.selection-summary strong { font-weight: 500; }
.selection-summary small { display: block; color: var(--muted); }
.selection-summary .text-link { margin-left: auto; }
/* Choose a doctor or a time first: a full-width two-way switch above the range tabs */
.mode-toggle { display: flex; gap: 0; margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem; padding: 4px; background: var(--soft); border-radius: 999px; }
.mode-toggle button { flex: 1; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted); min-height: 46px; padding: .5rem 1rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .95rem; transition: background .3s var(--ease), color .3s; }
.mode-toggle button:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.mode-toggle .active { background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(20, 24, 29, .12); }
.doctor-choices { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: .75rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
.doctor-choice { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; cursor: pointer; background: var(--white); padding: .75rem 3rem .75rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); transition: border-color .25s, box-shadow .25s; }
.doctor-choice:hover { border-color: #b9b8b2; }
.doctor-choice img { width: 64px; height: 80px; object-fit: cover; flex: none; background: var(--soft); }
.doctor-choice strong { display: block; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; }
.doctor-choice small { display: block; font-size: .86rem; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--muted); }
.doctor-choice .doctor-choice-open { color: var(--gold-text); margin-top: .2rem; }
.doctor-choice input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.doctor-choice::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 1.1rem; margin-top: -10px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #b9b8b2; transition: all .25s var(--ease); }
.doctor-choice.selected { border-color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink); }
.doctor-choice.selected::after { border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--white); }
.doctor-choice:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid var(--gold-text); outline-offset: 3px; }
.doctor-choice.unavailable { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .55; }
.doctor-choice.unavailable:hover { border-color: var(--line); }
.doctor-pick { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
/* In "Choose a time", each time shows who is free: their portraits and names */
.time-grid.with-doctors button { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .3rem; padding: .55rem .4rem; min-height: 72px; }
.time-doctors { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: .2rem; max-width: 100%; }
.time-avatars { display: flex; }
.time-avatars img { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 1.5px solid var(--white); }
.time-avatars img + img { margin-left: -6px; }
.time-doctors small { font-size: .74rem; color: var(--muted); max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.time-grid .active .time-doctors small { color: #b8bcc2; }
.time-grid .active .time-avatars img { border-color: var(--ink); }

/* Step 3: details */
.choice-field { border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; gap: .75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.choice-field legend { font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: .7rem; }
.choice-field label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; flex: 1; min-width: 140px; border: 1px solid #c4c3bd; padding: .75rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer; background: var(--white); transition: border-color .2s; }
.choice-field label:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink); }
.optional-fields { margin-top: 0; }
.optional-fields summary small { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; margin-left: .6rem; margin-right: auto; }
.optional-fields .stack { margin-top: 1.1rem; }
.brand-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin-top: 1.1rem; }
.brand-chips button { min-height: 42px; padding: .45rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #c4c3bd; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; font-size: .92rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; transition: background .25s, color .25s, border-color .25s; }
.brand-chips button:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }
.brand-chips button[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-color: var(--ink); }
.checkbox-label { display: flex; gap: .8rem; align-items: flex-start; font-size: .95rem; }
.checkbox-label input { margin: 5px 0; }
.checkbox-label small { display: block; font-size: .82rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: .2rem; }
.privacy-note { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); }
.honeypot { position: absolute; left: -10000px; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; }

/* Step 4: confirmation */
.success-mark { width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.success-mark svg path { stroke-dasharray: 24; stroke-dashoffset: 24; animation: draw .6s .25s var(--ease) forwards; }
@keyframes draw { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
.confirmation-lead { font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--muted); }
.confirmation-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: .5rem 2rem; padding: 1.75rem; background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); margin: 1.5rem 0; }
.confirmation-card h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.6rem; }
.confirmation-card p { margin: 0; }
.confirmation-card .ref { grid-row: span 4; align-self: start; text-align: right; font-size: .82rem; color: var(--muted); }
.confirmation-card .ref strong { display: block; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink); letter-spacing: .06em; }
/* "Complete your file", below the booking card and on /documents */
.documents-card { padding: 1.75rem; background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 2px solid var(--gold); margin-bottom: 1.75rem; }
.documents-card h3 { margin: 0 0 .4rem; font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.6rem; }
.documents-card h3:focus { outline: none; }
.documents-card .form-actions { margin-top: .5rem; }
.documents-card label small, .documents-card legend small { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; margin-left: .35rem; }
.documents-extra { border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.file-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .5rem 1rem; padding: .65rem .9rem; background: var(--soft); margin-bottom: .5rem; font-size: .92rem; }
.file-row > span { flex: 1 1 12rem; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.file-row small { display: block; color: var(--muted); }
.file-row svg { color: var(--gold-text); }
.file-row select { min-height: 40px; }
.demo-label { display: inline-block; padding: .4rem .7rem; background: var(--soft); border: 1px dashed #b9b8b2; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); }
.success-mark.small { width: 44px; height: 44px; margin-bottom: .9rem; }
.documents-page { max-width: 760px; padding-block: 4rem 6rem; }
.documents-page h1 { font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
/* /my-booking */
.lookup-page { max-width: 760px; padding-block: 4rem 6rem; }
.lookup-page h1 { font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.lookup-form { max-width: 460px; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
.lookup-result .confirmation-card { margin-top: 0; }
.lookup-line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; font-size: .98rem; }
.lookup-line svg { color: var(--gold-text); flex: none; }
.lookup-line a { color: var(--ink); }
.calendar-card { padding: 1.75rem; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); margin-bottom: 1.75rem; }
.calendar-card h3 { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.7rem; margin: 0 0 .4rem; }
.calendar-card > p { color: #b8bcc2; font-size: .95rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.calendar-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: .6rem; }
.calendar-actions .button { background: transparent; color: var(--paper); border-color: #4a4f57; font-size: .9rem; padding-inline: .5rem; }
.calendar-actions .button::before { background: var(--paper); }
.calendar-actions .button:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--paper); }
.calendar-actions .button.primary { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--paper); grid-column: 1 / -1; min-height: 56px; font-size: 1rem; }
.calendar-actions .button.primary::before { background: var(--gold); }
.calendar-added { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; margin: 1rem 0 0; color: #e3d4b1; font-size: .92rem; }
.confirmation .gift { margin-bottom: 2rem; }
.confirmation h3.plain { font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.check-list { padding: 0; list-style: none; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
.check-list li { display: flex; gap: .75rem; align-items: flex-start; margin: .65rem 0; }
.check-list svg { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--gold-text); }

/* ---------- Login page ---------- */
.login-page { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; min-height: calc(100vh - 40px); }
.login-editorial { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); padding: 4rem clamp(2rem, 7vw, 7rem); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; }
.login-editorial .logo { margin-bottom: 4rem; align-items: flex-start; }
.login-editorial .logo small { color: #9aa0a7; }
.login-editorial h1 { font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 4.4rem); margin-bottom: 2rem; }
.login-editorial p { color: #b8bcc2; max-width: 30rem; }
.login-panel { max-width: 530px; width: 100%; align-self: center; justify-self: center; padding: 4rem 2rem; }
.login-panel h2 { font-size: 2.6rem; }
.login-panel > p:not(.eyebrow) { color: var(--muted); }
.login-panel > .stack { margin-top: 2rem; }
.login-panel small { color: var(--muted); }

/* Workspace buttons that used the old shared rule */
.view-tabs button { border: 1px solid #bcbeb5; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius); min-height: 46px; padding: .65rem 1rem; }

/* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .booking-shell { gap: 3rem; }
}
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .header-actions { gap: 1rem; }
  .call-link span { display: none; }
  .call-link { width: 44px; height: 44px; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 50%; }
  .header-actions .button { min-height: 44px; padding: .6rem 1rem; font-size: .82rem; }
  .logo { --word: 1.4rem; }
  /* On phones the hero is at least 92svh and grows rather than clipping its copy */
  .hero { --r: 95px; display: flex; height: auto; min-height: 92svh; }
  .scroll-cue { display: none; }
  .hero-copy { position: relative; inset: auto; flex: 1; min-height: 92svh; padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 1.5rem; }
  .hero-copy::before { min-height: 31.5svh; } /* keeps the copy below the face */
  .hero-copy::after { min-height: .5rem; }
  .hero h1 { margin-bottom: .6rem; }
  .hero-actions { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: .55rem; width: 100%; max-width: 26rem; margin: 0 0 .9rem; }
  .hero-actions > .button { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; }
  .lens-hint { top: 5.75rem; font-size: .64rem; }
  .site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .call-link { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55); }
  @media (min-width: 600px) { .hero-copy::before { min-height: 42svh; } }
  .hero-photo img { object-position: 50% 18%; }
  .hero::after { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(20, 24, 29, .5), rgba(20, 24, 29, .24) 11%, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0) 22%), linear-gradient(to top, rgba(20, 24, 29, .5), rgba(20, 24, 29, .3) 45%, rgba(20, 24, 29, .12) 66%, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0) 88%); }
  .hero-text::before { inset: -30% -60%; }
  .hero-description { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: .85rem; }
  .hero .gift { border-radius: 1.75rem; padding: .5rem 1.1rem .5rem 1rem; margin-bottom: .85rem; }
  .hero .gift-value { font-size: 1.7rem; }
  .hero .gift small { font-size: .74rem; line-height: 1.4; }
  .hero .referral { margin-bottom: .7rem; }
  .hero .referral img { width: 34px; height: 34px; }
  .collections { padding: 3.25rem 0; }
  .collections-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; padding-left: 0; }
  .collections-story { padding-inline: 1.5rem; }
  .collections-title { margin-bottom: 1.75rem; }
  .brand-stories { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .brand-story h3 { font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 11vw, 3.4rem); }
  .carousel-controls { margin-top: 1.75rem; }
  .carousel-arrow { display: none; }
  .carousel-progress { margin-left: 0; }
  .brand-track { --gap: .9rem; --card: 78vw; padding-inline: 1.5rem; scroll-padding-inline: 1.5rem; }
  .section { padding-block: 4rem; }
  .section-intro { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  /* Appointments on phones: no eye chart, no blur. Chips, then cards you swipe. */
  .appointments { padding-top: 3.5rem; }
  .appointments .section-intro { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .appointments h2 { font-size: 2rem; }
  .only-desktop, .chart-layout { display: none; }
  .only-mobile, .appointment-mobile { display: block; }
  .appointment-mobile { --pad: 1.25rem; padding-bottom: 3rem; }
  .appointment-chips { display: flex; gap: .5rem; padding: .25rem var(--pad); overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }
  .appointment-chips::-webkit-scrollbar, .appointment-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .appointment-chips button { flex: none; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1.15rem; border: 1px solid #b9b8b2; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: var(--ink); font-size: .95rem; white-space: nowrap; transition: background .25s var(--ease), color .25s, border-color .25s; }
  .appointment-chips button[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
  .appointment-track { --card: 84vw; --gap: .9rem; display: flex; gap: var(--gap); margin-top: 1.1rem; padding-inline: var(--pad); overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scroll-padding-inline: var(--pad); scrollbar-width: none; }
  .appointment-track:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold-text); outline-offset: -3px; }
  .appointment-card { flex: 0 0 var(--card); display: flex; flex-direction: column; scroll-snap-align: start; background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
  /* Empty space after the last card, so it can travel all the way to the start of the track */
  .appointment-track-end { flex: 0 0 calc(100% - var(--card) - var(--gap)); }
  .appointment-card .service-photo { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; margin: 0; }
  .appointment-card-body { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 1.15rem 1.15rem 1.25rem; }
  .appointment-card .service-meta { font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .1em; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  .appointment-card h3 { margin: 0 0 .8rem; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.15; }
  .appointment-card .service-points { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; font-size: .95rem; }
  .appointment-card .service-points li { padding-block: .5rem; }
  .appointment-card .service-points li::before { top: 1.1rem; }
  .appointment-card .button { width: 100%; margin-top: auto; }
  .appointment-dots { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; margin-top: 1.25rem; }
  .appointment-dots span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #c4c3bd; transition: width .3s var(--ease), background .3s; }
  .appointment-dots .active { width: 22px; background: var(--ink); }
  .urgent-strip .container { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 1.1rem; padding-block: 2rem; }
  .urgent-strip .button, .urgent-pending { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; justify-content: center; }
  .urgent-pending { border: 1px solid #4a4f57; border-radius: var(--radius); }
  .doctors { padding-block: 4.5rem; }
  .doctors-intro { margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
  /* Optometrists on phones: a swipeable row of cards, and the intro as a bottom sheet */
  .doctors { padding-inline: 0; }
  .doctors-intro { padding-inline: 1.25rem; }
  .doctors-intro h2 { font-size: 2.2rem; }
  .doctor-grid { --gap: .9rem; flex-wrap: nowrap; justify-content: flex-start; max-width: none; padding-inline: 1.25rem; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scroll-padding-inline: 1.25rem; scrollbar-width: none; }
  .doctor-grid::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .doctor-card { flex: 0 0 86vw; max-width: none; scroll-snap-align: start; }
  .doctor-grid[data-count="1"] .doctor-card { flex-basis: 100%; }
  .doctor-card h3 em { font-size: 2rem; }
  .doctor-card h3 span { font-size: 2.1rem; }
  /* A tighter text block on the smaller card, so the name sits below the chin and its backing stays clear of the eyes */
  .doctor-card-text { padding: 3.5rem 1.25rem 1.4rem; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0), rgba(20, 24, 29, .62) 3.25rem, rgba(20, 24, 29, .74)); }
  .doctor-card h3 { margin-bottom: .45rem; }
  .doctor-card-text p { margin-bottom: .9rem; }
  /* The in-card panel is desktop only; here the card keeps its name and pill while the sheet is open */
  .doctor-panel { display: none; }
  .doctor-card.open .doctor-card-text { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
  .doctor-dots { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; margin-top: 1.25rem; }
  .doctor-dots span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #4a4f57; transition: width .3s var(--ease), background .3s; }
  .doctor-dots .active { width: 22px; background: var(--paper); }

  .doctor-sheet-backdrop { display: block; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 59; background: rgba(20, 24, 29, .58); opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity .35s var(--ease), visibility 0s .35s; }
  .doctor-sheet-backdrop.open { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transition: opacity .35s var(--ease), visibility 0s; }
  .doctor-sheet { display: flex; flex-direction: column; position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0; z-index: 60; max-height: 85vh; max-height: 85dvh; padding: 2.25rem 1.25rem calc(1.25rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(100%); transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16, .84, .44, 1), visibility 0s .4s; }
  .doctor-sheet.open { visibility: visible; transform: none; transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16, .84, .44, 1), visibility 0s; }
  .doctor-sheet:focus { outline: none; }
  .doctor-sheet-handle { position: absolute; top: .7rem; left: 50%; width: 40px; height: 4px; margin-left: -20px; border-radius: 2px; background: #c4c3bd; }
  .doctor-sheet .doctor-close { top: 1.1rem; right: .6rem; }
  .doctor-sheet .button { flex: none; width: 100%; }
  /* While the sheet is open the page behind does not scroll, and the floating Book bar steps aside */
  .sheet-open { overflow: hidden; }
  .sheet-open .mobile-book.visible { transform: translateY(110%); }
  /* In their words on phones: seal, then the featured review, then one swipe row of cards with dots */
  .voices { padding: 4.5rem 0; }
  .voices-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 2.25rem; text-align: center; }
  .rating-seal { width: 160px; height: 160px; margin-inline: auto; }
  .rating-seal strong { font-size: 2.9rem; }
  .rating-seal > span:not(.stars):not(.seal-arc):not(.seal-title) { font-size: .66rem; }
  .seal-title { font-size: 1.3rem; }
  .voices-main .text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
  .voices-label { margin-bottom: 1.1rem; }
  .voices-label + .sample-tag { margin: -.7rem 0 1.1rem; }
  .voice blockquote p, .voice-empty { max-width: 22ch; margin-inline: auto; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1.25; }
  .voice-empty { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .voice figcaption { justify-content: center; margin-top: 1.1rem; }
  .voice-controls { justify-content: center; margin-top: 1.25rem; }
  .review-wall { margin-top: 3rem; gap: 0; }
  .review-row { -webkit-mask-image: none; mask-image: none; padding-inline: 1.25rem; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scroll-padding-inline: 1.25rem; scrollbar-width: none; }
  .review-row::-webkit-scrollbar, .mention-pills::-webkit-scrollbar, .insurer-pills::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .review-row.reverse, .review-set.copy, .review-card.filler { display: none; }
  .review-belt { animation: none; }
  .review-set { gap: .9rem; padding-right: 0; }
  .review-card { flex-basis: 80vw; scroll-snap-align: start; text-align: left; }
  .review-dots { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; margin-top: 1.25rem; }
  .review-dots span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #c4c3bd; transition: width .3s var(--ease), background .3s; }
  .review-dots .active { width: 22px; background: var(--ink); }
  /* Pills in one row that scrolls sideways, out to the screen or card edge */
  .mentions { display: block; margin-top: 2.5rem; }
  .mentions p { margin-bottom: .8rem; }
  .mention-pills, .insurer-pills { flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scrollbar-width: none; }
  .mention-pills { margin-inline: calc((100vw - 100%) / -2); padding-inline: calc((100vw - 100%) / 2); }
  .mention-pills li, .insurer-pills li { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
  .insurer-pills { margin-inline: -1.5rem; padding-inline: 1.5rem; }

  /* Your visit, prepared on phones: everything stacks, and the stub tears off along the bottom */
  .prepared { padding-bottom: 4.5rem; }
  .prepared > .container { padding-top: 4rem; }
  .prepared-intro { margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  .ticket { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .ticket-strip { padding-inline: 1.5rem; }
  .ticket-columns, .ticket-columns.two { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .ticket-col { padding: 1.75rem 1.5rem; }
  .ticket-col + .ticket-col { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .ticket-stub { padding: 2rem 1.5rem 1.5rem; border-left: 0; border-top: 1px dashed #c4c3bd; border-radius: 0 0 5px 5px; }
  .ticket-stub::before, .ticket-stub::after { top: calc(var(--notch) / -2); bottom: auto; }
  .ticket-stub::before { left: calc(var(--notch) / -2 - 1px); clip-path: inset(-1px -1px -1px 50%); }
  .ticket-stub::after { left: auto; right: calc(var(--notch) / -2 - 1px); clip-path: inset(-1px 50% -1px -1px); }
  .ticket-stub .button { min-height: 52px; font-size: .95rem; }
  .final-cta { padding: 4.5rem 0 5.5rem; }
  .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2rem; }
  .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .footer-legal { padding-bottom: 6rem; }
  .mobile-book { display: block; position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 25; padding: .75rem 1rem calc(.75rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); background: rgba(246, 245, 242, .94); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); transform: translateY(110%); transition: transform .45s var(--ease); }
  .mobile-book.visible { transform: none; }
  .mobile-book .button { width: 100%; }
  .booking-shell { grid-template-columns: 1fr; margin: 2rem auto 4rem; gap: 2rem; max-width: 640px; }
  .booking-aside { display: none; }
  .service-choices { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .service-choice { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; min-height: 0; padding-right: 3rem; }
  .service-choice::after { top: 50%; margin-top: -10px; }
  .login-page { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .login-editorial { padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem; }
  .login-editorial .logo { margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  .login-editorial h1 { font-size: 2.6rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .login-panel { padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem; max-width: 600px; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .gift { gap: .9rem; }
  .gift-value { font-size: 1.9rem; padding-right: .8rem; }
  .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .booking-shell { padding: 0 1.25rem; }
  .time-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .time-grid.with-doctors { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .doctor-choices { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .confirmation-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .confirmation-card .ref { grid-row: auto; text-align: left; }
  .form-actions .button { flex: 1; padding: .85rem 1rem; }
  .stepper { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .stepper li:not([aria-current]) { display: none; }
  .logo { --word: 1.25rem; }
  .header-actions { gap: .6rem; }
}

/* ---------- Reduced motion ---------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; animation-delay: 0s !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; }
  .hero-photo.soft img { filter: none; }
  .hero-lens, .lens-ring, .lens-hint { display: none; }
  .chart-row { filter: none; }
  .scroll-cue::after { animation: none; }
  .rating-seal:hover .seal-arc, .rating-seal:focus-visible .seal-arc { animation: none; }
  /* The review wall stops drifting and can be scrolled by hand instead */
  .review-belt { animation: none !important; }
  .review-row { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-mask-image: none; mask-image: none; }
  .review-set.copy { display: none; }
}

/* Skin tightening technologies: a scroll-snap row of cards, in the home panel and booking step 1 */
.skin-tech { margin: 0 0 1.75rem; min-width: 0; }
.skin-tech-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: .75rem; }
.skin-tech-title { margin: 0; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.skin-tech-title small { margin-left: .4rem; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); }
.skin-tech-arrows { display: flex; gap: .5rem; }
.carousel-arrow.small { width: 38px; height: 38px; }
.skin-tech-track { --gap: .75rem; display: flex; gap: var(--gap); margin: 0; padding: 0 0 .25rem; list-style: none; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: none; }
.skin-tech-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.skin-tech-track:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold-text); outline-offset: 4px; }
.skin-tech-track { --card: min(240px, 72%); }
.skin-tech-track li { flex: 0 0 var(--card); scroll-snap-align: start; }
.skin-tech-track .skin-tech-end { flex-basis: calc(100% - var(--card) - var(--gap)); scroll-snap-align: none; }
.tech-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; height: 100%; padding: 0; text-align: left; background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color .25s, box-shadow .25s; }
.tech-card:hover { border-color: #9fa0a0; }
.tech-card[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink); }
.tech-media { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: var(--soft); }
.tech-media img { object-fit: cover; }
.tech-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .3rem; padding: .85rem .95rem 1rem; }
.tech-body strong { font-weight: 500; }
.tech-body small { font-size: .85rem; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--muted); }
.tech-session { margin-top: .2rem; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--gold-text); }
.service-choices + .skin-tech { margin-top: 1.5rem; }

/* Shop frames: a card under the appointment chart, and a link in the header */
.shop-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.25rem; margin: 2.5rem 0 3rem; padding: 1.4rem 1.6rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--white); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .25s; }
.shop-card svg { color: var(--gold-text); flex: none; }
.shop-card strong { display: block; font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.5rem; }
.shop-card small { display: block; color: var(--muted); }
.shop-card > span { flex: 1; }
.shop-card .chart-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
.shop-card:hover { border-color: #9fa0a0; }

/* Booking page: rating seal and review cards in the left column */
.booking-reviews { margin-top: 2.5rem; padding-top: 1.75rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
.booking-reviews .rating-seal { width: 150px; height: 150px; margin: 0; }
.booking-reviews .rating-seal strong { font-size: 2.6rem; }
.booking-review-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: .75rem; }
.booking-review-list .review-card { flex: none; padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem; gap: .6rem; }
.booking-review-list .review-card .review-text { font-size: .92rem; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; line-clamp: 3; }
.booking-review-list .review-card footer { font-size: .84rem; }
/* With reviews the column is taller than the screen: let it scroll fully into view, then stick by its bottom edge. */
.booking-aside:has(.booking-reviews) { top: auto; bottom: 1.5rem; }

/* Header on phones: the logo with its mark, Shop frames, Clinic phone and the booking button on one row. */
.header-actions .label-short { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .header-inner { gap: .75rem; }
  .header-actions { gap: .4rem; }
  .site-header .logo { --word: 1.1rem; }
  .header-actions .label-long { display: none; }
  .header-actions .label-short { display: inline; }
  .header-actions .shop-link { gap: .3rem; }
}
/* The narrowest phones: Shop Frames stays in the appointments section and under the carousel rather than the header. */
@media (max-width: 359px) {
  .header-actions .shop-link { display: none; }
}

/* Real reviews: a card shows four lines and opens fully on click; the featured quote has a Read full review toggle. */
.review-card { cursor: pointer; }
button.review-text { padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.review-card .review-text { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.review-card.open .review-text { display: block; -webkit-line-clamp: unset; line-clamp: none; overflow: visible; }
.review-card:hover { border-color: #b9b8b2; }
.voice-more { display: inline-block; margin-top: 1rem; font-size: .92rem; }
.seal-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; }
.seal-tag { text-align: center; }
.booking-reviews .seal-wrap { align-items: flex-start; }

/* Shop */
/* Header link: Shop Frames, shortened to Frames on phones. It shares .call-link, so the overlay and scrolled header
   states colour it like the phone link. */
.shop-link .shop-long { display: inline; }
.shop-link .shop-short { display: none; }
/* Below 860px the phone link becomes a round icon button; Shop Frames stays the bag icon and text, with the same 44px tap height. */
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .header-actions .shop-link { width: auto; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; }
}
@media (max-width: 639px) {
  .shop-link .shop-long { display: none; }
  .shop-link .shop-short { display: inline; }
}
/* The quiet link under the home page carousel, lined up with the page container. */
.collections-more { width: min(1250px, calc(100% - 3rem)); margin: 2.5rem auto 0; text-align: right; font-size: .95rem; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.collections-more .text-link { color: var(--muted); }
.collections-more .text-link:hover { color: var(--gold-text); }
@media (max-width: 860px) { .collections-more { margin-top: 1.75rem; text-align: left; } }

/* The /shop page heading: centred, like a boutique's front window. */
.shop { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); }
.shop-heading { padding: clamp(4rem, 9vw, 7.5rem) 0 clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem); text-align: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.shop-heading .eyebrow { margin: 0 0 1.25rem; font-family: var(--sans); letter-spacing: .24em; margin-right: -.24em; color: var(--gold-text); }
.shop-heading h1 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(3.25rem, 8vw, 6.5rem); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.shop-heading h1::after { content: ''; display: block; width: 3rem; height: 1px; margin: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem) auto; background: var(--gold); }
.shop-subline { max-width: 34rem; margin: 0 auto; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted); text-wrap: balance; }
/* With its photograph the heading is a full-width header under the overlay site header. The models fill the photo
   from edge to edge, so on larger screens it sits on the right two-thirds and fades into a dark panel that holds the
   white words, vertically centred in the left third. Phones show the 4:5 crop whole, under the words, with its empty
   dark top sliding beneath them. */
.shop-hero { --hero-bg: rgb(12, 14, 20); position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 70vh; min-height: 480px; max-height: 820px; padding: 0; text-align: left; border-bottom: 0; color: #fff; background: var(--hero-bg); overflow: hidden; }
.shop-hero-photo { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 0 auto; z-index: -1; width: 68%; height: 100%; }
.shop-hero-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: right 30%; -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, #000 30%); mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, #000 30%); }
.shop-hero::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 11, 20, .5) 0%, rgba(8, 11, 20, 0) 20%); }
.shop-hero .container { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding-top: 72px; }
.shop-hero .container > * { max-width: min(24rem, 30%); }
.shop-hero .eyebrow { margin-right: 0; color: #e3d4b1; }
.shop-hero h1 { font-size: clamp(3.25rem, 6.5vw, 6.5rem); }
.shop-hero h1::after { margin-inline: 0; }
.shop-hero .shop-subline { margin: 0; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .88); }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .shop-hero { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; height: auto; min-height: 0; max-height: none; }
  .shop-hero::before { display: none; }
  .shop-hero .container { padding-top: 92px; }
  .shop-hero .container > * { max-width: 22rem; }
  .shop-hero h1 { font-size: 3.25rem; }
  .shop-hero-photo { order: 1; position: relative; inset: auto; z-index: 0; width: 100%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; margin-top: -30vw; }
  .shop-hero-photo img { object-position: center; -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0, #000 22%); mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0, #000 22%); }
}

/* Featured this week: a scroll-snap row of frame cards. Four cards with the fifth peeking on desktop. */
.featured-frames { padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem) 0 clamp(4rem, 8vw, 6.5rem); overflow: hidden; }
.featured-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
.featured-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink); }
.featured-sample { padding: .15rem .55rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); font-size: .68rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.featured-arrows { display: flex; gap: .6rem; margin-left: auto; }
.frame-row { --gap: 1.25rem; --card: calc((100% - var(--gap) * 4) / 4.35); display: flex; gap: var(--gap); margin: 0; padding: 0 0 .5rem; list-style: none; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scroll-behavior: smooth; scrollbar-width: none; }
.frame-row::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.frame-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold-text); outline-offset: 6px; }
.frame-card { position: relative; flex: 0 0 var(--card); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .3rem; scroll-snap-align: start; }
.frame-media { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; margin-bottom: .9rem; overflow: hidden; background: var(--soft); }
.frame-media img { object-fit: contain; padding: 8%; }
.frame-placeholder { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .75rem; background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--soft), var(--tint)); color: var(--gold-text); }
.frame-placeholder::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: .75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(180, 154, 103, .45); }
.frame-placeholder small { padding-inline: 1.25rem; font-size: .68rem; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: .16em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; }
.frame-new { position: absolute; top: .9rem; left: .9rem; padding: .2rem .55rem; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.frame-save { position: absolute; top: .4rem; right: .4rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; transition: color .25s var(--ease); }
.frame-save:hover, .frame-save[aria-pressed=true] { color: var(--gold-text); }
.frame-save[aria-pressed=true] svg { fill: currentColor; }
.frame-name { margin: 0; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.frame-material { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1.2; }
.frame-price { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
/* Reserve to try: fades in on hover or keyboard focus; always shown where there is no hover. */
.frame-reserve { align-self: flex-start; margin-top: .55rem; font-size: .9rem; letter-spacing: .02em; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); transition: opacity .35s var(--ease), transform .35s var(--ease), background-size .35s var(--ease), color .2s; }
.frame-card:hover .frame-reserve, .frame-card:focus-within .frame-reserve { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
@media (hover: none) { .frame-reserve { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
/* Phones: about one and a half cards, no arrows, and the row runs to the screen edge from a 16px start. */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .featured-head { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .featured-arrows { display: none; }
  .frame-row { --gap: .9rem; --card: 66vw; margin-inline: calc(50% - 50vw); padding-inline: 16px; scroll-padding-inline: 16px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .frame-row { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  .frame-reserve, .frame-save { transition: none; }
  .frame-reserve { transform: none; }
}

/* The houses: full-bleed banners that touch each other and the tile row below them, and rows of three tiles with a
   tight gutter. Each tile row has room above and below it; two rows in a row share one gap. */
.houses { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; padding-bottom: clamp(5rem, 10vw, 9rem); }
.houses .house-row { padding-block: clamp(40px, 4vw, 64px); }
.houses .house-row + .house-row { padding-top: 0; }
.house-name { margin: 0 0 .6rem; font: 500 .8rem/1.4 var(--sans); letter-spacing: .24em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.house-tagline { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
/* Banner: 16:9 up to 80% of the screen height; the words sit low and centred over a soft dark gradient, as on the hero. */
.shop-banner { position: relative; width: 100%; margin: 0; color: #fff; }
.shop-banner-media { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; max-height: 80vh; overflow: hidden; background: var(--soft); }
.shop-banner-media img { object-fit: cover; object-position: 50% 28%; }
.shop-banner-media::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(20, 24, 29, .62), rgba(20, 24, 29, .3) 32%, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0) 62%); }
.shop-banner-text { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; z-index: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 0 1.5rem clamp(2.5rem, 7vh, 4.75rem); text-align: center; text-shadow: 0 1px 14px rgba(20, 24, 29, .35); }
.shop-banner .house-name { text-indent: .24em; }
.shop-banner .house-tagline { max-width: 22ch; font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.6vw, 3.4rem); text-wrap: balance; }
.shop-banner .button { margin-top: 1.9rem; text-shadow: none; }
.shop-banner .button.outline { background: transparent; color: #fff; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .85); }
.shop-banner .button.outline:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--gold); }
/* Tile rows: three equal columns of square photographs; the photograph drifts very slightly closer on hover. */
.house-row { width: min(1250px, calc(100% - 3rem)); margin-inline: auto; }
.house-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 24px); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.house-tile { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
.house-media { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; margin-bottom: 1.4rem; overflow: hidden; background: var(--soft); }
.house-media img { object-fit: cover; transition: transform 1.2s var(--ease); }
.house-tile:hover .house-media img { transform: scale(1.03); }
.house-tile .house-tagline { margin-bottom: 1rem; font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2vw, 1.8rem); }
.house-link { font-size: .92rem; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.house-count { display: none; }
/* The closing tiles: square panels the size of a tile photograph. */
.closing-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; padding: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.75rem); background: var(--tint); }
.closing-panel h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.3vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.1; }
.closing-panel p { max-width: 22rem; margin: 0; color: var(--muted); }
.closing-panel .button { margin-top: .6rem; }
.closing-panel.dark { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
.closing-panel.dark p { color: rgba(246, 245, 242, .75); }
.closing-panel.dark .button { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--paper); }
.closing-panel.dark .button:hover { border-color: var(--gold); }
/* Phones: banners become a 4:5 photograph with the words below it; tile rows swipe, about 1¼ tiles at a time. */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .houses .house-row { padding-block: 32px; }
  .shop-banner { color: var(--ink); }
  .shop-banner-media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; max-height: none; }
  .shop-banner-media::after { display: none; }
  .shop-banner-text { position: static; padding: 1.75rem 1.25rem 2.5rem; text-shadow: none; }
  .shop-banner .button.outline { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); }
  .house-row { width: 100%; }
  .house-tiles { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding-inline: 16px; scroll-padding-inline: 16px; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: none; }
  .house-tiles::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .house-tile { flex: 0 0 74vw; scroll-snap-align: start; }
  .house-count { display: block; margin: 1.1rem 16px 0; font-size: .8rem; letter-spacing: .12em; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .house-media img { transition: none; }
  .house-tile:hover .house-media img { transform: none; }
}

/* Brand pages (/shop/[slug]): back link, the brand's banner, its blurb, its frames and a closing strip. */
.brand-back { margin: 0 auto; padding-block: 1.25rem 1.5rem; font-size: .9rem; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.brand-intro { padding-block: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem); }
.brand-blurb { max-width: 40rem; margin: 0 auto; font-family: var(--serif); font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 28; font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 2.2vw, 1.9rem); line-height: 1.35; text-align: center; text-wrap: balance; }
.brand-frames { padding-bottom: clamp(4rem, 8vw, 7rem); }
.frame-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2.75rem 1.25rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.brand-empty { max-width: 34rem; margin: 0; padding-top: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); }
@media (max-width: 1024px) { .frame-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .frame-grid { gap: 2.25rem .9rem; }
  .frame-grid .frame-material { font-size: 1.1rem; }
  .frame-grid .frame-placeholder small { font-size: .6rem; letter-spacing: .12em; }
}

/* Phone polish: 44px tap targets and focus rings that are never clipped. */
/* Underlined text links: the padding makes the 44px target and the underline is drawn on the content box, so it
   stays tight under the words. */
.frame-reserve, .house-link, .brand-back .text-link, .collections-more .text-link { display: inline-block; min-height: 44px; padding-block: 10px; background-origin: content-box; background-clip: content-box; }
.frame-reserve { margin-top: 0; }
.brand-back { padding-block: .5rem .75rem; }
.collections-more { margin-top: 1.75rem; }
.site-header .shop-link { min-height: 44px; }
.logo { min-height: 44px; justify-content: center; }
.footer-col { gap: 0; }
.footer-col p { padding-block: .3rem; }
.footer-col a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
.preview-bar a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; margin-block: -12px; }
/* The swipe rows clip their content, so they get room around the cards for the focus ring without moving them. */
.frame-row { padding: 8px; margin: -8px; scroll-padding-inline: 8px; }
.frame-save:focus-visible { outline-offset: -3px; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .frame-row { margin: -8px calc(50% - 50vw); padding: 8px 16px; scroll-padding-inline: 16px; }
  .frame-row:focus-visible { outline-offset: -3px; }
  .house-tiles { padding-block: 8px; margin-block: -8px; }
}
/* On dark panels and over photographs the focus ring is white, as on the hero. */
.closing-panel.dark :focus-visible, .final-cta :focus-visible { outline-color: #fff; }
@media (min-width: 641px) { .shop-banner :focus-visible { outline-color: #fff; } }

/* ---------- Phone header and menu drawer (640px and narrower only) ---------- */
/* Like a fashion house: the menu button on the left, the logo with its mark centred, and an empty slot on the right the
   same width as the menu button so the logo sits in the true centre. Book, Shop Frames, the phone and the location move
   into the drawer; the hero already carries the booking button. Wider screens are unchanged. */
.menu-toggle, .menu-spacer { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .site-header .header-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr 44px; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; }
  .site-header .header-actions { display: none; }
  .menu-spacer { display: block; width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .menu-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; margin-left: -10px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
  .menu-toggle svg { stroke-width: 1.25; }
  .site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .menu-toggle { filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 8px rgba(20, 24, 29, .45)); }
  .site-header .logo { justify-self: center; --word: 1.3rem; }
}
/* The drawer slides in from the left over a dimmed page; tapping the dimmed page, the close button or Escape closes it. */
.menu-drawer { position: fixed; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: min(88vw, 380px); max-width: none; height: 100dvh; max-height: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; }
.menu-drawer[open] { animation: menu-in .42s var(--ease); }
.menu-drawer::backdrop { background: rgba(20, 24, 29, .45); animation: menu-fade .42s ease; }
@keyframes menu-in { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } }
@keyframes menu-fade { from { opacity: 0; } }
html:has(.menu-drawer[open]) { overflow: hidden; }
.menu-panel { min-height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem calc(1.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }
.menu-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr 44px; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding-bottom: 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.menu-head > span { justify-self: center; }
.menu-head .logo { --word: 1.15rem; }
.menu-head .menu-spacer { display: block; }
.menu-close { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; margin-left: -10px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.menu-close svg { stroke-width: 1.25; }
.menu-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding-top: .75rem; }
.menu-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; min-height: 64px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); text-decoration: none; color: inherit; font: 420 1.55rem/1.15 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.menu-nav a svg { flex: none; color: var(--gold-text); }
.menu-contact { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 2.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .35rem; }
.menu-contact .eyebrow { margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.menu-contact-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: .85rem; min-height: 44px; padding-block: .55rem; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.45; }
.menu-contact-row svg { flex: none; margin-top: .15rem; color: var(--gold-text); }
.menu-contact-row small { display: block; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: .1rem; }
.menu-contact-row.pending { color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; }
/* Hover colours only on devices with a pointer, so a tap never leaves a link gold. */
@media (hover: hover) and (max-width: 640px) {
  .menu-toggle:hover, .menu-nav a:hover, a.menu-contact-row:hover { color: var(--gold-text); }
  .site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .menu-toggle:hover { color: #e3d4b1; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .menu-drawer[open], .menu-drawer::backdrop { animation: none; } }
@media (min-width: 641px) { .menu-drawer { display: none; } }
```

## CLAUDE.md

```markdown
@AGENTS.md

## Project rules

- This is Next.js 16. Check node_modules/next/dist/docs before using any Next API.
- Demo mode (NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true) must keep working with no keys. Every live feature needs a demo equivalent in lib/demo.js.
- Database changes go in a new numbered file in supabase/migrations/ (003_, 004_, ...), never by editing schema.sql. Each file starts with a comment saying what it does and that it runs after the previous number.
- The server API (app/api/*) owns all writes. Affiliates must never receive patient contact details, service type, insurance, uploaded documents or any procedure dollar amounts (gross, discount, operation cost, net).
- Placeholder content uses [square brackets], like the existing doctors. Never invent real-looking content.
- Add or update tests in tests/core.test.js for every rule you add. Run npm test and npm run build before finishing. Update the README sitemap and feature list when pages change.
- Commit at the end of each stage with a clear message.
```

## components/affiliate-dashboard.js

```javascript
'use client';
import { Fragment, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { formatDate, money, serviceName, doctorName, statuses } from '@/lib/config';
import { affiliateRows } from '@/lib/demo';
import { completed } from '@/lib/affiliate';
import { performanceTable, affiliatePerformance, topAffiliates, filterAppointments, staffAppointmentRows, STAFF_APPOINTMENT_FIELDS } from '@/lib/performance';
import { csv } from '@/lib/validation';
import { downloadFile } from '@/lib/calendar';
import { Button, Field, Empty, Icon, Notice } from './ui';
import Calculator from './calculator';
import { AffiliateStats, AffiliateTable } from './affiliate-view';

// Staff affiliate performance. Everything here includes procedure amounts and is staff-only; the one exception is
// "Preview as affiliate", which renders the affiliate's restricted rows through the same code the affiliate sees.
const href = a => '/admin/affiliates/' + a.slug;
const amount = v => (v == null ? '—' : money(v));

// A column header that sorts the table. aria-sort tells screen readers which column is sorted and how.
function SortHeader({ label, k, sort, setSort }) {
  const active = sort.key === k;
  return <th scope="col" aria-sort={active ? (sort.dir === 'desc' ? 'descending' : 'ascending') : 'none'}>
    <button type="button" className="sort-button" onClick={() => setSort(s => ({ key: k, dir: s.key === k && s.dir === 'desc' ? 'asc' : 'desc' }))}>{label}<span aria-hidden="true">{active ? (sort.dir === 'desc' ? ' ↓' : ' ↑') : ' ↕'}</span></button>
  </th>;
}

// /admin/affiliates: one row per affiliate (cards on phones), sortable by completed referrals and by commission.
export function AffiliatesTable({ affiliates, bookings, busy, onToggle, onPhoto }) {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState({ key: 'completed', dir: 'desc' });
  if (!affiliates.length) return <Empty text="No affiliates yet." />;
  const rows = performanceTable(affiliates, bookings, sort);
  return <div className="table-wrap performance-table" tabIndex={0} role="region" aria-label="Affiliate performance">
    <table>
      <caption className="sr-only">Affiliate performance. Sorted by {sort.key}, {sort.dir === 'desc' ? 'highest' : 'lowest'} first.</caption>
      <thead><tr>
        <th scope="col">Affiliate</th><th scope="col">Active</th><th scope="col">Bookings</th>
        <SortHeader label="Completed" k="completed" sort={sort} setSort={setSort} />
        <th scope="col">Upcoming</th><th scope="col">Billed</th>
        <SortHeader label="Commission pending" k="pending" sort={sort} setSort={setSort} />
        <SortHeader label="Commission paid" k="paid" sort={sort} setSort={setSort} />
        <th scope="col">Actions</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>{rows.map(p => { const a = p.affiliate; return <tr key={a.id}>
        <td data-label="Affiliate"><Link className="affiliate-name" href={href(a)}><img src={a.photo} alt="" width="40" height="40" /><span><strong>{a.name}</strong><small>{a.commissionRate}% · /book/{a.slug}</small></span></Link></td>
        <td data-label="Active"><span className={'badge ' + (a.active ? 'attended' : 'cancelled')}>{a.active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}</span></td>
        <td data-label="Bookings">{p.total}</td>
        <td data-label="Completed">{p.completed}</td>
        <td data-label="Upcoming">{p.upcoming}</td>
        <td data-label="Billed">{money(p.billed)}</td>
        <td data-label="Commission pending">{money(p.pending)}</td>
        <td data-label="Commission paid">{money(p.paid)}</td>
        <td data-label="Actions"><div className="row-actions">
          <button type="button" className="text-link" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onToggle(a)}>{a.active ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate'}<span className="sr-only"> {a.name}</span></button>
          <label className="text-link upload-inline">Photo<span className="sr-only"> for {a.name}</span><input type="file" className="sr-only" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" disabled={busy} onChange={e => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) onPhoto(f, a); e.target.value = ''; }} /></label>
        </div></td>
      </tr>; })}</tbody>
    </table>
  </div>;
}

// The staff overview strip: who completed the most referrals this month.
export function TopAffiliates({ affiliates, bookings }) {
  const top = topAffiliates(affiliates, bookings);
  return <section className="top-affiliates" aria-labelledby="top-affiliates-title">
    <div className="section-heading"><h2 id="top-affiliates-title">Top affiliates this month</h2><Link className="text-link" href="/admin/affiliates">All affiliates</Link></div>
    {top.length ? <ol>{top.map((p, i) => <li key={p.affiliate.id}><Link href={href(p.affiliate)}>
      <span className="rank" aria-hidden="true">{i + 1}</span><img src={p.affiliate.photo} alt="" width="44" height="44" />
      <span><strong>{p.affiliate.name}</strong><small>{p.completedThisMonth} completed · {money(p.commissionThisMonth)} commission</small></span>
    </Link></li>)}</ol> : <p className="quiet">No completed referrals yet this month.</p>}
  </section>;
}

// /admin/affiliates/[slug]: the affiliate's figures, their appointments with every staff amount, inline commission
// calculators, filters, CSV, and a read-only preview of exactly what the affiliate sees.
export function AffiliateDetail({ affiliate, data, origin, busy, onComplete }) {
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState({ from: '', to: '', status: 'All' });
  const [open, setOpen] = useState('');
  const own = data.bookings.filter(b => b.affiliateId === affiliate.id).sort((x, y) => new Date(y.start) - new Date(x.start));
  const rows = filterAppointments(own, filter), p = affiliatePerformance(affiliate, data.bookings);
  const set = (k, v) => setFilter(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const exportCsv = () => downloadFile(csv(staffAppointmentRows(rows), STAFF_APPOINTMENT_FIELDS), 'eyecon-' + affiliate.slug + '-appointments.csv', 'text/csv');
  const pricing = b => data.procedureCosts?.find(x => x.service === b.service);

  return <div className="affiliate-detail">
    <p><Link className="text-link" href="/admin/affiliates">← All affiliates</Link></p>
    <section className="panel affiliate-hero">
      <img src={affiliate.photo} alt={'Profile photo for ' + affiliate.name} width="72" height="72" />
      <div>
        <h2>{affiliate.name} <span className={'badge ' + (affiliate.active ? 'attended' : 'cancelled')}>{affiliate.active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}</span></h2>
        <p className="quiet">{affiliate.email} · {affiliate.commissionRate}% commission on net · {affiliate.commissionNote || 'No written terms recorded.'}</p>
        <p className="link-value">{origin + '/book/' + affiliate.slug}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="toolbar">
        <Button secondary href={'/book/' + affiliate.slug}>Preview page</Button>
        <Button secondary={!preview} aria-pressed={preview} onClick={() => setPreview(v => !v)}>{preview ? 'Back to staff view' : 'Preview as affiliate'}</Button>
      </div>
    </section>

    {preview ? <section className="affiliate-preview" aria-label={'What ' + affiliate.name + ' sees'}>
      <Notice>Preview: exactly what {affiliate.name} sees in their workspace. Read-only.</Notice>
      <AffiliateStats rows={affiliateRows(data.bookings, affiliate.id)} />
      <div className="section-heading"><h2>Referrals</h2></div>
      <AffiliateTable items={affiliateRows(data.bookings, affiliate.id)} title="Referrals (preview)" />
      <div className="section-heading"><h2>Earnings</h2></div>
      <AffiliateTable items={affiliateRows(data.bookings, affiliate.id).filter(completed)} earnings title="Earnings (preview)" />
    </section> : <>
      <div className="stats stats-six">{[['Bookings', p.total], ['Completed', p.completed], ['Upcoming', p.upcoming], ['Billed', money(p.billed)], ['Commission pending', money(p.pending)], ['Commission paid', money(p.paid)]].map(([label, value]) => <article key={label}><p>{label}</p><strong>{value}</strong></article>)}</div>
      <div className="filters">
        <Field label="From" id="appt-from" type="date" value={filter.from} onChange={e => set('from', e.target.value)} />
        <Field label="To" id="appt-to" type="date" value={filter.to} onChange={e => set('to', e.target.value)} />
        <Field label="Status" id="appt-status"><select id="appt-status" value={filter.status} onChange={e => set('status', e.target.value)}>{['All', ...statuses].map(s => <option key={s}>{s}</option>)}</select></Field>
        <button type="button" className="text-link" onClick={() => setFilter({ from: '', to: '', status: 'All' })}>Clear</button>
        <Button secondary onClick={exportCsv} disabled={!rows.length}>Export CSV</Button>
      </div>
      {rows.length ? <div className="table-wrap appointments-table" tabIndex={0} role="region" aria-label={affiliate.name + ' appointments'}>
        <table>
          <caption className="sr-only">Appointments referred by {affiliate.name}</caption>
          <thead><tr>{['Patient', 'Date', 'Doctor', 'Service', 'Source', 'Status', 'Gross', 'Discount', 'Operation cost', 'Net', 'Commission', 'Payout', ''].map((h, i) => <th scope="col" key={i}>{h || <span className="sr-only">Calculator</span>}</th>)}</tr></thead>
          <tbody>{rows.map(b => { const canCalc = b.status === 'Attended' && b.payout !== 'Paid'; return <Fragment key={b.id}>
            <tr>
              <td data-label="Patient"><strong>{b.name}</strong>{b.reference && <small>{b.reference}</small>}</td>
              <td data-label="Date">{formatDate(b.start)}</td>
              <td data-label="Doctor">{doctorName(b.doctor) || '—'}</td>
              <td data-label="Service">{serviceName(b.service)}</td>
              <td data-label="Source">{b.source}</td>
              <td data-label="Status"><span className={'badge ' + b.status.toLowerCase()}>{b.status}</span></td>
              <td data-label="Gross">{amount(b.grossAmount)}</td>
              <td data-label="Discount">{amount(b.discountAmount)}</td>
              <td data-label="Operation cost">{amount(b.operationCost)}</td>
              <td data-label="Net">{amount(b.netAmount)}</td>
              <td data-label="Commission">{completed(b) ? money(b.commission) : '—'}</td>
              <td data-label="Payout"><span className="badge">{b.payout}</span>{b.paidAt && <small>{formatDate(b.paidAt, { timeStyle: undefined })}</small>}</td>
              <td data-label="Calculator">{canCalc && <button type="button" className="text-link" aria-expanded={open === b.id} aria-controls={'calc-row-' + b.id} onClick={() => setOpen(o => o === b.id ? '' : b.id)}>{open === b.id ? 'Close' : b.grossAmount == null ? 'Calculate' : 'Edit'}<span className="sr-only"> commission for {b.name}</span></button>}{b.payout === 'Paid' && completed(b) && <span className="quiet"><Icon name="check" size={14} /> Locked</span>}</td>
            </tr>
            {canCalc && open === b.id && <tr className="calc-row" id={'calc-row-' + b.id}><td colSpan={13}>
              <Calculator booking={b} affiliate={affiliate} pricing={pricing(b)} busy={busy} onSave={async payload => { if (await onComplete(payload) !== false) setOpen(''); }} />
            </td></tr>}
          </Fragment>; })}</tbody>
        </table>
      </div> : <Empty />}
      <p className="quiet">Billed is gross minus discount on completed referrals. Times in the clinic’s timezone.</p>
    </>}
  </div>;
}
```

```javascript
'use client';
import { formatDate, money } from '@/lib/config';
import { completed, affiliateStats } from '@/lib/affiliate';
import { Empty } from './ui';

// The affiliate's overview figures. Upcoming bookings are a count only and never add to the completed figures.
export function AffiliateStats({ rows }) {
  const st = affiliateStats(rows);
  return <div className="stats">{[['Completed referrals', st.completedThisMonth, 'This month · ' + st.completedAllTime + ' all time'], ['Upcoming bookings', st.upcoming, 'Counts once completed'], ['Commission earned', money(st.earned), 'From completed referrals'], ['Paid', money(st.paid), st.awaitingPayment > 0 ? money(st.awaitingPayment) + ' awaiting payment' : 'Nothing awaiting payment']].map(([label, value, note]) => <article key={label}><p>{label}</p><strong>{value}</strong><small>{note}</small></article>)}</div>;
}
// An affiliate's referrals: patient, appointment date, status and their commission (blank until completed). The
// earnings view lists completed referrals with payout status instead of the status column. Nothing else is shown.
export function AffiliateTable({items,earnings,title}){return items.length?<div className="table-wrap" tabIndex={0} role="region" aria-label={title+' table'}><table><caption className="sr-only">{title}</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Patient</th><th scope="col">Appointment</th>{!earnings&&<th scope="col">Status</th>}<th scope="col">Your commission</th>{earnings&&<th scope="col">Payout</th>}</tr></thead><tbody>{items.map(b=><tr key={b.id}><td><strong>{b.name}</strong></td><td>{formatDate(b.start)}</td>{!earnings&&<td><span className={'badge '+b.status.toLowerCase()}>{b.status}</span></td>}<td>{completed(b)?money(b.commission):<span className="quiet" aria-label="Not yet completed">—</span>}</td>{earnings&&<td><span className="badge">{b.payout}</span>{b.paidAt&&<small>{formatDate(b.paidAt,{timeStyle:undefined})}</small>}</td>}</tr>)}</tbody></table></div>:<Empty text={earnings?'No completed referrals yet.':undefined}/>;}
```
