## components/booking-flow.js

```javascript
'use client';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useApp } from './provider';
import DocumentsForm from './documents-form';
import Captcha from './captcha';
import CalendarCard from './calendar-card';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { DEMO, clinic, services, brands, brandFromParam, doctors, doctorName, findDoctor, formatDate, instructions, serviceOptions, serviceOptionName } from '@/lib/config';
import SkinTechnologies from './skin-technologies';
import { BookingReviews } from './reviews';
import { validateBooking, slotTaken } from '@/lib/validation';
import { Header, Footer, Button, Field, Gift, Icon, Notice, Loading, Referral } from './ui';

// Optometrist cards: photo, name and focus. With counts, each card says how many online times they have and
// a card with none cannot be chosen.
function DoctorChoices({ name, label, list, value, counts, onChange }) {
  return <div className="doctor-choices" role="radiogroup" aria-label={label}>
    {list.map(d => {
      const open = counts?.[d.slug], none = counts && !open;
      return <label key={d.slug} className={`doctor-choice ${value === d.slug ? 'selected' : ''} ${none ? 'unavailable' : ''}`}>
        <input type="radio" name={name} value={d.slug} checked={value === d.slug} disabled={none} onChange={() => onChange(d.slug)} />
        <Image src={d.photo} alt={d.alt || ''} width={64} height={80} sizes="64px" />
        <span><strong>{doctorName(d.slug)}</strong><small>{d.focus}</small>{counts && <small className="doctor-choice-open">{none ? 'No online times' : `${open} open time${open === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}</small>}</span>
      </label>;
    })}
  </div>;
}

const LABELS = ['Appointment', 'Date and time', 'Your details', 'Confirmed'];
const TITLES = ['What would you like to book?', 'When works for you?', 'Your details', 'You’re booked'];
// Date ranges in days from today. "This week" ends on Sunday so it matches how people say it.
function ranges() {
  const now = new Date(), toSunday = 7 - ((now.getDay() + 6) % 7 + 1) + 1;
  return [
    { label: 'This week', from: 0, to: toSunday },
    { label: 'Next week', from: toSunday, to: toSunday + 7 },
    { label: 'In 2–3 weeks', from: toSunday + 7, to: toSunday + 21 },
    { label: 'Later', from: toSunday + 21, to: Infinity }
  ];
}

export default function BookingFlow() {
  const params = useSearchParams(), slug = params.get('affiliate'), { data, ready, book } = useApp();
  const [affiliate, setAffiliate] = useState(null);
  const [slots, setSlots] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [service, setService] = useState(params.get('service') || '');
  // An optional choice within the service, such as the skin tightening technology. One passed in the link (from a
  // technology card on the home page) arrives already chosen; unknown slugs are ignored.
  const [serviceOption, setServiceOption] = useState(() => serviceOptions[params.get('service')]?.find(o => o.slug === params.get('option'))?.slug || '');
  const [day, setDay] = useState('');
  const [start, setStart] = useState('');
  const [range, setRange] = useState(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [confirmation, setConfirmation] = useState(null);
  const [captcha, setCaptcha] = useState('');
  const [captchaKey, setCaptchaKey] = useState(0);
  // A brand passed in the link (from the collections carousel) arrives already chosen; unknown names are ignored.
  const linkedBrand = brandFromParam(params.get('brand'));
  const [details, setDetails] = useState({ name: '', email: '', phone: '', firstVisit: '', insurance: '', policy: '', brands: linkedBrand ? [linkedBrand] : [], smsConsent: false, website: '' });
  // Every appointment is with one optometrist. Patients either pick the optometrist first ("doctor" mode) or the time
  // first ("time" mode). An optometrist passed in the link (from their card on the home page) opens doctor mode with
  // them already chosen; unknown slugs are ignored.
  const linkedDoctor = findDoctor(params.get('doctor'))?.slug || '';
  const [mode, setMode] = useState(linkedDoctor ? 'doctor' : 'time');
  const [doctor, setDoctor] = useState(linkedDoctor);
  const titleRef = useRef(null), firstRender = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (DEMO) {
      if (!ready) return;
      const a = slug ? data.affiliates.find(a => a.slug === slug && a.active) : null;
      if (slug && !a) { setLoadError('This referral is unavailable. You can book directly instead.'); setLoading(false); return; }
      setAffiliate(a);
      setSlots(data.slots.filter(s => new Date(s.start) > new Date() && findDoctor(s.doctor) && !slotTaken(s, data.bookings)));
      setLoading(false);
    } else {
      fetch('/api/availability' + (slug ? '?affiliate=' + encodeURIComponent(slug) : ''))
        .then(async r => { const d = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d.error); setAffiliate(d.affiliate); setSlots(d.slots.filter(s => findDoctor(s.doctor))); })
        .catch(e => setLoadError(e.message)).finally(() => setLoading(false));
    }
  }, [ready, slug, data]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (firstRender.current) { firstRender.current = false; return; }
    titleRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [step]);

  const dayKey = iso => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: clinic.timezone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).format(new Date(iso));
  // The times on offer: one optometrist's in doctor mode, everyone's in time mode.
  const pool = useMemo(() => mode === 'doctor' ? slots.filter(s => s.doctor === doctor) : slots, [slots, mode, doctor]);
  const openCount = useMemo(() => Object.fromEntries(doctors.map(d => [d.slug, slots.filter(s => s.doctor === d.slug).length])), [slots]);
  const days = useMemo(() => [...new Map(pool.map(s => [dayKey(s.start), s.start])).entries()], [pool]);
  // Each start time on the chosen day, with the optometrists free at that moment.
  const times = useMemo(() => { const m = new Map(); for (const s of pool) if (dayKey(s.start) === day) m.set(s.start, [...(m.get(s.start) || []), s.doctor]); return [...m.entries()]; }, [pool, day]);
  const freeAtStart = times.find(([iso]) => iso === start)?.[1] || [];
  const rangeList = useMemo(ranges, []);
  const today = new Date(); today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const inRange = (iso, r) => { const d = (new Date(iso) - today) / 86400000; return d >= r.from && d < r.to; };
  const visibleDays = days.filter(([, iso]) => inRange(iso, rangeList[range]));
  const chosenService = services.find(s => s.id === service);
  const chosen = !!(start && doctor && slots.some(s => s.doctor === doctor && s.start === start));

  // Open on the first range that has times, so nobody lands on an empty week.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pool.length || step !== 1 || visibleDays.length) return;
    const first = rangeList.findIndex(r => days.some(([, iso]) => inRange(iso, r)));
    if (first > -1 && first !== range) setRange(first);
  }, [step, pool.length, mode, doctor]);

  function change(key, value) { setDetails(d => ({ ...d, [key]: value })); }
  function toggleBrand(b) { setDetails(d => ({ ...d, brands: d.brands.includes(b) ? d.brands.filter(x => x !== b) : [...d.brands, b] })); }
  // In time mode the optometrist follows from the time, so clearing the time clears them too.
  function clearTime(nextDay = '') { setDay(nextDay); setStart(''); if (mode === 'time') setDoctor(''); }
  function switchMode(m) { if (m === mode) return; setError(''); setMode(m); setDay(''); setStart(''); if (m === 'time') setDoctor(''); }
  function pickDoctor(slug) { setError(''); setDoctor(slug); setDay(''); setStart(''); }
  function pickTime(iso, free) { setError(''); setStart(iso); if (mode === 'time') setDoctor(free.length === 1 ? free[0] : ''); }
  function next() {
    setError('');
    if (step === 0 && !chosenService) { setError('Choose the care you need.'); return; }
    if (step === 1 && !chosen) { setError(start && !doctor ? 'Choose which optometrist you would like to see.' : 'Choose an optometrist and an available time.'); return; }
    setStep(s => s + 1);
  }
  function back(to) { setError(''); setStep(to); }
  async function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault(); setError(''); setBusy(true);
    try {
      const payload = validateBooking({ ...details, brands: details.brands.join(', '), firstVisit: details.firstVisit === 'yes' ? true : details.firstVisit === 'no' ? false : null, service, serviceOption, start, doctor, affiliateId: affiliate?.id });
      if (!DEMO && !captcha) throw new Error('Complete the verification before booking.');
      const result = await book({ ...payload, captcha, website: details.website });
      setConfirmation(result); setStep(3);
    } catch (e) { setError(e.message); setCaptcha(''); setCaptchaKey(k => k + 1); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  if (loading) return <Loading />;
  if (loadError) return <><Header /><main className="container empty-page" id="main-content"><h1>Arrange your visit</h1><Notice error>{loadError}</Notice>{slug ? <Button href="/booking">Book directly</Button> : <Button onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>Try again</Button>}</main><Footer /></>;

  const optionName = serviceOptionName(service, serviceOption);
  const summary = (action = null) => <div className="selection-summary"><Icon name="calendar" /><div><strong>{chosenService?.name}{optionName && <> · {optionName}</>}</strong><small>With {doctorName(doctor)}</small><small>{formatDate(start, { dateStyle: 'full', timeStyle: 'short' })}</small></div>{action}</div>;
  const timeText = iso => formatDate(iso, { dateStyle: undefined, timeStyle: 'short' });
  const shortName = slug => { const d = findDoctor(slug); return d ? `${d.title} ${d.last}` : ''; };
  return <>
    <Header bookingHref={affiliate ? '/book/' + affiliate.slug : '/'} bookingLabel="Back to Eyecon" bookingShort="Back" />
    <main className="booking-shell" id="main-content">
      <aside className="booking-aside">
        <h1>A little time, a clearer view.</h1>
        <p>Choose your appointment and a time that suits you. It takes about a minute.</p>
        {affiliate && <><Referral affiliate={affiliate} />{step < 3 && <Gift compact affiliate={affiliate} />}</>}
        <div className="booking-help">
          <Icon name="phone" />
          <h3>Prefer to talk to us?</h3>
          {clinic.phone ? <a href={clinic.phoneHref}>{clinic.phone}</a> : <p>The clinic phone number will be added before launch.</p>}
        </div>
        <BookingReviews />
      </aside>

      <section className="booking-panel">
        {affiliate && <p className="booking-ref"><img src={affiliate.photo || '/images/affiliate.webp'} alt="" width="32" height="32" /><span>Booking through <strong>{affiliate.name}</strong>{step < 3 && <>, with a $50 gift card</>}</span></p>}
        <div className="progress" aria-label={`Step ${step + 1} of 4: ${LABELS[step]}`}>
          <div className="progress-track"><div className="progress-fill" style={{ width: ((step + 1) / 4) * 100 + '%' }} /></div>
          <ol className="stepper" aria-hidden="true">{LABELS.map((l, i) => <li key={l} className={i < step ? 'done' : ''} aria-current={i === step ? 'step' : undefined}><span className="num">{i + 1}</span>{l}</li>)}</ol>
        </div>
        <h2 ref={titleRef} tabIndex={-1}>{TITLES[step]}</h2>
        <Notice error>{error}</Notice>

        {step === 0 && <div className="step" key="s0">
          <div className="service-choices" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Appointment type">
            {services.map(s => <label key={s.id} className={`service-choice ${service === s.id ? 'selected' : ''}`}>
              <input type="radio" name="service" value={s.id} checked={service === s.id} onChange={() => { setService(s.id); if (!serviceOptions[s.id]) setServiceOption(''); }} />
              <Icon name={s.icon} />
              <span><strong>{s.name}</strong><small>{s.description}</small></span>
            </label>)}
          </div>
          {service === 'skin-tightening' && <SkinTechnologies value={serviceOption} onChange={setServiceOption} />}
          <p className="urgent-note">Urgent eye concern? {clinic.phone ? <a href={clinic.phoneHref}>Call the clinic</a> : 'Please call the clinic for guidance.'}</p>
          <div className="form-actions"><Button onClick={next} disabled={!chosenService}>Continue</Button></div>
        </div>}

        {step === 1 && <div className="step" key="s1">
          <p className="muted">{chosenService?.name}</p>
          <div className="mode-toggle" role="group" aria-label="How would you like to choose?">
            {[['doctor', 'Choose a doctor'], ['time', 'Choose a time']].map(([m, label]) => <button type="button" key={m} className={mode === m ? 'active' : ''} aria-pressed={mode === m} onClick={() => switchMode(m)}>{label}</button>)}
          </div>
          {!slots.length ? <Notice>No online times are available right now. Please call the clinic or check back later.</Notice> : <>
            {mode === 'doctor' && <>
              <p className="time-label">Your optometrist</p>
              <DoctorChoices name="doctor" label="Optometrist" list={doctors} value={doctor} counts={openCount} onChange={pickDoctor} />
              {!doctor && <p className="quiet">Pick an optometrist to see the days they are available.</p>}
            </>}
            {(mode === 'time' || doctor) && (pool.length ? <>
              <div className="week-tabs" role="group" aria-label="When">
                {rangeList.map((r, i) => <button type="button" key={r.label} className={range === i ? 'active' : ''} aria-pressed={range === i} onClick={() => { setRange(i); clearTime(); }}>{r.label}</button>)}
              </div>
              {visibleDays.length
                ? <div className="day-grid" role="group" aria-label={mode === 'doctor' ? 'Days ' + doctorName(doctor) + ' is available' : 'Available days'}>
                    {visibleDays.map(([key, iso]) => <button type="button" key={key} className={day === key ? 'active' : ''} aria-pressed={day === key} onClick={() => clearTime(key)}>
                      <small>{formatDate(iso, { dateStyle: undefined, timeStyle: undefined, weekday: 'short' })}</small>
                      <span>{formatDate(iso, { dateStyle: undefined, timeStyle: undefined, day: 'numeric' })}</span>
                      <small>{formatDate(iso, { dateStyle: undefined, timeStyle: undefined, month: 'short' })}</small>
                    </button>)}
                  </div>
                : <p className="empty-range">No open times in this range. Try another.</p>}
              {day && <>
                <p className="time-label">Available times</p>
                <div className={`time-grid ${mode === 'time' ? 'with-doctors' : ''}`} role="group" aria-label="Available times" key={mode + day}>
                  {times.map(([iso, free], i) => {
                    const names = free.map(doctorName).join(' and ');
                    return <button type="button" key={iso} style={{ animationDelay: i * 30 + 'ms' }} aria-pressed={start === iso} className={start === iso ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => pickTime(iso, free)}
                      aria-label={mode === 'time' ? `${timeText(iso)}, with ${names}` : undefined} title={mode === 'time' ? names : undefined}>
                      {timeText(iso)}
                      {mode === 'time' && <span className="time-doctors" aria-hidden="true">
                        <span className="time-avatars">{free.map(slug => <Image key={slug} src={findDoctor(slug).photo} alt="" width={20} height={20} sizes="20px" />)}</span>
                        <small>{free.map(shortName).join(' · ')}</small>
                      </span>}
                    </button>;
                  })}
                </div>
              </>}
              {!day && visibleDays.length > 0 && <p className="quiet">Pick a day to see the times.</p>}
              {mode === 'time' && start && freeAtStart.length > 1 && <div className="doctor-pick">
                <p className="time-label">Who would you like to see? {freeAtStart.length} optometrists are free at {timeText(start)}</p>
                <DoctorChoices name="doctor-at-time" label={'Optometrist at ' + timeText(start)} list={doctors.filter(d => freeAtStart.includes(d.slug))} value={doctor} onChange={slug => { setError(''); setDoctor(slug); }} />
              </div>}
              {chosen && summary()}
            </> : <p className="empty-range">{doctorName(doctor)} has no online times right now. Choose another optometrist, or switch to “Choose a time”.</p>)}
          </>}
          <div className="form-actions"><Button secondary onClick={() => back(0)}>Back</Button><Button onClick={next} disabled={!chosen}>Continue</Button></div>
        </div>}

        {step === 2 && <form onSubmit={submit} className="stack step" key="s2">
          {summary(<button type="button" className="text-link" onClick={() => back(1)}>Change</button>)}
          <Field label="Full name" id="patient-name" autoComplete="name" required maxLength={120} value={details.name} onChange={e => change('name', e.target.value)} />
          <div className="form-grid">
            <Field label="Mobile number" id="patient-phone" type="tel" autoComplete="tel" required maxLength={32} placeholder="+1 416 555 0123" value={details.phone} onChange={e => change('phone', e.target.value)} />
            <Field label="Email address" id="patient-email" type="email" autoComplete="email" required value={details.email} onChange={e => change('email', e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <fieldset className="choice-field"><legend>Is this your first visit to Eyecon?</legend>
            {['yes', 'no'].map(v => <label key={v}><input type="radio" name="first-visit" required checked={details.firstVisit === v} onChange={() => change('firstVisit', v)} />{v === 'yes' ? 'Yes, first visit' : 'I’ve been before'}</label>)}
          </fieldset>
          <details className="optional-fields"><summary>Insurance details <small>Optional</small></summary>
            <div className="stack">
              <Field label="Insurance company" id="insurance" value={details.insurance} maxLength={120} onChange={e => change('insurance', e.target.value)} list={clinic.insurers.length ? 'insurer-options' : undefined} />
              {clinic.insurers.length > 0 && <datalist id="insurer-options">{clinic.insurers.map(i => <option key={i} value={i} />)}</datalist>}
              <Field label="Policy number" id="policy" value={details.policy} maxLength={120} onChange={e => change('policy', e.target.value)} hint="Only clinic staff can see this. You can bring your insurance card instead." />
            </div>
          </details>
          <details className="optional-fields" open><summary>Designers you love <small>Optional</small></summary>
            <div className="brand-chips" role="group" aria-label="Favourite designers">
              {brands.map(b => <button type="button" key={b} aria-pressed={details.brands.includes(b)} onClick={() => toggleBrand(b)}>{details.brands.includes(b) && <Icon name="check" size={14} />}{b}</button>)}
            </div>
            <p className="quiet" style={{ marginTop: '.8rem' }}>We’ll have these ready for you to try.</p>
          </details>
          <label className="checkbox-label"><input type="checkbox" checked={details.smsConsent} onChange={e => change('smsConsent', e.target.checked)} /><span>Text me appointment reminders{affiliate ? ' and my gift card details' : ''}.<small>Optional. Message and data rates may apply. Contact the clinic to stop.</small></span></label>
          <p className="privacy-note">{affiliate ? `${affiliate.name} can see your name and booking status. Your appointment type and insurance stay with the clinic. ` : ''}Read our <Link href="/privacy">privacy notice</Link>.</p>
          <div className="honeypot" aria-hidden="true"><label htmlFor="website">Leave this blank</label><input id="website" value={details.website} onChange={e => change('website', e.target.value)} tabIndex={-1} autoComplete="off" /></div>
          {!DEMO && <Captcha key={captchaKey} action="booking" onToken={setCaptcha} />}
          <div className="form-actions"><Button type="button" secondary onClick={() => back(1)}>Back</Button><Button disabled={busy} type="submit">{busy ? 'Booking…' : 'Confirm booking'}</Button></div>
        </form>}

        {step === 3 && confirmation && <div className="confirmation step" key="s3">
          <div className="success-mark"><Icon name="check" size={34} /></div>
          <p className="confirmation-lead">We look forward to seeing you, {confirmation.booking.name.split(' ')[0]}.</p>
          <div className="confirmation-card">
            <h3>{services.find(s => s.id === confirmation.booking.service)?.name}</h3>
            {serviceOptionName(confirmation.booking.service, confirmation.booking.serviceOption) && <p>{serviceOptionName(confirmation.booking.service, confirmation.booking.serviceOption)}</p>}
            <p className="ref">Reference<strong>{confirmation.booking.reference}</strong></p>
            <p>With {doctorName(confirmation.booking.doctor)}</p>
            <p>{formatDate(confirmation.booking.start, { dateStyle: 'full', timeStyle: 'short' })}</p>
            <p className="muted">{clinic.address || 'The clinic will confirm the location with you.'}</p>
          </div>

          <DocumentsForm token={confirmation.booking.documentsToken} canSkip />

          <CalendarCard booking={confirmation.booking} />

          {affiliate && <Gift affiliate={affiliate} card={confirmation.booking.giftCard} />}
          <h3 className="plain">Before your visit</h3>
          <ul className="check-list">{instructions.map(t => <li key={t}><Icon name="check" size={18} />{t}</li>)}</ul>
          <Notice>{DEMO ? 'Demo booking saved in this browser. No email or SMS was sent.' : confirmation.notifications?.email === 'sent' ? 'Your confirmation email is on its way. Check your inbox.' : 'Your booking is saved. Keep your reference and add it to your calendar above.'}</Notice>
          <Button secondary href={affiliate ? '/book/' + affiliate.slug : '/'}>Return to Eyecon</Button>
        </div>}
      </section>
    </main>
    <Footer />
  </>;
}
```

## components/booking-lookup.js

```javascript
'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useApp } from './provider';
import Captcha from './captcha';
import CalendarCard from './calendar-card';
import { DEMO, clinic, formatDate } from '@/lib/config';
import { Header, Footer, Button, Field, Icon, Notice, Loading } from './ui';

// /my-booking: patients without an account find their booking with its reference and the email they booked with.
// The result is the limited view from lib/lookup.js; changes go through the clinic by phone.
export default function BookingLookup() {
  const { ready, lookupBooking } = useApp();
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ reference: '', email: '', website: '' });
  const [captcha, setCaptcha] = useState(''), [captchaKey, setCaptchaKey] = useState(0);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false), [error, setError] = useState(''), [booking, setBooking] = useState(null);
  const change = (key, value) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [key]: value }));

  async function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault(); setError(''); setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (!DEMO && !captcha) throw new Error('Complete the verification first.');
      const result = await lookupBooking({ ...form, captcha });
      setBooking(result.booking);
    } catch (err) { setError(err.message); }
    finally { setBusy(false); setCaptcha(''); setCaptchaKey(k => k + 1); }
  }

  if (!ready) return <Loading />;
  const upcoming = booking && booking.status === 'Booked' && new Date(booking.start) > new Date();
  const call = clinic.phone ? <a href={clinic.phoneHref}>{clinic.phone}</a> : 'the clinic';
  return <>
    <Header />
    <main className="container lookup-page" id="main-content">
      <p className="eyebrow">YOUR APPOINTMENT</p>
      <h1>Find my booking</h1>
      {!booking ? <>
        <p className="muted">Enter the booking reference from your confirmation and the email address you booked with.</p>
        {DEMO && <p className="demo-label">Demo: this searches the sample bookings saved in this browser. Try reference 7K2M9QXB with sample1@example.com.</p>}
        <Notice error>{error}</Notice>
        <form className="stack lookup-form" onSubmit={submit}>
          <Field label="Booking reference" id="lookup-reference" required maxLength={12} autoComplete="off" autoCapitalize="characters" spellCheck={false} placeholder="7K2M9QXB" value={form.reference} onChange={e => change('reference', e.target.value)} hint="8 letters and numbers, in your confirmation email." />
          <Field label="Email address" id="lookup-email" type="email" autoComplete="email" required value={form.email} onChange={e => change('email', e.target.value)} />
          <div className="honeypot" aria-hidden="true"><label htmlFor="lookup-website">Leave this blank</label><input id="lookup-website" value={form.website} onChange={e => change('website', e.target.value)} tabIndex={-1} autoComplete="off" /></div>
          {!DEMO && <Captcha key={captchaKey} action="lookup" onToken={setCaptcha} />}
          <div className="form-actions"><Button type="submit" disabled={busy}>{busy ? 'Finding…' : 'Find my booking'}</Button></div>
        </form>
      </> : <div className="lookup-result">
        <div className="confirmation-card">
          <h3>{booking.serviceName}</h3>
          <p className="ref">Reference<strong>{booking.reference}</strong></p>
          {booking.doctorName && <p>With {booking.doctorName}</p>}
          <p>{formatDate(booking.start, { dateStyle: 'full', timeStyle: 'short' })} · {booking.duration} min</p>
          <p className="muted">{booking.clinicAddress || 'The clinic will confirm the location with you.'}</p>
          {booking.status !== 'Booked' && <p><span className={'badge ' + booking.status.toLowerCase()}>{booking.status}</span></p>}
        </div>
        {booking.giftCardNumber && <p className="lookup-line"><Icon name="gift" size={20} /><span>Gift card number <strong>{booking.giftCardNumber}</strong>. Please bring it to your visit.</span></p>}
        {booking.fileComplete
          ? <p className="lookup-line"><Icon name="check" size={20} /><span>Your file is complete.</span></p>
          : booking.documentsToken && <p className="lookup-line"><Icon name="scan" size={20} /><span>Your file is missing a government ID. <Link href={'/documents#t=' + booking.documentsToken}>Complete your file</Link></span></p>}
        {upcoming && <CalendarCard booking={booking} text="One tap, so you won’t miss it." />}
        <p className="lookup-line"><Icon name="phone" size={20} /><span>To change or cancel this appointment, please call {call}.</span></p>
        <Button secondary onClick={() => { setBooking(null); setForm({ reference: '', email: '', website: '' }); }}>Find another booking</Button>
      </div>}
    </main>
    <Footer />
  </>;
}
```

```javascript
'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field } from './ui';
import { money } from '@/lib/config';
import { validateCompletion, calculateCommission } from '@/lib/commission';

// The commission calculator for an attended booking. Staff type the amount billed (prefilled from the procedure's
// retail price) and any discount; operation cost and rate are read-only; net and commission update as they type.
// Only gross and discount are sent: the server recalculates everything. A paid booking is shown but locked.
export default function Calculator({booking,affiliate,pricing,busy,onSave}){
  const cost=booking.operationCost??pricing?.operationCost??0,hasAffiliate=!!booking.affiliateId,rate=hasAffiliate?(booking.commissionRate??affiliate?.commissionRate??0):0,locked=booking.payout==='Paid';
  const [gross,setGross]=useState(String(booking.grossAmount??pricing?.retailPrice??0)),[discount,setDiscount]=useState(String(booking.discountAmount??0));
  let calc=null,problem='';try{calc=calculateCommission({...validateCompletion({gross,discount}),operationCost:cost,rate,hasAffiliate});}catch(e){problem=e.message;}
  const id=k=>'calc-'+k+'-'+booking.id;
  return <form className="calculator" onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault();if(!problem&&!locked)onSave({id:booking.id,gross,discount});}}>
    <h3>Commission{locked&&<span className="badge">Paid · locked</span>}</h3>
    <div className="calc-grid">
      <Field label="Gross (billed before discount)" id={id('gross')} type="number" inputMode="decimal" min="0" max="1000000" step="0.01" required value={gross} disabled={locked} onChange={e=>setGross(e.target.value)} hint={booking.grossAmount==null&&pricing?'Prefilled from the retail price.':undefined}/>
      <Field label="Discount" id={id('discount')} type="number" inputMode="decimal" min="0" max="1000000" step="0.01" value={discount} disabled={locked} onChange={e=>setDiscount(e.target.value)}/>
      <div className="calc-output"><span>Operation cost</span><output>{money(cost)}</output></div>
      <div className="calc-output"><span>Net</span><output htmlFor={id('gross')+' '+id('discount')}>{calc?money(calc.net):'—'}</output></div>
      <div className="calc-output"><span>Rate</span><output>{hasAffiliate?rate+'%':'No affiliate'}</output></div>
      <div className="calc-output total"><span>Commission</span><output aria-live="polite" htmlFor={id('gross')+' '+id('discount')}>{calc?money(calc.commission):'—'}</output></div>
    </div>
    {problem&&<p className="error-text" role="alert">{problem}</p>}
    {!locked&&<Button disabled={busy||!!problem}>Save</Button>}
  </form>;
}
```

## components/calendar-card.js

```javascript
'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { calendarFile, googleCalendar, outlookCalendar, downloadFile } from '@/lib/calendar';
import { Icon } from './ui';

const NAMES = { google: 'Google Calendar', apple: 'Apple Calendar', outlook: 'Outlook' };
// Pick the calendar that this device most likely uses for the one-tap button.
function preferredCalendar() {
  if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return 'google';
  const ua = navigator.userAgent;
  if (/iPhone|iPad|Macintosh/.test(ua)) return 'apple';
  if (/Windows/.test(ua)) return 'outlook';
  return 'google';
}
// "Add it to your calendar", used on the confirmation step and on /my-booking.
export default function CalendarCard({ booking, text = 'One tap, so you won’t miss it. Your confirmation email has the invite too.' }) {
  const [calendar, setCalendar] = useState('google'), [added, setAdded] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => { setCalendar(preferredCalendar()); }, []);
  function addTo(kind) {
    if (kind === 'apple') downloadFile(calendarFile(booking), 'eyecon-appointment.ics', 'text/calendar');
    else window.open(kind === 'google' ? googleCalendar(booking) : outlookCalendar(booking), '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    setAdded(kind);
  }
  return <div className="calendar-card">
    <h3>Add it to your calendar</h3>
    <p>{text}</p>
    <div className="calendar-actions">
      <button type="button" className="button primary" onClick={() => addTo(calendar)}><Icon name="calendar" size={20} />Add to {NAMES[calendar]}</button>
      {['google', 'apple', 'outlook'].filter(k => k !== calendar).map(k => <button type="button" key={k} className="button" onClick={() => addTo(k)}>{NAMES[k]}</button>)}
    </div>
    {added && <p className="calendar-added" role="status"><Icon name="check" size={18} />Opened in {NAMES[added]}. Save it there to finish.</p>}
  </div>;
}
```

## components/captcha.js

```javascript
'use client';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Script from 'next/script';

// Cloudflare Turnstile. action names the form ('booking' or 'lookup'); the server checks it matches.
export default function Captcha({ action, onToken }) {
  const el = useRef(null), [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loaded || !el.current || !window.turnstile) return;
    const id = window.turnstile.render(el.current, { sitekey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY, action, callback: onToken, 'expired-callback': () => onToken('') });
    return () => window.turnstile?.remove(id);
  }, [loaded]);
  return <><Script src="https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js?render=explicit" onReady={() => setLoaded(true)} /><div ref={el} /></>;
}
```

## components/documents-form.js

```javascript
'use client';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useApp } from './provider';
import { DEMO, residencyStatuses, documentKinds, DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES, DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES, fileSize, documentsLink } from '@/lib/config';
import { validateDocuments } from '@/lib/validation';
import { Button, Field, Icon, Notice } from './ui';

const ACCEPT = '.pdf,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,application/pdf,image/jpeg,image/png';
const extraKinds = documentKinds.filter(k => k.id !== 'government-id');

// "Complete your file": residency status, one government ID and optional tagged documents, sent once with the
// single-use token issued with the booking. canSkip shows "Skip for now" (on the confirmation step); the
// /documents page, reached from the confirmation email, has no skip.
export default function DocumentsForm({ token, canSkip = false }) {
  const { submitDocuments, documentsLinkValid } = useApp();
  const [valid, setValid] = useState(null);
  const [state, setState] = useState('form');
  const [residency, setResidency] = useState('');
  const [id, setId] = useState(null);
  const [extras, setExtras] = useState([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const idInput = useRef(null), extraInput = useRef(null), heading = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => { if (!token) { setValid(false); return; } documentsLinkValid(token).then(setValid).catch(() => setValid(false)); }, [token]);
  useEffect(() => { if (state !== 'form') heading.current?.focus(); }, [state]);

  const total = (id ? 1 : 0) + extras.length;
  function addExtras(list) {
    setError('');
    const room = DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES - total, added = [...list].slice(0, Math.max(0, room)).map(file => ({ key: crypto.randomUUID(), file, kind: '' }));
    if (list.length > room) setError(`You can add up to ${DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES} files in total.`);
    setExtras(x => [...x, ...added]);
    if (extraInput.current) extraInput.current.value = '';
  }
  async function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault(); setError('');
    const files = [...(id ? [{ file: id, kind: 'government-id' }] : []), ...extras.map(({ file, kind }) => ({ file, kind }))];
    try {
      validateDocuments({ residencyStatus: residency, files: files.map(({ file, kind }) => ({ name: file.name, size: file.size, type: file.type, kind })) });
      setBusy(true);
      await submitDocuments({ token, residencyStatus: residency, files });
      setState('done');
    } catch (err) { setError(err.message); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  if (valid === null) return <section className="documents-card" aria-busy="true"><h3>Complete your file</h3><p className="quiet">Checking your link…</p></section>;
  if (!valid && state === 'form') return <section className="documents-card"><h3>Complete your file</h3><Notice>{token ? 'This link has expired or has already been used. Please contact the clinic, or bring your documents to your visit.' : 'Please bring your government ID and any documents to your visit.'}</Notice></section>;
  if (state === 'done') return <section className="documents-card done"><div className="success-mark small"><Icon name="check" size={22} /></div><h3 ref={heading} tabIndex={-1}>Your file is complete</h3><p>Thank you. Only clinic staff can see your documents. To change anything, please contact the clinic.</p>{DEMO && <p className="demo-label">Demo: only the file names and sizes were kept, in this browser. No file was uploaded.</p>}</section>;
  if (state === 'skipped') return <section className="documents-card"><h3 ref={heading} tabIndex={-1}>Finish your file later</h3><p>{DEMO ? 'In live mode, your confirmation email has a link to finish this before your visit.' : 'Your confirmation email has a link to finish this before your visit. The link works once.'}</p>{DEMO && <p className="demo-label">Demo link: <Link href={'/documents#t=' + token}>{documentsLink(token, '')}</Link></p>}<Button secondary onClick={() => setState('form')}>Complete it now</Button></section>;

  return <section className="documents-card" aria-labelledby="documents-title">
    <h3 id="documents-title">Complete your file</h3>
    <p className="muted">Add your residency status and a valid government ID. PDF, JPG or PNG, up to {DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES / 1048576} MB each and {DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES} files in total.</p>
    {DEMO && <p className="demo-label">Demo: only file names and sizes are kept, in this browser. File contents are never stored or sent.</p>}
    <Notice error>{error}</Notice>
    <form className="stack" onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
      <Field label="Residency status" id="residency-status">
        <select id="residency-status" required value={residency} onChange={e => setResidency(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="">Choose your status</option>
          {residencyStatuses.map(s => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
        </select>
      </Field>
      <div className="field">
        <label htmlFor="government-id">Valid government ID <small>Required, 1 file</small></label>
        {id
          ? <div className="file-row"><Icon name="check" size={18} /><span>{id.name}<small>{fileSize(id.size)}</small></span><button type="button" className="text-link" onClick={() => { setId(null); if (idInput.current) idInput.current.value = ''; }}>Remove</button></div>
          : <input ref={idInput} id="government-id" type="file" accept={ACCEPT} required onChange={e => { setError(''); const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f && total >= DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES) setError(`You can add up to ${DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES} files in total.`); else setId(f || null); }} />}
      </div>
      <fieldset className="choice-field documents-extra">
        <legend>Additional documents <small>Optional</small></legend>
        {extras.map((x, i) => <div className="file-row" key={x.key}>
          <span>{x.file.name}<small>{fileSize(x.file.size)}</small></span>
          <label className="sr-only" htmlFor={'kind-' + x.key}>What is {x.file.name}?</label>
          <select id={'kind-' + x.key} required value={x.kind} onChange={e => setExtras(list => list.map((y, j) => j === i ? { ...y, kind: e.target.value } : y))}>
            <option value="">What is this?</option>
            {extraKinds.map(k => <option key={k.id} value={k.id}>{k.label}</option>)}
          </select>
          <button type="button" className="text-link" onClick={() => setExtras(list => list.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}>Remove<span className="sr-only"> {x.file.name}</span></button>
        </div>)}
        {total < DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES && <label className="upload-label">Add documents<input ref={extraInput} type="file" accept={ACCEPT} multiple onChange={e => addExtras(e.target.files || [])} /></label>}
        <p className="quiet">Tag each as a diploma, certificate, high school diploma, English language test result or other. {total} of {DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES} files.</p>
      </fieldset>
      <p className="privacy-note">Only authorised clinic staff can see these documents. They are never shared with affiliates. Read our <Link href="/privacy">privacy notice</Link>.</p>
      <div className="form-actions">
        {canSkip && <Button type="button" secondary onClick={() => { setError(''); setState('skipped'); }}>Skip for now</Button>}
        <Button type="submit" disabled={busy}>{busy ? 'Uploading…' : 'Save my file'}</Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </section>;
}
```

```javascript
'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useApp } from './provider';
import { Header, Footer, Loading } from './ui';
import DocumentsForm from './documents-form';

// /documents#t=TOKEN, from the confirmation email. The token sits in the URL fragment, which browsers never send to
// the server, so it stays out of server logs; the page reads it here and sends it only with the form.
export default function DocumentsPage() {
  const { ready } = useApp();
  const [token, setToken] = useState(null);
  useEffect(() => { setToken(new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.slice(1)).get('t') || ''); }, []);
  if (!ready || token === null) return <Loading />;
  return <>
    <Header />
    <main className="container documents-page" id="main-content">
      <p className="eyebrow">BEFORE YOUR VISIT</p>
      <h1>Complete your file</h1>
      <DocumentsForm token={token} />
    </main>
    <Footer />
  </>;
}
```
