```javascript
export function Footer(){return <footer className="footer"><div className="footer-inner"><div className="footer-brand"><Logo/><p className="footer-about">Eyecon is the leading provider of optometry services and vision care products in Edmonton. Come visit us today!</p></div><div className="footer-col"><h2>Visit</h2>{clinic.address?<p>{clinic.address}</p>:<p className="pending-text">Address to be confirmed</p>}{clinic.hours?<p>{clinic.hours}</p>:<p className="pending-text">Hours to be confirmed</p>}</div><div className="footer-col"><h2>Contact</h2>{clinic.phone?<a href={clinic.phoneHref}>{clinic.phone}</a>:<p className="pending-text">Phone to be confirmed</p>}{clinic.email&&<a href={'mailto:'+clinic.email}>{clinic.email}</a>}</div><div className="footer-col"><h2>Eyecon</h2><Link href="/my-booking">Find my booking</Link><Link href="/privacy">Privacy</Link><Link href="/login">Affiliate and staff sign-in</Link></div></div><p className="footer-legal">© {new Date().getFullYear()} Eyecon Optometry</p></footer>;}
export function Field({label,id,error,hint,children,...props}){return <div className="field"><label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>{children||<input id={id} aria-invalid={!!error} aria-describedby={hint?id+'-hint':undefined} {...props}/>} {hint&&<small id={id+'-hint'}>{hint}</small>}{error&&<small className="error-text">{error}</small>}</div>;}
export function Notice({children,error=false}){return children?<div role={error?'alert':'status'} className={`notice ${error?'error':''}`}>{children}</div>:null;}
export function Modal({open,title,onClose,children}){const ref=useRef(null);useEffect(()=>{const d=ref.current;if(open&&!d.open)d.showModal();if(!open&&d.open)d.close();},[open]);return <dialog ref={ref} className="modal" onCancel={onClose} onClose={onClose} aria-labelledby="modal-title"><div className="modal-head"><h2 id="modal-title">{title}</h2><button onClick={onClose} className="icon-button" aria-label="Close dialog"><Icon name="close"/></button></div>{open&&children}</dialog>;}
export function Loading(){return <div className="loading" role="status"><span className="spinner"/>Loading your Eyecon experience…</div>;}
export function Portrait({src,alt,...props}){return <Image src={src} alt={alt} {...props}/>;}
// The empty state for a table or list.
export function Empty({text='No records match your filters.'}){return <div className="empty-state"><Icon name="calendar" size={32}/><h3>{text}</h3><p>Your next update will appear here.</p></div>;}
```

```javascript
const staffNav=[['','Bookings'],['affiliates','Affiliates'],['leads','Leads'],['payouts','Payouts'],['pricing','Pricing'],['messages','Messages']];

export default function Workspace({role,section='',item=''}){

  const viewed=role==='staff'&&section==='affiliates'&&item?data.affiliates.find(a=>a.slug===item):null;
  const activeTitle=viewed?viewed.name:(role==='staff'&&section==='affiliates'&&item)?'Affiliate not found':(role==='staff'?staffNav:affiliateNav).find(n=>n[0]===section)?.[1]||'Overview';
  const dayKey=d=>new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:clinic.timezone,year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).format(new Date(d));
  const filtered=rows.filter(b=>(!query||b.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))&&(status==='All'||b.status===status)&&(source==='All'||b.source===source)&&(!date||dayKey(b.start)===date));
  const eligible=rows.filter(b=>b.status==='Attended'&&b.commission>0&&b.payout==='Pending');
  const total=eligible.filter(b=>selected.includes(b.id)).reduce((s,b)=>s+b.commission,0);
  async function run(fn,success='Saved successfully.'){setBusy(true);setError('');setMessage('');try{const result=await fn();setMessage(success);return result;}catch(e){setError(e.message);return false;}finally{setBusy(false);}}
  async function save(act,payload,success){const result=await run(()=>action(act,payload),success);if(result!==false)setModal('');return result;}
  // Opens one uploaded document through a signed link that expires after 5 minutes. The tab is opened before the

  async function viewDocument(doc){if(DEMO||doc.demo)throw new Error('Demo: only the file name and size were kept. There is no file to view.');const tab=window.open('about:blank','_blank');if(!tab)throw new Error('Allow pop-ups for this site to view documents.');tab.opener=null;try{const {url}=await action('document-url',{id:doc.id});tab.location.href=url;}catch(e){tab.close();throw e;}}

  if(!ready)return <Loading/>;
```

```javascript
import { clinic } from './config.js';

// The affiliate workspace's restricted view. An affiliate sees, per referral, only the patient's name, the appointment
// date, its status, their own commission and its payout. Never contact details, service, insurance, documents,
// residency status, doctor, gift card, or any procedure amount (gross, discount, operation cost, net) or rate.
// The live API selects only these columns and then passes each row through restrictAffiliateRow; the demo does the
// same in affiliateRows(), so both modes give an affiliate exactly the same fields.
export const AFFILIATE_FIELDS = ['id', 'name', 'status', 'start', 'commission', 'payout', 'paidAt'];
export const AFFILIATE_COLUMNS = 'id,name,status,start,commission,payout,paid_at';

// Carries an affiliate's referral onto a link, so a booking started from a page they shared still counts for them.
// slug may be a query value (a string, an array if repeated, or missing); only a well-formed page name is passed on.
export function withAffiliate(href, slug) {
  const value = Array.isArray(slug) ? slug[0] : slug;
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > 70 || !/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(value)) return href;
  const [path, hash] = href.split('#');
  return path + (path.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'affiliate=' + encodeURIComponent(value) + (hash === undefined ? '' : '#' + hash);
}

// A referral counts once it is completed (Attended). Until then its commission is shown blank.
export const completed = row => row.status === 'Attended';

// Builds the row from the allowed fields only, whatever else the source object carries. Accepts a database row
// (paid_at) or a demo booking (paidAt).
export function restrictAffiliateRow(row) {
  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    name: String(row.name ?? ''),
    status: row.status,
    start: row.start,
    commission: Number(row.commission) || 0,
    payout: row.payout,
    paidAt: row.paidAt ?? row.paid_at ?? null
  };
}

const monthKey = iso => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: clinic.timezone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit' }).format(new Date(iso));
// Overview and earnings figures. Upcoming bookings are a count only and never add to the completed figures.
export function affiliateStats(rows, now = new Date()) {
  const done = rows.filter(completed), sum = list => list.reduce((s, r) => s + (Number(r.commission) || 0), 0);
  const earned = sum(done), paid = sum(done.filter(r => r.payout === 'Paid'));
  return {
    completedThisMonth: done.filter(r => monthKey(r.start) === monthKey(now)).length,
    completedAllTime: done.length,
    upcoming: rows.filter(r => r.status === 'Booked' && new Date(r.start) > now).length,
    earned,
    paid,
    awaitingPayment: Math.round((earned - paid) * 100) / 100
  };
}

// The CSV an affiliate downloads: the same fields as the screen, with commission blank until completed.
export const AFFILIATE_CSV_FIELDS = ['name', 'appointment', 'status', 'yourCommission', 'payout', 'paidAt'];
export function affiliateCsvRows(rows) {
  return rows.map(r => ({ name: r.name, appointment: r.start, status: r.status, yourCommission: completed(r) ? (Number(r.commission) || 0).toFixed(2) : '', payout: completed(r) ? r.payout : '', paidAt: r.paidAt || '' }));
}
```

```javascript
import { clinic, serviceName, doctorName } from './config.js';
export function escapeICS(s) { return String(s).replaceAll('\\', '\\\\').replaceAll('\n', '\\n').replaceAll(',', '\\,').replaceAll(';', '\\;').replaceAll('\r', ''); }
const stamp = d => new Date(d).toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').replace(/\.\d{3}/, '');
// The event title names the optometrist the appointment is with, e.g. "Eyecon: Comprehensive eye exam with Dr. A B".
// booking.doctorName (from the lookup page, which may come from the EMR) wins over the doctor's slug.
const doctorOf = booking => booking.doctorName || doctorName(booking.doctor);
export function eventTitle(booking) { const doctor = doctorOf(booking); return 'Eyecon: ' + serviceName(booking.service) + (doctor ? ' with ' + doctor : ''); }
const details = booking => (doctorOf(booking) ? 'Your optometrist: ' + doctorOf(booking) + '. ' : '') + (booking.reference ? 'Booking reference: ' + booking.reference + '. ' : '') + 'Please bring your current glasses and insurance card.';
// The UID is the booking reference, so adding the event again from /my-booking updates it rather than duplicating it.
export function calendarFile(booking) {
  const lines = ['BEGIN:VCALENDAR','VERSION:2.0','PRODID:-//Eyecon//Appointments//EN','CALSCALE:GREGORIAN','METHOD:PUBLISH','BEGIN:VEVENT',`UID:${booking.reference || booking.id}@eyecon-appointments`,`DTSTAMP:${stamp(new Date())}`,`DTSTART:${stamp(booking.start)}`,`DTEND:${stamp(new Date(new Date(booking.start).getTime() + (booking.duration || 30) * 60000))}`,`SUMMARY:${escapeICS(eventTitle(booking))}`,`LOCATION:${escapeICS(clinic.address || 'Contact the clinic for location details')}`,`DESCRIPTION:${escapeICS(details(booking))}`,'END:VEVENT','END:VCALENDAR'];
  return lines.join('\r\n') + '\r\n';
}
export function googleCalendar(booking) {
  const end = new Date(new Date(booking.start).getTime() + (booking.duration || 30) * 60000);
  return 'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?' + new URLSearchParams({ action: 'TEMPLATE', text: eventTitle(booking), dates: stamp(booking.start) + '/' + stamp(end), details: details(booking), location: clinic.address });
}
export function outlookCalendar(booking) { return 'https://outlook.live.com/calendar/0/deeplink/compose?' + new URLSearchParams({ subject: eventTitle(booking), startdt: booking.start, enddt: new Date(new Date(booking.start).getTime() + (booking.duration || 30) * 60000).toISOString(), body: details(booking), location: clinic.address }); }
export function downloadFile(text, filename, type = 'text/plain') { const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], { type })); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = filename; a.click(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000); }
```

## lib/commission.js

```javascript
// Affiliate commission, calculated rather than typed:
//   billed     = gross − discount            (what the patient is charged)
//   net        = max(billed − operation cost, 0)
//   commission = round(net × rate ÷ 100, 2)  only when the booking came from an affiliate; otherwise 0
// Example: $400 billed, $200 operation cost → $200 net → 10% → $20 commission.
// supabase/migrations/007_commission.sql (complete_appointment) applies the same rule in the database, which is what
// actually saves it; this copy drives the live calculator, the demo and the tests. Amounts are worked in whole cents
// so rounding matches the database's numeric arithmetic.
export const MAX_AMOUNT = 1000000;
const cents = value => Math.round(Number(value) * 100);
const dollars = value => value / 100;

function amount(value, label) {
  const n = typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() === '' ? NaN : Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > MAX_AMOUNT) throw new Error(`Enter ${label} between $0 and $${MAX_AMOUNT.toLocaleString('en-CA')}.`);
  return cents(n);
}
// What staff enter: the amount billed before discount (gross) and the discount.
export function validateCompletion({ gross, discount = 0 }) {
  const g = amount(gross, 'the amount billed'), d = amount(discount === '' || discount == null ? 0 : discount, 'a discount');
  if (d > g) throw new Error('The discount cannot be more than the amount billed.');
  return { gross: dollars(g), discount: dollars(d) };
}
// A procedure's prices on the Pricing page.
export function validatePricing({ retailPrice, operationCost }) {
  return { retailPrice: dollars(amount(retailPrice, 'a retail price')), operationCost: dollars(amount(operationCost, 'an operation cost')) };
}
// rate is a percentage (10 means 10%). hasAffiliate false means a direct booking: no commission whatever the rate.
export function calculateCommission({ gross, discount = 0, operationCost = 0, rate = 0, hasAffiliate = true }) {
  const g = cents(gross), d = cents(discount || 0), cost = cents(operationCost || 0);
  const basisPoints = Math.round(Number(rate || 0) * 100);
  const billed = g - d, net = Math.max(billed - cost, 0);
  const commission = hasAffiliate ? Math.round(net * basisPoints / 10000) : 0;
  return { gross: dollars(g), discount: dollars(d), billed: dollars(billed), operationCost: dollars(cost), net: dollars(net), rate: hasAffiliate ? basisPoints / 100 : 0, commission: dollars(commission) };
}
```

```javascript
export function findDoctor(slug) { return doctors.find(d => d.slug === slug) || null; }
export function doctorName(slug) { const d = findDoctor(slug); return d ? `${d.title} ${d.first} ${d.last}` : ''; }
export function serviceName(id) { return services.find(s => s.id === id)?.name || 'Eye appointment'; }
export function formatDate(iso, options = {}) { return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: clinic.timezone, dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short', ...options }).format(new Date(iso)); }
export function money(value) { return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-CA', { style: 'currency', currency: 'CAD' }).format(Number(value || 0)); }
```

```javascript
  { daysOff: [0, 1], hours: [13, 14, 15, 17, 18] }      // Tuesday to Saturday, starting and finishing earlier
```

## lib/emr.js

```javascript
import { statuses } from './config.js';

// EMR (electronic medical record) integration: PLACEHOLDER. The EMR vendor is to be confirmed by the clinic, so no
// system is connected and every call returns null. When the vendor is chosen, write an adapter with the same two
// methods, return it from emrAdapter(), keep its credentials in server-only environment variables, and add
// `import 'server-only'` to the file that holds them.
//
//   getAppointment(reference) -> null, or what the EMR knows about that booking:
//     { status?: 'Booked' | 'Attended' | 'No-show' | 'Cancelled', doctorName?: string, start?: ISO string, duration?: minutes }
//     These override the website's own record on /my-booking, because the EMR is where the clinic changes them.
//   syncBooking(booking) -> null, or { externalId } once the EMR has the booking.
export const nullEmr = {
  async getAppointment(reference) { return null; },
  async syncBooking(booking) { return null; }
};
export function emrAdapter() { return nullEmr; }

// Lays what the EMR returned over the website's view of a booking. Only well-formed values are taken.
export function applyEmr(view, appointment) {
  if (!appointment) return view;
  const next = { ...view };
  if (statuses.includes(appointment.status)) next.status = appointment.status;
  if (typeof appointment.doctorName === 'string' && appointment.doctorName.trim()) next.doctorName = appointment.doctorName.trim().slice(0, 120);
  if (appointment.start && Number.isFinite(new Date(appointment.start).getTime())) next.start = new Date(appointment.start).toISOString();
  if (Number.isInteger(appointment.duration) && appointment.duration > 0 && appointment.duration <= 480) next.duration = appointment.duration;
  return next;
}
```

## lib/gift.js

```javascript
import { GIFT_CARD_DAYS } from './config.js';

// Gift card numbers look like EYC-AMO-7K2M9Q: a three-letter code for the affiliate, then a random serial.
// The serial alphabet leaves out 0, 1, I and O so a number read aloud or copied by hand is not misread.
export const GIFT_ALPHABET = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
export const GIFT_SERIAL_LENGTH = 6;
export const HIDDEN_SERIAL = '••••••';

// Characters from a cryptographic random source. The alphabet has exactly 32 characters, so taking the
// low five bits of each random byte picks every character with equal probability.
export function giftSerial(length = GIFT_SERIAL_LENGTH) {
  const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(length));
  return Array.from(bytes, b => GIFT_ALPHABET[b & 31]).join('');
}
// Booking references use the same alphabet, 8 characters long (for example 7K2M9QXB). In live mode the database
// assigns them (migration 006); the demo uses this.
export const REFERENCE_LENGTH = 8;
export const REFERENCE_PATTERN = /^[2-9A-HJ-NP-Z]{8}$/;
export function bookingReference(isTaken = () => false) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt++) { const ref = giftSerial(REFERENCE_LENGTH); if (!isTaken(ref)) return ref; }
  throw new Error('A booking reference could not be issued. Please try again.');
}

// A new card for a referral booking: a serial no other booking has, valid for GIFT_CARD_DAYS from the moment of issue.
export function issueGiftCard(isTaken = () => false, now = new Date()) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt++) {
    const serial = giftSerial();
    if (isTaken(serial)) continue;
    return { serial, issuedAt: now.toISOString(), expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + GIFT_CARD_DAYS * 86400000).toISOString(), status: 'Issued' };
  }
  throw new Error('A gift card number could not be issued. Please try again.');
}

// The affiliate's three-letter code: the one set for them, or else their initials plus the next letter of their
// last name (Alex Morgan becomes AMO), padded with X for very short names.
export function giftCode(affiliate) {
  const set = String(affiliate?.code || '').toUpperCase();
  if (/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(set)) return set;
  const words = String(affiliate?.name || '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[^A-Za-z\s]/g, '').toUpperCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (!words.length) return 'XXX';
  const first = words[0], last = words[words.length - 1];
  const letters = words.length > 1 ? first[0] + last[0] + (last[1] || first[1] || '') : first.slice(0, 3);
  return (letters + 'XXX').slice(0, 3);
}

export function giftNumber(affiliate, serial) { return 'EYC-' + giftCode(affiliate) + '-' + (serial || HIDDEN_SERIAL); }
```

## lib/lookup.js

```javascript
import { clinic, serviceName, doctorName } from './config.js';
import { giftNumber, REFERENCE_PATTERN } from './gift.js';
import { clean } from './validation.js';
import { applyEmr } from './emr.js';

// /my-booking: a patient finds their booking with its reference and the email they booked with. "Not found" and
// "wrong email" give the same answer, so the page cannot be used to learn whether someone has a booking.
export const LOOKUP_NOT_FOUND = 'We could not find a booking with that reference and email. Check both and try again, or call the clinic.';
export const LOOKUP_LIMIT_PER_HOUR = 10;
export function validateLookup(input) {
  const reference = clean(input?.reference, 40).toUpperCase().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
  const email = clean(input?.email, 254).toLowerCase();
  if (!REFERENCE_PATTERN.test(reference)) throw new Error('Your booking reference is 8 letters and numbers, as shown in your confirmation.');
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) throw new Error('Please enter the email address you booked with.');
  return { reference, email };
}
// Everything the lookup ever returns. Nothing else about the booking (contact details, insurance, documents,
// affiliate, notes) leaves the server. affiliate is { name, code } for the gift card number; emr is what the EMR
// adapter returned, which overrides status, doctor and time.
export function lookupView(b, { affiliate = null, fileComplete = false, emr = null } = {}) {
  return applyEmr({
    reference: b.reference,
    service: b.service,
    serviceName: serviceName(b.service),
    doctorName: doctorName(b.doctor) || '',
    start: new Date(b.start).toISOString(),
    duration: b.duration || 30,
    status: b.status,
    clinicAddress: clinic.address || '',
    giftCardNumber: b.giftCard?.serial ? giftNumber(affiliate, b.giftCard.serial) : null,
    fileComplete: !!fileComplete
  }, emr);
}
// A "Complete your file" link is offered only for an upcoming, active booking that still has no government ID.
export function needsDocumentsLink(view, now = new Date()) { return !view.fileComplete && view.status === 'Booked' && new Date(view.start) > now; }
```

```javascript
import 'server-only';
import { calendarFile } from './calendar.js';
import { clinic, formatDate, instructions, defaultTemplates, doctorName } from './config.js';
import { giftNumber } from './gift.js';
// {gift} carries the card number and expiry once a card has been issued to the booking.
export function giftText(b,affiliate) { if(!b.affiliateId)return '';const terms='Terms: '+clinic.site+'/gift-card-terms';return b.giftCard?`Your referral includes a $50 gift card. Card number ${giftNumber(affiliate,b.giftCard.serial)}, valid until ${formatDate(b.giftCard.expiresAt,{dateStyle:'long',timeStyle:undefined})}. Please bring this number to your visit. ${terms}`:`Your referral includes a $50 gift card. ${terms}`; }
// {doctor} is the optometrist the appointment is with, for example "Dr. First Last".
// {documents_link} is the single-use "Complete your file" link. Only the raw token can build it and the server keeps
// just its hash, so the link exists only in the confirmation sent at booking; any later message falls back to text.
export function renderTemplate(body,b,affiliate) { const values={name:b.name,doctor:doctorName(b.doctor)||'your optometrist',documents_link:b.documentsLink||'please bring your documents to your visit.',reference:b.reference||'',lookup_link:clinic.site+'/my-booking',date:formatDate(b.start),address:clinic.address,phone:clinic.phone,instructions:instructions.join('\n'),gift:giftText(b,affiliate)};return body.replace(/\{(name|doctor|documents_link|reference|lookup_link|date|address|phone|instructions|gift)\}/g,(_,key)=>values[key]); }
export async function sendNotification(db,b,kind) {
  const {data:template}=await db.from('message_templates').select('*').eq('id',kind).single();
  // The affiliate's name and code are needed for the gift card number.
  let affiliate=null;if(b.affiliateId&&b.giftCard){const {data:a}=await db.from('affiliates').select('*').eq('id',b.affiliateId).maybeSingle();if(a)affiliate={name:a.name,code:a.gift_code||null};}
  const t=template||defaultTemplates.find(t=>t.id===kind), text=renderTemplate(t.body,b,affiliate);
  const status={email:'not-configured',sms:b.smsConsent?'not-configured':'not-consented'};
  if(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY && process.env.RESEND_FROM){const res=await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails',{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+process.env.RESEND_API_KEY,'Content-Type':'application/json','Idempotency-Key':b.id+'-'+kind},body:JSON.stringify({from:process.env.RESEND_FROM,to:[b.email],subject:t.subject,text,...(kind==='confirmation'?{attachments:[{filename:'eyecon-appointment.ics',content:Buffer.from(calendarFile(b)).toString('base64')}]}:{})}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000)});status.email=res.ok?'sent':'failed';}
  if(b.smsConsent && process.env.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID && process.env.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN && process.env.TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER){const res=await fetch('https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/'+process.env.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID+'/Messages.json',{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:'Basic '+Buffer.from(process.env.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID+':'+process.env.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN).toString('base64'),'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},body:new URLSearchParams({From:process.env.TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER,To:b.phone,Body:text}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000)});status.sms=res.ok?'sent':'failed';}
  return status;
}
export async function claimAndSend(db,b,kind) {
  const {error}=await db.from('notification_jobs').insert({booking_id:b.id,kind,status:'processing'});
  if(error?.code==='23505')return {skipped:true};if(error){console.error('Notification job could not be recorded:',error.code);return {email:'failed',sms:'failed',reviewRequired:true};}
  try{const result=await sendNotification(db,b,kind);await db.from('notification_jobs').update({status:'finished',result}).eq('booking_id',b.id).eq('kind',kind);return result;}catch{await db.from('notification_jobs').update({status:'failed',result:{error:'Delivery failed; staff review required'}}).eq('booking_id',b.id).eq('kind',kind);return {email:'failed',sms:'failed'};}
}
```

## lib/performance.js

```javascript
import { clinic, serviceName, doctorName } from './config.js';
import { completed } from './affiliate.js';

// Staff-only affiliate performance figures. These include procedure amounts, so they are only ever computed from the
// staff workspace data and never reach an affiliate (affiliates get lib/affiliate.js's restricted rows).
const sum = (list, fn) => Math.round(list.reduce((s, b) => s + (Number(fn(b)) || 0), 0) * 100) / 100;
const monthKey = iso => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: clinic.timezone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit' }).format(new Date(iso));
export const dayKey = iso => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: clinic.timezone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).format(new Date(iso));
// What the patient was billed: gross minus discount, once the appointment has been completed with amounts.
export const billed = b => (b.grossAmount == null ? 0 : (Number(b.grossAmount) || 0) - (Number(b.discountAmount) || 0));

// One affiliate's figures. billed sums gross − discount over completed referrals; commission is split by payout.
export function affiliatePerformance(affiliate, bookings, now = new Date()) {
  const own = bookings.filter(b => b.affiliateId === affiliate.id), done = own.filter(completed);
  const thisMonth = done.filter(b => monthKey(b.start) === monthKey(now));
  return {
    affiliate,
    total: own.length,
    completed: done.length,
    upcoming: own.filter(b => b.status === 'Booked' && new Date(b.start) > now).length,
    billed: sum(done, billed),
    pending: sum(done.filter(b => b.payout !== 'Paid'), b => b.commission),
    paid: sum(done.filter(b => b.payout === 'Paid'), b => b.commission),
    commission: sum(done, b => b.commission),
    completedThisMonth: thisMonth.length,
    commissionThisMonth: sum(thisMonth, b => b.commission)
  };
}
// The Affiliates table, sorted by 'completed' or 'commission' (pending + paid), highest first unless dir is 'asc'.
// Ties fall back to name so the order is stable.
export function performanceTable(affiliates, bookings, { key = 'completed', dir = 'desc' } = {}, now = new Date()) {
  const rows = affiliates.map(a => affiliatePerformance(a, bookings, now)), sign = dir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
  return rows.sort((x, y) => sign * (x[key] - y[key]) || x.affiliate.name.localeCompare(y.affiliate.name));
}
// "Top affiliates this month" on the staff overview: most completed referrals this month, then most commission.
export function topAffiliates(affiliates, bookings, now = new Date(), limit = 3) {
  return affiliates.map(a => affiliatePerformance(a, bookings, now)).filter(p => p.completedThisMonth > 0)
    .sort((x, y) => y.completedThisMonth - x.completedThisMonth || y.commissionThisMonth - x.commissionThisMonth || x.affiliate.name.localeCompare(y.affiliate.name))
    .slice(0, limit);
}
// The appointment filters on an affiliate's page. from and to are YYYY-MM-DD in the clinic's timezone, inclusive.
export function filterAppointments(rows, { from = '', to = '', status = 'All' } = {}) {
  return rows.filter(b => (!from || dayKey(b.start) >= from) && (!to || dayKey(b.start) <= to) && (status === 'All' || b.status === status));
}
// The staff CSV for an affiliate's appointments: every staff field, amounts included.
export const STAFF_APPOINTMENT_FIELDS = ['reference', 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'start', 'doctor', 'service', 'source', 'status', 'gross', 'discount', 'billed', 'operationCost', 'net', 'rate', 'commission', 'payout', 'paidAt'];
const amount = v => (v == null ? '' : Number(v).toFixed(2));
export function staffAppointmentRows(rows) {
  return rows.map(b => ({
    reference: b.reference || '', name: b.name, email: b.email || '', phone: b.phone || '', start: b.start,
    doctor: doctorName(b.doctor) || b.doctor || '', service: serviceName(b.service), source: b.source, status: b.status,
    gross: amount(b.grossAmount), discount: amount(b.discountAmount), billed: b.grossAmount == null ? '' : billed(b).toFixed(2),
    operationCost: amount(b.operationCost), net: amount(b.netAmount), rate: b.commissionRate == null ? '' : String(b.commissionRate),
    commission: amount(b.commission), payout: b.payout, paidAt: b.paidAt || ''
  }));
}
```

```javascript
import { featuredReviews } from './config.js';

// The reviews with the featured ones first, in the order named in lib/config.js; the rest keep their order.
export function featuredFirst(list, names = featuredReviews) {
  const rank = r => { const i = names.indexOf(r.name); return i < 0 ? names.length : i; };
  return list.map((r, i) => [r, i]).sort((a, b) => rank(a[0]) - rank(b[0]) || a[1] - b[1]).map(([r]) => r);
}

// The featured quote shortens a long review: about max characters, ending on a whole word, then "…".
// Shorter reviews are returned unchanged. The full text is always one click away.
export const EXCERPT_LENGTH = 160;
export function excerpt(text, max = EXCERPT_LENGTH) {
  if (text.length <= max) return text;
  const cut = text.slice(0, max - 1), space = cut.lastIndexOf(' ');
  return (space > max * 0.6 ? cut.slice(0, space) : cut).replace(/[\s,;:.\-—]+$/, '') + '…';
}
```

```javascript
import 'server-only';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, createHash, randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { DEMO, documentLinkExpiry } from './config.js';
import { issueGiftCard } from './gift.js';
export function adminClient() {
  if (DEMO) throw new Error('Live services are disabled in demo mode.');
  if (!process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || !process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) throw new Error('The clinic booking service is not configured yet.');
  return createClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, { auth:{persistSession:false,autoRefreshToken:false} });
}
export async function identity(request) {
  const token = request.headers.get('authorization')?.replace(/^Bearer /,'');
  if (!token) throw new Error('Please sign in.');
  const db=adminClient(); const {data,error}=await db.auth.getUser(token);
  if(error || !data.user) throw new Error('Your session has expired. Please sign in again.');
  const {data:profile}=await db.from('profiles').select('role,affiliate_id').eq('id',data.user.id).single();
  if(!profile) throw new Error('Your account does not have access to this workspace.');
  if(profile.role==='affiliate') { const {data:a}=await db.from('affiliates').select('active').eq('id',profile.affiliate_id).single(); if(!a?.active) throw new Error('This affiliate account is inactive.'); }
  return {id:data.user.id,role:profile.role,affiliateId:profile.affiliate_id,db};
}
export function requireStaff(user) { if(user.role!=='staff') throw new Error('Staff access is required.'); }
export function sameOrigin(request) { const origin=request.headers.get('origin'); if(!origin || origin!==new URL(request.url).origin) throw new Error('This request must come from the Eyecon website.'); }
export function encryptPolicy(value) { if(!value)return null;const key=process.env.INSURANCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY;if(!/^[a-f\d]{64}$/i.test(key||''))throw new Error('Insurance policy storage is not configured. Please leave the policy number blank.');const iv=randomBytes(12),cipher=createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm',Buffer.from(key,'hex'),iv);const encrypted=Buffer.concat([cipher.update(value,'utf8'),cipher.final()]);return Buffer.concat([iv,cipher.getAuthTag(),encrypted]).toString('base64'); }
export function decryptPolicy(value) { if(!value)return '';const key=process.env.INSURANCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY;if(!key)return 'Unavailable';try{const bytes=Buffer.from(value,'base64'),decipher=createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm',Buffer.from(key,'hex'),bytes.subarray(0,12));decipher.setAuthTag(bytes.subarray(12,28));return Buffer.concat([decipher.update(bytes.subarray(28)),decipher.final()]).toString('utf8');}catch{return 'Unavailable';} }
// documents are the booking's booking_documents rows (staff only). Storage paths are never sent to the browser.
export function mapDocument(d) { return {id:d.id,kind:d.kind,name:d.original_name,size:d.size,mime:d.mime,uploadedAt:d.uploaded_at}; }
// The amounts behind a calculated commission (staff only; affiliates never receive these). null until completed.
const num=v=>v==null?null:Number(v);
function amounts(b) { return {grossAmount:num(b.gross_amount),discountAmount:num(b.discount_amount),operationCost:num(b.operation_cost),netAmount:num(b.net_amount),commissionRate:num(b.commission_rate)}; }
export function mapPricing(p) { return {service:p.service,retailPrice:Number(p.retail_price),operationCost:Number(p.operation_cost),updatedAt:p.updated_at}; }
export function mapBooking(b, documents=[]) { return {id:b.id,reference:b.reference||null,name:b.name,email:b.email,phone:b.phone,start:b.start,duration:b.duration,service:b.service,source:b.source,affiliateId:b.affiliate_id,status:b.status,commission:Number(b.commission),payout:b.payout,paidAt:b.paid_at,firstVisit:b.first_visit,smsConsent:b.sms_consent,insurance:b.insurance,policy:decryptPolicy(b.policy_encrypted),brands:b.brands,doctor:b.doctor||null,serviceOption:b.service_option||null,...amounts(b),residencyStatus:b.residency_status||null,documents:documents.map(mapDocument),giftCard:b.gift_serial?{serial:b.gift_serial,issuedAt:b.gift_issued_at,expiresAt:b.gift_expires_at,status:b.gift_status||'Issued'}:null,createdAt:b.created_at}; }
export function mapAffiliate(a) { return {id:a.id,name:a.name,slug:a.slug,bio:a.bio,photo:a.photo,email:a.email,active:a.active,commissionRate:Number(a.commission_rate),commissionNote:a.commission_note,code:a.gift_code||null}; }
export function publicAffiliate(a) { const {id,name,slug,bio,photo,active,code}=mapAffiliate(a);return {id,name,slug,bio,photo,active,code}; }
// Issue a gift card number to a referral booking that has just been created. The unique index on gift_serial is the
// final guard: a clash simply draws another serial. The card is a courtesy, so a failure to store it (for example
// before migration 002 has run) is logged and never loses the booking.
export async function issueGift(db, row) {
  if(!row?.affiliate_id || row.gift_serial) return row;
  for(let attempt=0;attempt<5;attempt++){
    const card=issueGiftCard();
    const {error}=await db.from('bookings').update({gift_serial:card.serial,gift_issued_at:card.issuedAt,gift_expires_at:card.expiresAt,gift_status:card.status}).eq('id',row.id).is('gift_serial',null);
    if(!error) return {...row,gift_serial:card.serial,gift_issued_at:card.issuedAt,gift_expires_at:card.expiresAt,gift_status:card.status};
    if(error.code!=='23505'){console.error('Gift card not issued:',error.code);return row;}
  }
  console.error('Gift card not issued: no unused serial found');return row;
}
// "Complete your file" upload links. The token is 32 random bytes; only its SHA-256 hash is stored, so a database
// leak does not reveal working links. A failure to issue one (for example before migration 005 has run) is logged
// and never loses the booking: the patient can bring their documents instead.
export function hashToken(token) { return createHash('sha256').update(String(token)).digest('hex'); }
export async function issueDocumentToken(db, row) {
  if(!row?.id) return null;
  const token=randomBytes(32).toString('base64url');
  const {error}=await db.from('booking_document_tokens').insert({booking_id:row.id,token_hash:hashToken(token),expires_at:documentLinkExpiry(row.start)});
  if(error){console.error('Document link not issued:',error.code);return null;}
  return token;
}
// Cloudflare Turnstile for public forms. action is the form's name ('booking' or 'lookup'), and must match.
export async function verifyTurnstile(request, token, action) {
  if(!process.env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY)throw new Error('Online verification is not configured. Please contact the clinic.');
  const verify=await fetch('https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify',{method:'POST',body:new URLSearchParams({secret:process.env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY,response:String(token||'')}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(10000)}).then(r=>r.json());
  if(!verify.success || verify.hostname!==new URL(request.url).hostname || verify.action!==action)throw new Error('Please complete the verification and try again.');
}
// The visitor's IP, hashed with a server secret, for per-IP rate limits. The IP itself is never stored.
export function requestHash(request) { return createHash('sha256').update((request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]||'unknown')+process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY).digest('hex'); }
// The optional service option (migration 008) is saved after the booking is created. It is a preference, so a
// failure to store it is logged and never loses the booking.
export async function saveServiceOption(db, row, option) {
  if(!option) return row;
  const {error}=await db.from('bookings').update({service_option:option}).eq('id',row.id);
  if(error){console.error('Service option not saved:',error.code);return row;}
  return {...row,service_option:option};
}
export function fail(error, status=400) { const text=String(error?.message || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.');const safe=text.includes('fetch failed')?'The booking service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.':text;return Response.json({error:safe},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}}); }
export async function audit(db, actor, action, recordId) { const {error}=await db.from('audit_logs').insert({actor_id:actor,action,record_id:String(recordId)});if(error)console.error('Audit log write failed:',error.code); }
```

## lib/shop.js

```javascript
import { collections, money } from './config.js';
import { withAffiliate } from './affiliate.js';

// The Shop Frames page's rules, kept apart from the components so they can be tested.

export function frameBrand(frame) { return collections.find(c => c.slug === frame.brand) || null; }

// A frame's price as shown: nothing while it is blank; a plain number is shown in dollars, anything else as written.
export function framePrice(price) {
  const text = String(price ?? '').trim();
  if (!text) return '';
  return /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(text) ? money(text) : text;
}

// A styling visit, with a brand already chosen when one is given, keeping the affiliate's referral.
export function stylingHref(affiliate, brandName = '') {
  return withAffiliate('/booking?service=styling' + (brandName ? '&brand=' + encodeURIComponent(brandName) : ''), affiliate);
}
// "Reserve to try": a styling visit with the frame's brand already chosen.
export function reserveHref(frame, affiliate) { return stylingHref(affiliate, frameBrand(frame)?.name); }
// A brand's own page. Not a booking link, but it keeps the referral so the booking links there can carry it on.
export function brandHref(slug, affiliate) { return withAffiliate('/shop/' + slug, affiliate); }
// Get directions: a Google Maps search for the address, or nothing while there is no address.
export function directionsUrl(address) {
  const text = String(address ?? '').trim();
  return text ? 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=' + encodeURIComponent(text) : '';
}

// The brands below the featured row, in list order. Each 'banner' brand is its own full-width band; consecutive
// 'tile' brands fill rows of three. A row left short is filled with the closing tiles (Book a styling visit, then
// Visit the boutique), and the page always ends with both closing tiles: in the last row when it already holds them,
// otherwise in a row of their own after it. New brands fall into the same pattern from their layout alone.
export const CLOSING_TILES = ['styling', 'visit'];
export function brandGroups(list = collections) {
  const groups = [];
  for (const brand of list) {
    const last = groups.at(-1);
    if (brand.layout === 'tile' && last?.type === 'tiles' && last.items.length < 3) last.items.push(brand);
    else groups.push({ type: brand.layout === 'tile' ? 'tiles' : 'banner', items: [brand] });
  }
  for (const group of groups) {
    if (group.type === 'tiles') group.items.push(...CLOSING_TILES.slice(0, 3 - group.items.length).map(closing => ({ closing })));
  }
  const end = groups.at(-1), shown = end?.type === 'tiles' ? end.items.map(i => i.closing) : [];
  const missing = CLOSING_TILES.filter(id => !shown.includes(id));
  if (missing.length) groups.push({ type: 'tiles', items: missing.map(closing => ({ closing })) });
  return groups;
}

// Saved (hearted) frames live in this browser only. Reading and writing never throw: a private window, blocked storage
// or a damaged value simply means nothing is saved.
export const SAVED_FRAMES_KEY = 'eyecon-saved-frames';
export function readSavedFrames(storage) {
  try {
    const list = JSON.parse(storage?.getItem(SAVED_FRAMES_KEY) || '[]');
    return Array.isArray(list) ? list.filter(s => typeof s === 'string') : [];
  } catch { return []; }
}
export function writeSavedFrames(storage, list) {
  try { storage.setItem(SAVED_FRAMES_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)); return true; } catch { return false; }
}
export function toggleSaved(list, slug) { return list.includes(slug) ? list.filter(s => s !== slug) : [...list, slug]; }
```

## lib/validation.js

```javascript
import { services, statuses, doctors, serviceOptions, residencyStatuses, documentKinds, DOCUMENT_TYPES, DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES, DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES } from './config.js';
export function clean(value, max = 250) { return typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim().slice(0, max) : ''; }
export function validateBooking(input, manual = false) {
  const name = clean(input.name, 120), email = clean(input.email, 254).toLowerCase(), phone = clean(input.phone, 32);
  if (name.length < 2) throw new Error('Please enter your full name.');
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) throw new Error('Please enter a valid email address.');
  if (!/^\+?[\d\s().-]{7,25}$/.test(phone)) throw new Error('Please enter a valid mobile number.');
  if (input.smsConsent && !/^\+[1-9]\d{7,14}$/.test(phone)) throw new Error('For SMS reminders, use an international number such as +14165550123.');
  if (!services.some(s => s.id === input.service)) throw new Error('Please choose an appointment type.');
  const date = new Date(input.start);
  if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) || date <= new Date()) throw new Error('Choose an available future appointment.');
  if (typeof input.firstVisit !== 'boolean') throw new Error('Please tell us whether this is your first visit.');
  const doctor = validateDoctor(input.doctor);
  // Optional. Only an option the chosen service offers is kept (for example a skin tightening technology).
  const serviceOption = serviceOptions[input.service]?.some(o => o.slug === input.serviceOption) ? input.serviceOption : null;
  const source = manual ? (['Phone', 'Walk-in', 'Direct'].includes(input.source) ? input.source : 'Phone') : (input.affiliateId ? 'Affiliate' : 'Direct');
  return { name, email, phone, service: input.service, start: date.toISOString(), firstVisit: input.firstVisit, insurance: clean(input.insurance, 120), policy: clean(input.policy, 120), brands: clean(input.brands, 300), smsConsent: input.smsConsent === true, affiliateId: clean(input.affiliateId, 60) || null, doctor, serviceOption, source };
}
// Every appointment belongs to one optometrist: the slug of a doctor in lib/config.js.
export function validateDoctor(slug) { if (typeof slug !== 'string' || !doctors.some(d => d.slug === slug)) throw new Error('Please choose an optometrist.'); return slug; }
// The "Complete your file" form: a residency status from the list, exactly one government ID, and up to
// DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES files in total, each a PDF, JPG or PNG of at most DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES with a known kind.
// files are descriptions only ({ name, size, type, kind }); the bytes are checked separately by fileSignatureOk.
export function validateDocuments(input) {
  const residencyStatus = residencyStatuses.includes(input?.residencyStatus) ? input.residencyStatus : null;
  if (!residencyStatus) throw new Error('Please choose your residency status.');
  const files = Array.isArray(input?.files) ? input.files : [];
  if (files.length > DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES) throw new Error(`Please upload at most ${DOCUMENT_MAX_FILES} files in total.`);
  const ids = files.filter(f => f?.kind === 'government-id').length;
  if (ids === 0) throw new Error('Please add a valid government ID.');
  if (ids > 1) throw new Error('Please add only one government ID.');
  const described = files.map(f => {
    const name = clean(f?.name, 200) || 'document';
    if (!documentKinds.some(k => k.id === f?.kind)) throw new Error(`Choose what “${name}” is.`);
    if (!DOCUMENT_TYPES[f?.type]) throw new Error(`“${name}” must be a PDF, JPG or PNG file.`);
    if (!Number.isInteger(f?.size) || f.size <= 0) throw new Error(`“${name}” is empty.`);
    if (f.size > DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES) throw new Error(`“${name}” is larger than ${DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES / 1048576} MB.`);
    return { name, size: f.size, type: f.type, kind: f.kind };
  });
  return { residencyStatus, files: described };
}
// Does the file start with the signature its type claims? PDF: "%PDF-". JPEG: FF D8 FF. PNG: the 8-byte PNG signature.
export function fileSignatureOk(type, bytes) {
  const b = bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? bytes : new Uint8Array(bytes || []);
  const starts = sig => sig.every((x, i) => b[i] === x);
  if (type === 'application/pdf') return starts([0x25, 0x50, 0x44, 0x46, 0x2d]);
  if (type === 'image/jpeg') return starts([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff]);
  if (type === 'image/png') return starts([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]);
  return false;
}
// "File complete" once a government ID has been uploaded; "Missing ID" until then.
export function fileComplete(booking) { return !!booking?.documents?.some(d => d.kind === 'government-id'); }
export function validateStatus(status) { if (!statuses.includes(status)) throw new Error('Invalid booking status.'); return status; }
export function validateSlug(slug) { if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(slug) || slug.length > 70) throw new Error('Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens for the page name.'); return slug; }
// An affiliate's optional gift card code: blank, or exactly three letters (stored in capitals).
export function validateGiftCode(code) { const value = clean(code, 10).toUpperCase(); if (!value) return null; if (!/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(value)) throw new Error('The gift card code must be exactly three letters.'); return value; }
export function safePhoto(url) { return typeof url === 'string' && (url.startsWith('/images/') || /^https:\/\//.test(url)) ? url : '/images/affiliate.webp'; }
// A slot is taken when its optometrist already has an active booking overlapping it. Other optometrists' bookings
// never block it. A record without a doctor (which should not exist) is treated as blocking, to be safe.
export function slotTaken(slot, bookings) { const start=new Date(slot.start).getTime(),end=start+(slot.duration||30)*60000;return bookings.some(b=>b.status!=='Cancelled'&&(!slot.doctor||!b.doctor||b.doctor===slot.doctor)&&start<new Date(b.start).getTime()+(b.duration||30)*60000&&end>new Date(b.start).getTime()); }
export function csv(rows, fields) { const cell = x => { let v=String(x ?? '');if(/^\s*[=+@-]/.test(v))v="'"+v;return '"'+v.replaceAll('"','""')+'"'; }; return [fields.map(cell).join(','), ...rows.map(r => fields.map(f => cell(r[f])).join(','))].join('\r\n'); }
```

## scripts/compare.mjs

```javascript
// Side-by-side before/after images from two screenshot folders.
// Usage: node scripts/compare.mjs [before] [after] [output]   Saves into screenshots/compare/ unless an output folder is named.
import { mkdir, readdir, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';

const [before = 'before', after = 'after', output = 'compare'] = process.argv.slice(2);
const root = path.resolve('screenshots'), out = path.join(root, path.basename(output));
await mkdir(out, { recursive: true });
const names = (await readdir(path.join(root, after))).filter(f => f.endsWith('.png'));
const afterOnly = new Set(names), shared = (await readdir(path.join(root, before))).filter(f => afterOnly.has(f));
const data = async file => 'data:image/png;base64,' + (await readFile(file)).toString('base64');

const browser = await chromium.launch();
try {
  const page = await browser.newPage({ deviceScaleFactor: 1 });
  for (const name of shared) {
    const width = Number(name.match(/-(\d+)x\d+\.png$/)?.[1]) || 1440;
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: width * 2 + 72, height: 800 });
    await page.setContent(`<style>
      body { margin: 0; padding: 24px; background: #14181d; color: #f6f5f2; font: 500 15px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: flex-start; }
      figure { margin: 0; } figcaption { letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 14px; } img { display: block; width: ${width}px; }
    </style>
    <figure><figcaption>Before</figcaption><img src="${await data(path.join(root, before, name))}"></figure>
    <figure><figcaption>After</figcaption><img src="${await data(path.join(root, after, name))}"></figure>`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
    const file = path.join(out, name);
    await page.screenshot({ path: file, fullPage: true });
    console.log('Saved ' + path.relative(process.cwd(), file));
  }
} finally {
  await browser.close();
}
```

## scripts/convert-shop-images.mjs

```javascript
// One-off: converts the Shop Frames banner, hero and brand photographs to WebP.
// Crops each source to its exact ratio, then resizes without upscaling.
// Usage: node scripts/convert-shop-images.mjs [srcRoot]  (originals live in the git-ignored design-assets/)
import sharp from 'sharp';
import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const src = process.argv[2] || 'design-assets/originals';
const banners = path.join(src, 'shop frames banners');
const brands = path.join(src, 'brands');

const jobs = [
  { in: path.join(banners, 'shop-frames-hero-desktop.png'), out: 'public/images/shop/hero-desktop.webp', w: 2400, rw: 16, rh: 9 },
  { in: path.join(banners, 'shop-frames-hero-mobile.png'), out: 'public/images/shop/hero-mobile.webp', w: 1080, rw: 4, rh: 5 },
  ...['cartier', 'chrome-hearts', 'tom-ford', 'maybach', 'dior', 'tiffany-and-co'].map((slug) => ({
    in: path.join(banners, `${slug}-desktop-banner.png`), out: `public/images/shop/banners/${slug}-desktop.webp`, w: 2400, rw: 16, rh: 9,
  })),
  ...['bottega-veneta', 'celine', 'versace', 'prada', 'tiffany-and-co', 'dior', 'oakley', 'ray-ban'].map((slug) => ({
    in: path.join(brands, `${slug}.png`), out: `public/images/brands/${slug}.webp`, w: 1122, h: 1402, rw: 4, rh: 5,
  })),
];

// Per-file crop position overrides, filled in after checking the output.
// The 16:9 sources only lose a few rows, so keep their top edge: the hero's
// right-hand head already touches it in the source.
const positions = Object.fromEntries(
  ['hero-desktop', 'cartier-desktop', 'chrome-hearts-desktop', 'tom-ford-desktop', 'maybach-desktop', 'dior-desktop', 'tiffany-and-co-desktop']
    .map((name) => [`${name}.webp`, 'top']),
);

for (const job of jobs) {
  const { width, height } = await sharp(job.in).metadata();
  // Largest box of the target ratio that fits the source, on a whole-unit grid.
  const unit = Math.min(Math.floor(width / job.rw), Math.floor(height / job.rh));
  let cropW = unit * job.rw;
  let cropH = unit * job.rh;
  // The brand portraits have a fixed size that matches their source.
  if (job.h && job.w <= width && job.h <= height) { cropW = job.w; cropH = job.h; }
  const outW = Math.min(job.w, cropW);
  const outH = job.h && outW === job.w ? job.h : Math.round((outW * cropH) / cropW);
  const position = positions[path.basename(job.out)] || 'attention';
  const cropped = await sharp(job.in).resize(cropW, cropH, { fit: 'cover', position }).toBuffer();
  mkdirSync(path.dirname(job.out), { recursive: true });
  const info = await sharp(cropped).resize(outW, outH, { withoutEnlargement: true }).webp({ quality: 82 }).toFile(job.out);
  console.log(`${job.out} ${info.width}x${info.height} ${Math.round(info.size / 1024)}KB (${position})`);
}
```

## scripts/generate-code-guide.mjs

````javascript
import { readdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';

const root = process.cwd();
const ignored = new Set(['node_modules', '.next', '.git', '.vercel', 'coverage', 'SOURCE_CODE.md']);
async function list(dir, prefix = '') {
  const entries = await readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  const result = [];
  for (const entry of entries.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))) {
    if (ignored.has(entry.name) || (entry.name.startsWith('.env') && entry.name !== '.env.example') || entry.name.endsWith('.log')) continue;
    const relative = prefix + entry.name;
    if (entry.isDirectory()) result.push(...await list(path.join(dir, entry.name), relative + '/'));
    else if (entry.isFile()) result.push(relative);
  }
  return result;
}
function tree(files) {
  const nodes = {};
  for (const file of files) {
    let current = nodes;
    for (const part of file.split('/')) current = current[part] ||= {};
  }
  function lines(node, prefix = '') {
    const entries = Object.entries(node);
    return entries.flatMap(([name, child], index) => {
      const last = index === entries.length - 1;
      const directory = Object.keys(child).length > 0;
      return [prefix + (last ? '└── ' : '├── ') + name + (directory ? '/' : ''), ...lines(child, prefix + (last ? '    ' : '│   '))];
    });
  }
  return ['eyecon-module-1/', ...lines(nodes)].join('\n');
}
const files = await list(root);
const assets = files.filter(f => /\.(webp|png|jpg|jpeg)$/i.test(f));
const source = files.filter(f => f !== 'README.md' && !assets.includes(f));
let result = '# Full folder structure\n\n```text\n' + tree([...files, 'SOURCE_CODE.md']) + '\n```\n\n';
result += 'The ZIP contains these files in their actual folders. `node_modules`, `.next` and `.env.local` are created on your machine and are deliberately excluded. `SOURCE_CODE.md` is this generated guide.\n\n# Complete source files\n\nEvery text source file is reproduced below, including the lockfile. Create each file at its exact relative path. The image restoration command follows the source; the full README and setup instructions are last.\n\n';
for (const file of source) {
  const content = await readFile(path.join(root, file), 'utf8');
  const language = file.endsWith('.js') || file.endsWith('.mjs') ? 'javascript' : file.endsWith('.json') ? 'json' : file.endsWith('.css') ? 'css' : file.endsWith('.sql') ? 'sql' : file.endsWith('.svg') ? 'xml' : file.endsWith('.md') ? 'markdown' : 'text';
  const fences = content.match(/`{3,}/g) || [];
  const fence = '`'.repeat(Math.max(3, ...fences.map(f => f.length + 1)));
  result += '## ' + file + '\n\n' + fence + language + '\n' + content + (content.endsWith('\n') ? '' : '\n') + fence + '\n\n';
}
const encoded = {};
for (const file of assets) encoded[file] = (await readFile(path.join(root, file))).toString('base64');
result += '# Complete image assets\n\nThese are binary WebP files, already included in the ZIP. For manual reconstruction, run the following complete Node.js command from the project root. It restores the exact supplied images from Base64; no external download is required. Paste it as a single command in a terminal that supports the shown quoting, or save the JavaScript between the outer quotes as `restore-images.cjs` and run `node restore-images.cjs`. The temporary restoration script is not needed to run the site.\n\n```bash\nnode -e \'const fs=require("node:fs");const path=require("node:path");const assets=' + JSON.stringify(encoded) + ';for(const [name,data] of Object.entries(assets)){fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(name),{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(name,Buffer.from(data,"base64"));}\'\n```\n\n';
result += '# README.md — complete setup instructions\n\nSave the following full contents as `README.md`. These instructions follow the source as requested.\n\n' + await readFile(path.join(root, 'README.md'), 'utf8');
await writeFile(path.join(root, 'SOURCE_CODE.md'), result);
console.log(`SOURCE_CODE.md: ${source.length} complete text source files, README, ${assets.length} complete image assets.`);
````

## scripts/screenshots.mjs

```javascript
// Full-page screenshots of the public pages, for before/after comparisons.
// Usage: node scripts/screenshots.mjs <folder>     e.g. node scripts/screenshots.mjs before
// Saves into screenshots/<folder>/. The dev server must be running; set BASE_URL if it is not on port 3000.
import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';

const folder = process.argv[2];
if (!folder) { console.error('Give a folder name, for example: node scripts/screenshots.mjs before'); process.exit(1); }

const base = (process.env.BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000').replace(/\/$/, '');
const pages = [['home', '/'], ['book-alex-morgan', '/book/alex-morgan']];
// The wide size is an extra check of the home page only.
const sizes = [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844], ['wide', 1920, 1080]];
const out = path.resolve('screenshots', path.basename(folder));
await mkdir(out, { recursive: true });

const browser = await chromium.launch();
try {
  for (const [size, width, height] of sizes) {
    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width, height }, deviceScaleFactor: 1, isMobile: size === 'mobile', hasTouch: size === 'mobile' });
    for (const [name, route] of size === 'wide' ? pages.slice(0, 1) : pages) {
      const page = await context.newPage();
      const response = await page.goto(base + route, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' });
      if (!response?.ok()) throw new Error(`${route} returned ${response?.status()}`);
      await page.waitForSelector('.hero');
      await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
      // Scroll through the page so lazy images load, then let the entrance animations finish.
      await page.evaluate(async () => { for (let y = 0; y < document.body.scrollHeight; y += 600) { window.scrollTo(0, y); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 80)); } window.scrollTo(0, 0); });
      // Hide what floats over the page (mobile booking bar, Next.js dev badge) so nothing covers the content in a full-page capture.
      await page.addStyleTag({ content: '.mobile-book, nextjs-portal { display: none !important; }' });
      await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');
      await page.waitForTimeout(2200);
      const file = path.join(out, `${name}-${size}-${width}x${height}.png`);
      await page.screenshot({ path: file, fullPage: true });
      console.log('Saved ' + path.relative(process.cwd(), file));
      await page.close();
    }
    await context.close();
  }
} finally {
  await browser.close();
}
```

## supabase/migrations/004_doctor_availability.sql

```sql
-- Every appointment belongs to one optometrist, and availability is kept per optometrist, so two optometrists can
-- see patients at the same moment while one optometrist can never be double-booked.
-- Run this once in the Supabase SQL editor, after the previous migration (002_gift_cards.sql; number 003 is not in use).
-- Doctor values are the slugs in lib/config.js (for example 'doctor-1').

create extension if not exists btree_gist;

-- 1. Appointment slots: one row per optometrist per start time.
alter table public.appointment_slots add column if not exists doctor text;
-- STAFF, PLEASE REVIEW: every slot that existed before this migration has been given to 'doctor-1'. In Staff admin,
-- add the same times for the other optometrists where they also work, and contact the clinic's developer to move
-- any time that really belongs to someone else.
update public.appointment_slots set doctor = 'doctor-1' where doctor is null;
alter table public.appointment_slots alter column doctor set not null;
alter table public.appointment_slots add constraint appointment_slots_doctor_slug check (doctor ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$');

-- The bookings foreign key depends on the old primary key, so it goes first and returns below as (doctor, start).
alter table public.bookings drop constraint if exists bookings_start_fkey;
alter table public.appointment_slots drop constraint appointment_slots_pkey;
alter table public.appointment_slots add primary key (doctor, start);

-- 2. Bookings: the optometrist is the one the patient asked for, or 'doctor-1' when no preference was given.
-- preferred_doctor stays for history; the website now writes doctor.
alter table public.bookings add column if not exists doctor text;
update public.bookings set doctor = coalesce(preferred_doctor, 'doctor-1') where doctor is null;
alter table public.bookings alter column doctor set not null;

-- A booking whose preferred optometrist differs from the slot's new owner needs a matching slot for that optometrist.
insert into public.appointment_slots (doctor, start, duration)
select distinct on (doctor, start) doctor, start, duration from public.bookings
on conflict (doctor, start) do nothing;
alter table public.bookings add constraint bookings_doctor_slot_fkey foreign key (doctor, start) references public.appointment_slots (doctor, start);

-- 3. One active booking per optometrist per start time, and no overlapping bookings for the same optometrist.
drop index if exists public.one_active_booking_per_slot;
alter table public.bookings drop constraint if exists no_overlapping_bookings;
create unique index one_active_booking_per_doctor_slot on public.bookings (doctor, start) where status <> 'Cancelled';
alter table public.bookings add constraint no_overlapping_bookings_per_doctor exclude using gist (doctor with =, tstzrange(start, end_time, '[)') with &&) where (status <> 'Cancelled');
create index if not exists booking_doctor_start_index on public.bookings (doctor, start);

-- 4. Open times now say whose they are. A slot is free when that optometrist has no overlapping active booking.
drop function if exists public.available_slots();
create function public.available_slots() returns table(doctor text, start timestamptz, duration integer) language sql security definer set search_path=public as $$
 select s.doctor, s.start, s.duration from appointment_slots s where s.start > now() and s.start < now() + interval '90 days'
 and not exists(select 1 from bookings b where b.status <> 'Cancelled' and b.doctor = s.doctor and tstzrange(b.start, b.end_time, '[)') && tstzrange(s.start, s.start + s.duration * interval '1 minute', '[)'))
 order by s.start, s.doctor limit 1500;
$$;
revoke all on function public.available_slots() from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.available_slots() to service_role;

-- 5. Booking requires an optometrist and locks that optometrist's slot.
drop function if exists public.create_booking(text,text,text,timestamptz,text,uuid,text,boolean,text,text,text,boolean,text);
create function public.create_booking(p_name text,p_email text,p_phone text,p_doctor text,p_start timestamptz,p_service text,p_affiliate uuid,p_source text,p_first_visit boolean,p_insurance text,p_policy text,p_brands text,p_sms boolean,p_request_hash text)
returns setof public.bookings language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare duration_value integer;
begin
 if p_doctor is null or p_doctor = '' then raise exception 'doctor required'; end if;
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(coalesce(p_request_hash,p_email)));
 if p_request_hash is not null and (select count(*) from bookings where request_hash=p_request_hash and created_at>now()-interval '1 hour')>=5 then raise exception 'rate limit';end if;
 if p_affiliate is not null and not exists(select 1 from affiliates where id=p_affiliate and active=true) then raise exception 'inactive affiliate';end if;
 select duration into duration_value from appointment_slots where doctor=p_doctor and start=p_start and start>now() for update;
 if duration_value is null then raise exception 'unavailable slot';end if;
 return query insert into bookings(name,email,phone,doctor,start,end_time,duration,service,affiliate_id,source,first_visit,insurance,policy_encrypted,brands,sms_consent,consent_at,request_hash)
 values(p_name,p_email,p_phone,p_doctor,p_start,p_start+duration_value*interval '1 minute',duration_value,p_service,p_affiliate,p_source,p_first_visit,p_insurance,p_policy,p_brands,p_sms,case when p_sms then now() else null end,p_request_hash) returning *;
end;$$;
revoke all on function public.create_booking(text,text,text,text,timestamptz,text,uuid,text,boolean,text,text,text,boolean,text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.create_booking(text,text,text,text,timestamptz,text,uuid,text,boolean,text,text,text,boolean,text) to service_role;

-- 6. The confirmation message names the optometrist. Only the default wording is changed; a template staff have
-- rewritten is left alone (they can add {doctor} themselves in Staff admin > Messages).
update public.message_templates set body = replace(body, 'your appointment is booked for', 'your appointment with {doctor} is booked for')
where id = 'confirmation' and body not like '%{doctor}%';
```

## supabase/migrations/005_documents.sql

```sql
-- "Complete your file": the patient's residency status, a valid government ID and optional additional documents,
-- uploaded after booking through the website's /api/documents route with a single-use, expiring link.
-- Run this once in the Supabase SQL editor, after 004_doctor_availability.sql.
-- Only the server (service role) can read or write any of this. Affiliates never see it.

-- 1. The residency status chosen from the list in lib/config.js (stored as its label).
alter table public.bookings add column if not exists residency_status text check (residency_status is null or char_length(residency_status) <= 120);

-- 2. One upload link per booking. Only the SHA-256 hash of the token is stored; the token itself exists only in the
-- patient's browser and confirmation email. used_at is set when the form is submitted, so the link works once.
create table public.booking_document_tokens (
 booking_id uuid primary key references public.bookings(id) on delete cascade,
 token_hash text not null unique check (token_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 expires_at timestamptz not null,
 used_at timestamptz,
 created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- 3. The uploaded files. file_path is the object's path inside the private 'booking-documents' bucket.
create table public.booking_documents (
 id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
 booking_id uuid not null references public.bookings(id) on delete cascade,
 kind text not null check (kind in ('government-id','diploma','certificate','high-school-diploma','english-test','other')),
 file_path text not null unique,
 original_name text not null check (char_length(original_name) between 1 and 200),
 size integer not null check (size > 0 and size <= 10485760),
 mime text not null check (mime in ('application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png')),
 uploaded_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index booking_documents_booking_index on public.booking_documents(booking_id);
create unique index one_government_id_per_booking on public.booking_documents(booking_id) where kind = 'government-id';

alter table public.booking_document_tokens enable row level security;
alter table public.booking_documents enable row level security;
-- No policies: nobody but the service role can touch these tables.
revoke all on public.booking_document_tokens, public.booking_documents from anon, authenticated;

-- 4. A PRIVATE bucket. public = false means there are no public URLs, and with no storage.objects policies for this
-- bucket, signed-in users and anonymous visitors cannot list, read or write it. Staff see files only through
-- signed URLs the server creates, which expire after 5 minutes. Do not add storage policies for this bucket.
insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
values ('booking-documents', 'booking-documents', false, 10485760, array['application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png'])
on conflict (id) do update set public = false, file_size_limit = excluded.file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types = excluded.allowed_mime_types;

-- 5. The confirmation message carries the upload link. Only a template without {documents_link} is changed.
update public.message_templates
set body = replace(body, E'{instructions}\n\n', E'{instructions}\n\nComplete your file before your visit: {documents_link}\n\n')
where id = 'confirmation' and body not like '%{documents_link}%';
```

## supabase/migrations/006_booking_lookup.sql

```sql
-- Booking lookup for patients without an account (/my-booking): a short booking reference, a rate-limited lookup by
-- reference and email, and more than one "Complete your file" link per booking (the lookup page can issue a new one).
-- Run this once in the Supabase SQL editor, after 005_documents.sql.

-- 1. Booking references: 8 characters from the gift card alphabet (no 0, 1, I or O), e.g. 7K2M9QXB. Unique.
-- gen_random_bytes comes from pgcrypto, which Supabase installs in the "extensions" schema.
create or replace function public.new_booking_reference() returns text language plpgsql volatile set search_path=public, extensions as $$
declare alphabet constant text := '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ'; ref text; b bytea;
begin
 loop
  b := gen_random_bytes(8); ref := '';
  for i in 0..7 loop ref := ref || substr(alphabet, (get_byte(b, i) & 31) + 1, 1); end loop;
  exit when not exists (select 1 from bookings where reference = ref);
 end loop;
 return ref;
end;$$;
revoke all on function public.new_booking_reference() from public, anon, authenticated;

alter table public.bookings add column if not exists reference text;
update public.bookings set reference = public.new_booking_reference() where reference is null;
alter table public.bookings alter column reference set default public.new_booking_reference();
alter table public.bookings alter column reference set not null;
alter table public.bookings add constraint bookings_reference_format check (reference ~ '^[2-9A-HJ-NP-Z]{8}$');
create unique index booking_reference_unique on public.bookings(reference);

-- 2. Lookup attempts, counted per hashed IP (the same hash the booking form uses). At most 10 per hour.
create table public.lookup_attempts (
 id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
 request_hash text not null,
 created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index lookup_attempts_hash_index on public.lookup_attempts(request_hash, created_at);
alter table public.lookup_attempts enable row level security;
revoke all on public.lookup_attempts from anon, authenticated;

-- Records the attempt, refuses the 11th within an hour, then returns the booking only when BOTH the reference and the
-- email match. Not found and wrong email look the same to the caller.
create function public.lookup_booking(p_reference text, p_email text, p_request_hash text)
returns setof public.bookings language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
begin
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('lookup:' || p_request_hash));
 delete from lookup_attempts where request_hash = p_request_hash and created_at < now() - interval '1 day';
 if (select count(*) from lookup_attempts where request_hash = p_request_hash and created_at > now() - interval '1 hour') >= 10 then raise exception 'rate limit'; end if;
 insert into lookup_attempts(request_hash) values (p_request_hash);
 return query select * from bookings where reference = upper(p_reference) and email = lower(trim(p_email)) limit 1;
end;$$;
revoke all on function public.lookup_booking(text,text,text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.lookup_booking(text,text,text) to service_role;

-- 3. Several "Complete your file" links per booking: the emailed one and any issued by the lookup page. Submitting
-- through one closes the others (the website does that), and one_government_id_per_booking still allows one ID.
alter table public.booking_document_tokens drop constraint booking_document_tokens_pkey;
alter table public.booking_document_tokens add column id bigint generated always as identity primary key;
create index booking_document_tokens_booking_index on public.booking_document_tokens(booking_id);

-- 4. The confirmation message gives the reference and a "Find my booking" link. Only a template without {reference}
-- is changed.
update public.message_templates
set body = body || E'\n\nYour booking reference is {reference}. Find your booking any time: {lookup_link}'
where id = 'confirmation' and body not like '%{reference}%';
```

## supabase/migrations/007_commission.sql

```sql
-- Calculated affiliate commission. Staff enter what the patient was billed and any discount; the database works out
-- the rest:  net = max(gross − discount − operation cost, 0),  commission = round(net × rate ÷ 100, 2), and only
-- for bookings that came from an affiliate. The affiliate's commission_rate is now the real rate (a percentage).
-- Run this once in the Supabase SQL editor, after 006_booking_lookup.sql.
-- None of these amounts are ever sent to affiliates; they see only their commission.

-- 1. Retail price and operation cost per procedure (service id from lib/config.js). Seeded at 0 until staff fill in
-- Staff admin > Pricing.
create table public.procedure_costs (
 service text primary key check (service in ('eye-exam','contacts','dry-eye','children','testing','styling')),
 retail_price numeric(12,2) not null default 0 check (retail_price >= 0),
 operation_cost numeric(12,2) not null default 0 check (operation_cost >= 0),
 updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
insert into public.procedure_costs (service, retail_price, operation_cost) values
 ('eye-exam',0,0),('contacts',0,0),('dry-eye',0,0),('children',0,0),('testing',0,0),('styling',0,0)
on conflict (service) do nothing;
alter table public.procedure_costs enable row level security;
revoke all on public.procedure_costs from anon, authenticated;

-- 2. The amounts behind each commission. operation_cost and commission_rate are snapshots taken the first time the
-- appointment is completed, so later price or rate changes do not alter an existing calculation.
alter table public.bookings add column if not exists gross_amount numeric(12,2) check (gross_amount is null or gross_amount >= 0);
alter table public.bookings add column if not exists discount_amount numeric(12,2) check (discount_amount is null or discount_amount >= 0);
alter table public.bookings add column if not exists operation_cost numeric(12,2) check (operation_cost is null or operation_cost >= 0);
alter table public.bookings add column if not exists net_amount numeric(12,2) check (net_amount is null or net_amount >= 0);
alter table public.bookings add column if not exists commission_rate numeric(5,2) check (commission_rate is null or commission_rate between 0 and 100);

-- 3. Complete an appointment: mark it Attended and calculate its commission. Paid bookings are locked.
create function public.complete_appointment(p_id uuid, p_gross numeric, p_discount numeric, p_actor uuid)
returns setof public.bookings language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare b bookings; v_gross numeric(12,2); v_discount numeric(12,2); v_cost numeric(12,2); v_rate numeric(5,2); v_net numeric(12,2);
begin
 select * into b from bookings where id = p_id for update;
 if not found then raise exception 'booking not found'; end if;
 if b.payout = 'Paid' then raise exception 'paid bookings are locked'; end if;
 v_gross := round(p_gross, 2); v_discount := round(coalesce(p_discount, 0), 2);
 if v_gross is null or v_gross < 0 or v_gross > 1000000 then raise exception 'invalid gross amount'; end if;
 if v_discount < 0 or v_discount > v_gross then raise exception 'invalid discount'; end if;
 v_cost := coalesce(b.operation_cost, (select operation_cost from procedure_costs where service = b.service), 0);
 if b.affiliate_id is not null then
  v_rate := coalesce(b.commission_rate, (select round(commission_rate, 2) from affiliates where id = b.affiliate_id), 0);
 end if;
 v_net := greatest(v_gross - v_discount - v_cost, 0);
 return query update bookings set status = 'Attended', gross_amount = v_gross, discount_amount = v_discount, operation_cost = v_cost,
  net_amount = v_net, commission_rate = v_rate, commission = case when b.affiliate_id is null then 0 else round(v_net * v_rate / 100, 2) end
 where id = p_id returning *;
 insert into audit_logs(actor_id, action, record_id) values (p_actor, 'complete_appointment', p_id::text);
end;$$;
revoke all on function public.complete_appointment(uuid,numeric,numeric,uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.complete_appointment(uuid,numeric,numeric,uuid) to service_role;
```
