## supabase/schema.sql

```sql
-- Run once in a new Supabase project's SQL Editor. Server API owns all writes.
create extension if not exists pgcrypto;
create table public.affiliates (
 id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), name text not null, slug text not null unique,
 email text not null, bio text not null default '', photo text not null default '/images/affiliate.webp',
 active boolean not null default true, commission_rate numeric not null default 0 check(commission_rate between 0 and 100),
 commission_note text not null default '', created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create table public.profiles (
 id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade, role text not null check(role in ('staff','affiliate')),
 affiliate_id uuid references public.affiliates(id), check((role='affiliate' and affiliate_id is not null) or role='staff')
);
create table public.appointment_slots (start timestamptz primary key, duration integer not null check(duration in (15,30,45,60,90)));
create table public.bookings (
 id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), name text not null, email text not null, phone text not null,
 start timestamptz not null references public.appointment_slots(start), end_time timestamptz not null, duration integer not null,
 service text not null check(service in ('eye-exam','contacts','dry-eye','children','testing','styling')),
 affiliate_id uuid references public.affiliates(id), source text not null check(source in ('Affiliate','Direct','Phone','Walk-in')),
 status text not null default 'Booked' check(status in ('Booked','Attended','No-show','Cancelled')),
 commission numeric(12,2) not null default 0 check(commission>=0), payout text not null default 'Pending' check(payout in ('Pending','Paid')),
 paid_at timestamptz, first_visit boolean not null, insurance text default '', policy_encrypted text,
 brands text default '', sms_consent boolean not null default false, consent_at timestamptz,
 request_hash text, created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create unique index one_active_booking_per_slot on public.bookings(start) where status<>'Cancelled';
alter table public.bookings add constraint no_overlapping_bookings exclude using gist (tstzrange(start,end_time,'[)') with &&) where (status<>'Cancelled');
create index booking_affiliate_index on public.bookings(affiliate_id);
create index booking_rate_index on public.bookings(request_hash,created_at);
create table public.message_templates(id text primary key,subject text not null,body text not null);
insert into public.message_templates values
 ('confirmation','Your Eyecon appointment',E'Hello {name}, your appointment is booked for {date}. {address}\n\n{instructions}\n\n{gift}'),
 ('day-before','Your appointment is tomorrow','Hello {name}, a reminder of your Eyecon appointment: {date}. {address} {gift}'),
 ('same-day','Your appointment is today','Hello {name}, we look forward to seeing you at Eyecon today: {date}. {gift}'),
 ('no-show','Would you like to rebook?','Hello {name}, please contact Eyecon if you would like to arrange another appointment. {phone}');
create table public.audit_logs(id bigint generated always as identity primary key,actor_id uuid,action text not null,record_id text,created_at timestamptz not null default now());
create table public.notification_jobs(id bigint generated always as identity primary key,booking_id uuid references public.bookings(id),kind text not null,status text not null,result jsonb,created_at timestamptz not null default now(),unique(booking_id,kind));
alter table public.affiliates enable row level security;
alter table public.profiles enable row level security;
alter table public.appointment_slots enable row level security;
alter table public.bookings enable row level security;
alter table public.message_templates enable row level security;
alter table public.audit_logs enable row level security;
alter table public.notification_jobs enable row level security;
create policy own_profile on public.profiles for select to authenticated using(id=auth.uid());
-- No client insert/update/delete policies. No anonymous access to patient records.
revoke all on public.affiliates,public.appointment_slots,public.bookings,public.message_templates,public.audit_logs,public.notification_jobs from anon,authenticated;
grant select on public.profiles to authenticated;
create function public.available_slots() returns table(start timestamptz,duration integer) language sql security definer set search_path=public as $$
 select s.start,s.duration from appointment_slots s where s.start>now() and s.start<now()+interval '90 days'
 and not exists(select 1 from bookings b where b.status<>'Cancelled' and tstzrange(b.start,b.end_time,'[)') && tstzrange(s.start,s.start+s.duration*interval '1 minute','[)')) order by s.start limit 500;
$$;
create function public.create_booking(p_name text,p_email text,p_phone text,p_start timestamptz,p_service text,p_affiliate uuid,p_source text,p_first_visit boolean,p_insurance text,p_policy text,p_brands text,p_sms boolean,p_request_hash text)
returns setof public.bookings language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare duration_value integer;
begin
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(coalesce(p_request_hash,p_email)));
 if p_request_hash is not null and (select count(*) from bookings where request_hash=p_request_hash and created_at>now()-interval '1 hour')>=5 then raise exception 'rate limit';end if;
 if p_affiliate is not null and not exists(select 1 from affiliates where id=p_affiliate and active=true) then raise exception 'inactive affiliate';end if;
 select duration into duration_value from appointment_slots where start=p_start and start>now() for update;
 if duration_value is null then raise exception 'unavailable slot';end if;
 return query insert into bookings(name,email,phone,start,end_time,duration,service,affiliate_id,source,first_visit,insurance,policy_encrypted,brands,sms_consent,consent_at,request_hash)
 values(p_name,p_email,p_phone,p_start,p_start+duration_value*interval '1 minute',duration_value,p_service,p_affiliate,p_source,p_first_visit,p_insurance,p_policy,p_brands,p_sms,case when p_sms then now() else null end,p_request_hash) returning *;
end;$$;
create function public.approve_payout(p_ids uuid[],p_actor uuid) returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
begin
 perform 1 from bookings where id=any(p_ids) for update;
 if cardinality(p_ids)=0 or cardinality(p_ids)<>(select count(*) from bookings where id=any(p_ids) and affiliate_id is not null and status='Attended' and commission>0 and payout='Pending') then raise exception 'Invalid payout selection';end if;
 update bookings set payout='Paid',paid_at=now() where id=any(p_ids);
 insert into audit_logs(actor_id,action,record_id) values(p_actor,'approve_payout',array_to_string(p_ids,','));
end;$$;
revoke all on function public.available_slots() from public,anon,authenticated;
revoke all on function public.create_booking(text,text,text,timestamptz,text,uuid,text,boolean,text,text,text,boolean,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
revoke all on function public.approve_payout(uuid[],uuid) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.available_slots() to service_role;
grant execute on function public.create_booking(text,text,text,timestamptz,text,uuid,text,boolean,text,text,text,boolean,text) to service_role;
grant execute on function public.approve_payout(uuid[],uuid) to service_role;
insert into storage.buckets(id,name,public,file_size_limit,allowed_mime_types) values('affiliate-photos','affiliate-photos',true,2097152,array['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp']);
-- Add real availability in Staff admin > Bookings > Add available time.

-- insert into public.profiles(id,role) values('YOUR_AUTH_USER_UUID','staff');
```

```javascript
// Booking lookup (/my-booking)
const LOOKUP_KEYS=['clinicAddress','doctorName','duration','fileComplete','giftCardNumber','reference','service','serviceName','start','status'];
test('booking references are 8 characters from the gift card alphabet and unique',()=>{for(let i=0;i<300;i++)assert.match(bookingReference(),/^[2-9A-HJ-NP-Z]{8}$/);let calls=0;assert.match(bookingReference(()=>++calls<3),/^[2-9A-HJ-NP-Z]{8}$/);assert.equal(calls,3);assert.throws(()=>bookingReference(()=>true));let data=seedDemo();for(const b of data.bookings)assert.match(b.reference,/^[2-9A-HJ-NP-Z]{8}$/);for(let i=1;i<=6;i++)data=applyDemo(data,'booking',validateBooking({...at(data.slots[i]),email:`p${i}@example.com`}),null);const refs=data.bookings.map(b=>b.reference);assert.ok(refs.every(r=>/^[2-9A-HJ-NP-Z]{8}$/.test(r)));assert.equal(new Set(refs).size,refs.length);});
test('lookup needs the reference and the booking email, and gives one answer for not found and wrong email',()=>{const data=seedDemo(),b=data.bookings.find(b=>b.id==='sample-1');const found=demoLookup(data,{reference:b.reference,email:b.email});assert.equal(found.reference,b.reference);assert.deepEqual(demoLookup(data,{reference:' '+b.reference.toLowerCase().slice(0,4)+'-'+b.reference.toLowerCase().slice(4)+' ',email:b.email.toUpperCase()}).reference,b.reference);const wrongEmail=(()=>{try{demoLookup(data,{reference:b.reference,email:'someone@example.com'});}catch(e){return e.message;}})();const unknown=(()=>{try{demoLookup(data,{reference:'ZZZZZZZZ',email:b.email});}catch(e){return e.message;}})();const otherPatients=(()=>{try{demoLookup(data,{reference:b.reference,email:'sample2@example.com'});}catch(e){return e.message;}})();assert.equal(wrongEmail,LOOKUP_NOT_FOUND);assert.equal(unknown,LOOKUP_NOT_FOUND);assert.equal(otherPatients,LOOKUP_NOT_FOUND);assert.throws(()=>validateLookup({reference:'ABC',email:b.email}),/8 letters/);assert.throws(()=>validateLookup({reference:'O0I1O0I1',email:b.email}),/8 letters/);assert.throws(()=>validateLookup({reference:b.reference,email:'not-an-email'}),/email/);});
test('lookup returns only the booking card fields',()=>{const data=seedDemo();for(const b of data.bookings){const view=demoLookup(data,{reference:b.reference,email:b.email});const keys=Object.keys(view).filter(k=>k!=='documentsToken').sort();assert.deepEqual(keys,LOOKUP_KEYS);for(const key of ['email','phone','name','insurance','policy','brands','affiliateId','residencyStatus','documents','commission','payout','id'])assert.equal(key in view,false,key);}const referral=demoLookup(data,{reference:'R6HD3NVU',email:'sample4@example.com'});assert.equal(referral.giftCardNumber,'EYC-AMO-R6HD3N');assert.equal(referral.fileComplete,true);assert.equal(referral.doctorName,doctorName('doctor-2'));const direct=demoLookup(data,{reference:'H3CZ6PLE',email:'sample3@example.com'});assert.equal(direct.giftCardNumber,null);assert.equal(direct.fileComplete,false);assert.equal(direct.status,'No-show');});
test('a Complete your file link is offered only for an upcoming booking that is missing its ID',()=>{const data=seedDemo(),booked=applyDemo(data,'booking',validateBooking(at(data.slots[1])),null),b=booked.bookings[0];const open=demoLookup(booked,{reference:b.reference,email:b.email});assert.equal(open.fileComplete,false);assert.equal(open.documentsToken,b.documentsToken);const done=applyDemo(booked,'documents',{residencyStatus:residencyStatuses[0],files:[doc('government-id')],token:b.documentsToken},null);const complete=demoLookup(done,{reference:b.reference,email:b.email});assert.equal(complete.fileComplete,true);assert.equal('documentsToken' in complete,false);const cancelled=structuredClone(booked);cancelled.bookings[0].status='Cancelled';assert.equal('documentsToken' in demoLookup(cancelled,{reference:b.reference,email:b.email}),false);const past=demoLookup(data,{reference:'H3CZ6PLE',email:'sample3@example.com'});assert.equal('documentsToken' in past,false);});
test('the EMR placeholder returns null, and its data can later override status, doctor and time',async()=>{assert.equal(emrAdapter(),nullEmr);assert.equal(await nullEmr.getAppointment('7K2M9QXB'),null);assert.equal(await nullEmr.syncBooking({}),null);const view=lookupView(seedDemo().bookings[0]);assert.deepEqual(applyEmr(view,null),view);const moved=applyEmr(view,{status:'Cancelled',doctorName:'Dr. EMR Name',start:'2027-01-05T15:00:00Z',duration:45});assert.equal(moved.status,'Cancelled');assert.equal(moved.doctorName,'Dr. EMR Name');assert.equal(moved.start,'2027-01-05T15:00:00.000Z');assert.equal(moved.duration,45);const junk=applyEmr(view,{status:'Rescheduled?',doctorName:'  ',start:'not a date',duration:-5});assert.deepEqual(junk,view);});
test('the reference appears in the confirmation email and calendar event',()=>{const t=defaultTemplates.find(t=>t.id==='confirmation').body;assert.ok(t.includes('{reference}'));assert.ok(t.includes('{lookup_link}'));const ics=calendarFile({...patient,id:'uuid-1',reference:'7K2M9QXB',duration:30});assert.ok(ics.includes('UID:7K2M9QXB@eyecon-appointments'));assert.ok(ics.includes('Booking reference: 7K2M9QXB'));assert.ok(calendarFile({...patient,doctorName:'Dr. EMR Name',reference:'7K2M9QXB'}).includes('with Dr. EMR Name'));});
test('migration 006 adds unique references, a rate-limited lookup and several document links per booking',()=>{const sql=readFileSync(new URL('../supabase/migrations/006_booking_lookup.sql',import.meta.url),'utf8');for(const part of ["'23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ'",'add column if not exists reference text','update public.bookings set reference = public.new_booking_reference() where reference is null','set default public.new_booking_reference()','alter column reference set not null',"check (reference ~ '^[2-9A-HJ-NP-Z]{8}$')",'create unique index booking_reference_unique on public.bookings(reference)','>= 10 then raise exception \'rate limit\'','where reference = upper(p_reference) and email = lower(trim(p_email))','grant execute on function public.lookup_booking(text,text,text) to service_role','drop constraint booking_document_tokens_pkey','{lookup_link}'])assert.ok(sql.includes(part),part);});

// Calculated commission: rate × (billed − operation cost), billed = gross − discount
const staff={role:'staff'};
test('the worked example: $400 billed, $200 operation cost, 10% gives $20',()=>{const c=calculateCommission({gross:400,discount:0,operationCost:200,rate:10});assert.equal(c.billed,400);assert.equal(c.net,200);assert.equal(c.commission,20);});
test('a discount lowers the amount billed, so it lowers net and commission',()=>{const full=calculateCommission({gross:400,operationCost:200,rate:10}),discounted=calculateCommission({gross:400,discount:50,operationCost:200,rate:10});assert.equal(discounted.billed,350);assert.equal(discounted.net,150);assert.equal(discounted.commission,15);assert.ok(discounted.commission<full.commission);});
test('net never goes below 0, so commission is never negative',()=>{const c=calculateCommission({gross:100,operationCost:200,rate:10});assert.equal(c.net,0);assert.equal(c.commission,0);const all=calculateCommission({gross:300,discount:300,operationCost:50,rate:25});assert.equal(all.net,0);assert.equal(all.commission,0);});
test('commission rounds to the cent, and direct bookings earn none',()=>{assert.equal(calculateCommission({gross:333.33,operationCost:0,rate:7.5}).commission,25);assert.equal(calculateCommission({gross:10.05,rate:10}).commission,1.01);assert.equal(calculateCommission({gross:0.1,discount:0,operationCost:0.03,rate:100}).net,0.07);assert.equal(calculateCommission({gross:400,operationCost:200,rate:10,hasAffiliate:false}).commission,0);});
test('staff enter a valid gross and discount; the discount cannot exceed the bill',()=>{assert.deepEqual(validateCompletion({gross:'400',discount:''}),{gross:400,discount:0});assert.throws(()=>validateCompletion({gross:'',discount:0}),/amount billed/);assert.throws(()=>validateCompletion({gross:-1}),/amount billed/);assert.throws(()=>validateCompletion({gross:100,discount:-5}),/discount/);assert.throws(()=>validateCompletion({gross:100,discount:150}),/more than the amount billed/);assert.throws(()=>validateCompletion({gross:2000000}),/amount billed/);assert.deepEqual(validatePricing({retailPrice:'120',operationCost:'45.5'}),{retailPrice:120,operationCost:45.5});assert.throws(()=>validatePricing({retailPrice:-1,operationCost:0}),/retail price/);});
test('affiliates cannot complete appointments or change pricing, and typed commission is gone',()=>{const data=seedDemo();for(const user of [{role:'affiliate',affiliateId:'demo-alex'},null]){assert.throws(()=>applyDemo(data,'complete',{id:'sample-1',gross:400,discount:0},user),/Staff access/);assert.throws(()=>applyDemo(data,'pricing',{service:'eye-exam',retailPrice:1,operationCost:0},user),/Staff access/);}assert.throws(()=>applyDemo(data,'commission',{id:'sample-2',amount:999},staff),/Unknown action/);});
test('completing an appointment calculates commission from the pricing and the affiliate rate',()=>{let data=applyDemo(seedDemo(),'pricing',{service:'eye-exam',retailPrice:400,operationCost:200},staff);assert.deepEqual(data.procedureCosts.find(p=>p.service==='eye-exam'),{...data.procedureCosts.find(p=>p.service==='eye-exam'),retailPrice:400,operationCost:200});const done=applyDemo(data,'complete',{id:'sample-1',gross:400,discount:0},staff),b=done.bookings.find(b=>b.id==='sample-1');assert.equal(b.status,'Attended');assert.equal(b.operationCost,200);assert.equal(b.netAmount,200);assert.equal(b.commissionRate,10);assert.equal(b.commission,20);const discounted=applyDemo(done,'complete',{id:'sample-1',gross:400,discount:100},staff).bookings.find(b=>b.id==='sample-1');assert.equal(discounted.commission,10);const repriced=applyDemo(applyDemo(done,'pricing',{service:'eye-exam',retailPrice:400,operationCost:350},staff),'complete',{id:'sample-1',gross:400,discount:0},staff).bookings.find(b=>b.id==='sample-1');assert.equal(repriced.operationCost,200,'the first operation cost is kept');assert.equal(repriced.commission,20);const direct=applyDemo(data,'complete',{id:'sample-3',gross:400,discount:0},staff).bookings.find(b=>b.id==='sample-3');assert.equal(direct.commission,0);assert.equal(direct.commissionRate,null);assert.throws(()=>applyDemo(data,'complete',{id:'sample-4',gross:400,discount:0},staff),/locked/);assert.throws(()=>applyDemo(data,'complete',{id:'sample-1',gross:400,discount:500},staff),/more than/);});
test('migration 007 calculates commission in the database',()=>{const sql=readFileSync(new URL('../supabase/migrations/007_commission.sql',import.meta.url),'utf8');for(const part of ['create table public.procedure_costs','retail_price numeric(12,2)','operation_cost numeric(12,2)',"('eye-exam',0,0),('contacts',0,0),('dry-eye',0,0),('children',0,0),('testing',0,0),('styling',0,0)",'gross_amount numeric(12,2)','discount_amount numeric(12,2)','net_amount numeric(12,2)','commission_rate numeric(5,2)','create function public.complete_appointment(p_id uuid, p_gross numeric, p_discount numeric, p_actor uuid)',"if b.payout = 'Paid' then raise exception 'paid bookings are locked'",'v_net := greatest(v_gross - v_discount - v_cost, 0)','when b.affiliate_id is null then 0 else round(v_net * v_rate / 100, 2)',"status = 'Attended'","insert into audit_logs(actor_id, action, record_id) values (p_actor, 'complete_appointment'",'grant execute on function public.complete_appointment(uuid,numeric,numeric,uuid) to service_role'])assert.ok(sql.includes(part),part);});

// The affiliate workspace's restricted view
const FORBIDDEN=['gross_amount','discount_amount','operation_cost','net_amount','commission_rate','grossAmount','discountAmount','operationCost','netAmount','commissionRate','email','phone','service','insurance','policy','policy_encrypted','documents','residencyStatus','residency_status','documentsToken','brands','doctor','giftCard','gift_serial','affiliateId','affiliate_id','reference'];
test('affiliate rows never contain procedure amounts, contact details, service, insurance or documents',()=>{let data=seedDemo();data=applyDemo(data,'pricing',{service:'eye-exam',retailPrice:400,operationCost:200},staff);data=applyDemo(data,'complete',{id:'sample-1',gross:400,discount:25},staff);const rows=affiliateRows(data.bookings,'demo-alex');assert.ok(rows.length>=3);assert.ok(data.bookings.find(b=>b.id==='sample-1').grossAmount>0,'the source booking does carry amounts');for(const row of rows){assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(row).sort(),[...AFFILIATE_FIELDS].sort());for(const key of FORBIDDEN)assert.equal(key in row,false,key);}const dbRow={id:'x',name:'Sample P.',status:'Attended',start:'2026-10-01T15:00:00Z',commission:'20.00',payout:'Pending',paid_at:null,email:'a@example.com',phone:'+1',service:'eye-exam',insurance:'X',policy_encrypted:'enc',gross_amount:'400',discount_amount:'0',operation_cost:'200',net_amount:'200',commission_rate:'10',residency_status:'[x]',affiliate_id:'a',reference:'7K2M9QXB',documents:[{}]};const safe=restrictAffiliateRow(dbRow);assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(safe).sort(),[...AFFILIATE_FIELDS].sort());assert.equal(safe.commission,20);for(const key of FORBIDDEN)assert.equal(key in safe,false,key);});
test('the live affiliate query selects only the agreed columns',()=>{assert.equal(AFFILIATE_COLUMNS,'id,name,status,start,commission,payout,paid_at');for(const key of FORBIDDEN)assert.equal(AFFILIATE_COLUMNS.split(',').includes(key),false,key);const route=readFileSync(new URL('../app/api/workspace/route.js',import.meta.url),'utf8');const branch=route.slice(route.indexOf("if(u.role==='affiliate'){"),route.indexOf('requireStaff(u);'));assert.ok(branch.includes(".from('bookings').select(AFFILIATE_COLUMNS)"));assert.ok(branch.includes('bookings:b.data.map(restrictAffiliateRow)'));for(const t of ['booking_documents','procedure_costs',"select('*').eq('affiliate_id'"])assert.equal(branch.includes(t),false,t);});
test('booked referrals are excluded from completed counts and earnings',()=>{const now=new Date('2026-10-14T12:00:00Z'),row=(status,start,commission=0,payout='Pending')=>({id:status+start,name:'P',status,start,commission,payout,paidAt:null});const rows=[row('Attended','2026-10-03T15:00:00Z',20),row('Attended','2026-09-10T15:00:00Z',30,'Paid'),row('Booked','2026-10-20T15:00:00Z',99),row('Booked','2026-10-05T15:00:00Z',5),row('No-show','2026-10-06T15:00:00Z',7),row('Cancelled','2026-10-21T15:00:00Z')];const st=affiliateStats(rows,now);assert.equal(st.completedThisMonth,1);assert.equal(st.completedAllTime,2);assert.equal(st.upcoming,1);assert.equal(st.earned,50);assert.equal(st.paid,30);assert.equal(st.awaitingPayment,20);const csvRows=affiliateCsvRows(rows);for(const r of csvRows)assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(r),AFFILIATE_CSV_FIELDS);assert.equal(csvRows[0].yourCommission,'20.00');assert.equal(csvRows[2].yourCommission,'');assert.equal(csvRows[4].yourCommission,'');});

// Staff affiliate performance dashboard
const perfNow=new Date('2026-10-14T12:00:00Z');
const perfBooking=(id,affiliateId,status,start,extra={})=>({id,affiliateId,name:'P '+id,email:id+'@example.com',phone:'+1',service:'eye-exam',doctor:'doctor-1',source:'Affiliate',status,start,commission:0,payout:'Pending',paidAt:null,grossAmount:null,discountAmount:null,operationCost:null,netAmount:null,commissionRate:null,...extra});
const perfAffiliates=[{id:'a1',name:'Avery',slug:'avery'},{id:'a2',name:'Blake',slug:'blake'},{id:'a3',name:'Casey',slug:'casey'}];
const perfBookings=[
  perfBooking('1','a1','Attended','2026-10-02T15:00:00Z',{grossAmount:400,discountAmount:0,operationCost:200,netAmount:200,commissionRate:10,commission:20}),
  perfBooking('2','a1','Attended','2026-09-12T15:00:00Z',{grossAmount:500,discountAmount:50,operationCost:150,netAmount:300,commissionRate:10,commission:30,payout:'Paid',paidAt:'2026-09-30T15:00:00Z'}),
  perfBooking('3','a1','Booked','2026-10-20T15:00:00Z'),
  perfBooking('4','a1','No-show','2026-10-05T15:00:00Z'),
  perfBooking('5','a2','Attended','2026-10-06T15:00:00Z',{grossAmount:1000,discountAmount:100,operationCost:100,netAmount:800,commissionRate:10,commission:80}),
  perfBooking('6','a2','Attended','2026-10-08T15:00:00Z',{grossAmount:300,discountAmount:0,operationCost:100,netAmount:200,commissionRate:10,commission:20}),
  perfBooking('7',null,'Attended','2026-10-06T15:00:00Z',{grossAmount:999,commission:0})
];
test('affiliate performance counts completed referrals, billed amounts and commission by payout',()=>{const a=affiliatePerformance(perfAffiliates[0],perfBookings,perfNow);assert.equal(a.total,4);assert.equal(a.completed,2);assert.equal(a.upcoming,1);assert.equal(a.billed,850,'(400 − 0) + (500 − 50), completed referrals only');assert.equal(a.pending,20);assert.equal(a.paid,30);assert.equal(a.completedThisMonth,1);assert.equal(a.commissionThisMonth,20);const c=affiliatePerformance(perfAffiliates[2],perfBookings,perfNow);assert.deepEqual([c.total,c.completed,c.upcoming,c.billed,c.pending,c.paid],[0,0,0,0,0,0]);});
test('the affiliates table sorts by completed and by commission',()=>{const names=sort=>performanceTable(perfAffiliates,perfBookings,sort,perfNow).map(p=>p.affiliate.name);assert.deepEqual(names({key:'completed',dir:'desc'}),['Avery','Blake','Casey']);assert.deepEqual(names({key:'completed',dir:'asc'}),['Casey','Avery','Blake']);assert.deepEqual(names({key:'pending',dir:'desc'}),['Blake','Avery','Casey']);assert.deepEqual(names({key:'paid',dir:'desc'}),['Avery','Blake','Casey']);assert.deepEqual(names({key:'commission',dir:'desc'}),['Blake','Avery','Casey']);});
test('top affiliates this month ranks by completed referrals, then commission',()=>{const top=topAffiliates(perfAffiliates,perfBookings,perfNow);assert.deepEqual(top.map(p=>[p.affiliate.name,p.completedThisMonth,p.commissionThisMonth]),[['Blake',2,100],['Avery',1,20]]);assert.deepEqual(topAffiliates(perfAffiliates,perfBookings,new Date('2027-03-01T12:00:00Z')),[]);});
test('appointment filters use an inclusive date range and status',()=>{const own=perfBookings.filter(b=>b.affiliateId==='a1');assert.deepEqual(filterAppointments(own,{from:'2026-10-01',to:'2026-10-05'}).map(b=>b.id),['1','4']);assert.deepEqual(filterAppointments(own,{from:'2026-10-02',to:'2026-10-02'}).map(b=>b.id),['1']);assert.deepEqual(filterAppointments(own,{status:'Attended'}).map(b=>b.id),['1','2']);assert.deepEqual(filterAppointments(own,{from:'2026-10-01',status:'Booked'}).map(b=>b.id),['3']);assert.equal(filterAppointments(own,{}).length,4);});
test('the staff appointment CSV carries every staff field, amounts included',()=>{const [row]=staffAppointmentRows([perfBookings[1]]);assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(row),STAFF_APPOINTMENT_FIELDS);assert.equal(row.gross,'500.00');assert.equal(row.discount,'50.00');assert.equal(row.billed,'450.00');assert.equal(row.operationCost,'150.00');assert.equal(row.net,'300.00');assert.equal(row.rate,'10');assert.equal(row.commission,'30.00');assert.equal(row.email,'2@example.com');assert.equal(row.service,'Comprehensive eye exam');const [open]=staffAppointmentRows([perfBookings[2]]);assert.equal(open.gross,'');assert.equal(open.billed,'');});
test('preview as affiliate shows only the restricted rows',()=>{const rows=affiliateRows(perfBookings,'a1');assert.equal(rows.length,4);for(const row of rows)assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(row).sort(),[...AFFILIATE_FIELDS].sort());});

// Non-Invasive Skin Tightening, its technologies, and Shop frames
test('skin tightening is a service with bracketed placeholder content, an icon and a neutral image',()=>{const st=services.find(s=>s.id==='skin-tightening');assert.ok(st);assert.equal(st.name,'Non-Invasive Skin Tightening');for(const text of [st.description,st.meta,...st.points])assert.match(text,/\[[^\]]+\]/,text);assert.equal(st.icon,'skin');assert.ok(readFileSync(new URL('../components/ui.js',import.meta.url),'utf8').includes('skin:<>'));assert.ok(readFileSync(new URL('../public/images/services/skin-tightening.webp',import.meta.url)).subarray(8,12).toString()==='WEBP');});
test('skin technologies are three bracketed placeholders with unique slugs',()=>{assert.equal(skinTechnologies.length,3);assert.equal(new Set(skinTechnologies.map(t=>t.slug)).size,3);for(const t of skinTechnologies){assert.match(t.slug,/^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/);for(const k of ['name','summary','session'])assert.match(t[k],/\[[^\]]+\]/,k);assert.ok(t.image.startsWith('/images/'));}assert.equal(serviceOptions['skin-tightening'],skinTechnologies);assert.equal(serviceOptionName('skin-tightening','technology-2'),'[Technology two]');assert.equal(serviceOptionName('eye-exam','technology-2'),'');});
test('a technology is optional, kept only for skin tightening, and saved with the booking',()=>{const skin={...patient,service:'skin-tightening'};assert.equal(validateBooking(skin).serviceOption,null);assert.equal(validateBooking({...skin,serviceOption:'technology-1'}).serviceOption,'technology-1');assert.equal(validateBooking({...skin,serviceOption:'laser-9000'}).serviceOption,null);assert.equal(validateBooking({...patient,serviceOption:'technology-1'}).serviceOption,null,'not kept for another service');const data=seedDemo();const saved=applyDemo(data,'booking',validateBooking({...at(data.slots[1]),service:'skin-tightening',serviceOption:'technology-3'}),null).bookings[0];assert.equal(saved.service,'skin-tightening');assert.equal(saved.serviceOption,'technology-3');assert.ok(seedDemo().procedureCosts.some(p=>p.service==='skin-tightening'));for(const key of ['serviceOption','service_option'])assert.equal(key in restrictAffiliateRow({...saved,service_option:'technology-3'}),false);});
// Phone header: menu button, centred logo, and a drawer with Book, Shop Frames, the phone and the location
test('on phones the header is a menu button and a centred logo, and the drawer holds Book, Shop Frames, phone and location',()=>{
  const read=f=>readFileSync(new URL(f,import.meta.url),'utf8');
  const ui=read('../components/ui.js'),css=read('../app/site.css');
  const menu=ui.slice(ui.indexOf('function MobileMenu'),ui.indexOf('export function Header'));
  for(const part of ['href={bookingHref}','href={shopHref}','>Shop Frames<','clinic.phoneHref','google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=','Phone to be confirmed','Address to be confirmed','aria-label="Close menu"','showModal()'])assert.ok(menu.includes(part),part);
  const header=ui.slice(ui.indexOf('export function Header'),ui.indexOf('export function PreviewBar'));
  assert.ok(header.indexOf('className="menu-toggle"')<header.indexOf('<Logo/>'),'menu button sits left of the logo');
  assert.ok(header.indexOf('</header>')<header.indexOf('<MobileMenu'),'drawer sits outside the header so the overlay never tints it');
  assert.ok(css.includes('.menu-toggle, .menu-spacer { display: none; }'),'wider screens never show the menu button');
  assert.match(css,/@media \(max-width: 640px\) \{\s*\.site-header \.header-inner \{ display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr 44px;[^}]*\}\s*\.site-header \.header-actions \{ display: none; \}/);
  assert.ok(css.includes('.site-header .logo { justify-self: center;'));
  assert.ok(ui.includes(',pin:<>'),'location pin icon');
});
// Shop Frames page
test('Shop frames points at the /shop page by default, from the header and under the carousel',()=>{
  const read=f=>readFileSync(new URL(f,import.meta.url),'utf8');
  assert.equal(shopUrl,'/shop');
  const ui=read('../components/ui.js'),landing=read('../components/landing.js'),css=read('../app/site.css');
  const header=ui.slice(ui.indexOf('export function Header'),ui.indexOf('export function PreviewBar'));
  assert.ok(header.indexOf('shop-link')<header.indexOf('clinic.phoneHref'),'Shop Frames sits before the phone link');
  for(const part of ['<Icon name="bag" size={18}/><span className="shop-long">','>Shop Frames<','>Frames<','href={shopHref}'])assert.ok(header.includes(part),part);
  assert.match(css,/@media \(max-width: 639px\) \{\s*\.shop-link \.shop-long \{ display: none; \}\s*\.shop-link \.shop-short \{ display: inline; \}/);
  assert.ok(css.includes('  .header-actions .shop-link { gap: .3rem; }'),'bag icon sits closer to Frames on small phones so the header fits at 360px');
  assert.ok(landing.includes('className="collections-more"')&&landing.includes('Shop all frames'));
  assert.ok(css.includes('/* Shop */'));
});
test('the Shop page has its own title, heading and components file',()=>{
  const read=f=>readFileSync(new URL(f,import.meta.url),'utf8');

test('saved frames never throw, whatever the browser storage does',()=>{
  const store=(value)=>{const s={v:value,getItem:()=>s.v,setItem:(k,v)=>{s.v=v;}};return s;};
  const throwing={getItem(){throw new Error('blocked');},setItem(){throw new Error('quota');}};
  assert.deepEqual(readSavedFrames(store(null)),[]);assert.deepEqual(readSavedFrames(store('{bad')),[]);assert.deepEqual(readSavedFrames(store('{"a":1}')),[]);
  assert.deepEqual(readSavedFrames(store('["dita-mach-one",3]')),['dita-mach-one']);
  assert.deepEqual(readSavedFrames(throwing),[]);assert.deepEqual(readSavedFrames(null),[]);assert.equal(writeSavedFrames(throwing,['x']),false);
  const s=store(null);assert.equal(writeSavedFrames(s,['dita-mach-one']),true);assert.equal(s.getItem(SAVED_FRAMES_KEY),'["dita-mach-one"]');
  assert.deepEqual(toggleSaved(['a'],'b'),['a','b']);assert.deepEqual(toggleSaved(['a','b'],'a'),['b']);
  const shop=readFileSync(new URL('../components/shop.js',import.meta.url),'utf8');
  assert.ok(shop.includes('try { return window.localStorage; } catch { return null; }'));assert.ok(shop.includes('aria-pressed={saved}'));
});

test('the houses follow collections: banners alone, tiles in rows of three, closing tiles fill and end the page',()=>{
  const shape=groups=>groups.map(g=>g.type+':'+g.items.map(i=>i.closing?'+'+i.closing:i.slug).join(','));
  assert.deepEqual(shape(brandGroups()),['banner:cartier','banner:chrome-hearts','tiles:gucci,lindberg,dita','banner:tom-ford','banner:maybach','tiles:maui-jim,ray-ban,oakley','banner:dior','banner:tiffany-and-co','tiles:prada,versace,celine','tiles:bottega-veneta,+styling,+visit']);
  const groups=brandGroups();
  assert.deepEqual(groups.map(g=>g.type==='banner'?'B':'T'+g.items.length).join(' '),'B B T3 B B T3 B B T3 T3','pairs of banners between full rows of three');
  assert.ok(groups.slice(0,-1).every(g=>g.type==='banner'||g.items.every(i=>!i.closing)),'no short or filled row mid-page');
  const b=slug=>({slug,layout:'banner'}),t=slug=>({slug,layout:'tile'});
  assert.deepEqual(shape(brandGroups([b('a')])),['banner:a','tiles:+styling,+visit'],'always closes the page');
  assert.deepEqual(shape(brandGroups([t('a'),t('b'),t('c'),t('d'),b('e')])),['tiles:a,b,c','tiles:d,+styling,+visit','banner:e','tiles:+styling,+visit'],'four tiles make a full row and a filled one');
  assert.deepEqual(shape(brandGroups([t('a'),t('b'),t('c')])),['tiles:a,b,c','tiles:+styling,+visit']);
  assert.deepEqual(shape(brandGroups([t('a'),t('b')])),['tiles:a,b,+styling','tiles:+visit'],'a short last row still ends with both');
  assert.deepEqual(shape(brandGroups([])),['tiles:+styling,+visit']);
  assert.deepEqual(CLOSING_TILES,['styling','visit']);
});

test('house photographs: art-directed banners, brand photos on tiles and phones, fallback and alt text',()=>{
  const read=f=>readFileSync(new URL(f,import.meta.url),'utf8');
  const shop=read('../components/shop.js'),photo=read('../components/photo.js'),css=read('../app/site.css').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
  for(const part of ["'/images/shop/banners/' + brand.slug","art + '-desktop.webp'","mobile={'/images/brands/' + brand.slug + '.webp'}","'/images/brands/' + brand.slug + '.webp'",'<BrandPhoto brand={brand} sizes="(max-width: 640px) 78vw, 33vw" />'])assert.ok(shop.includes(part),part);
  assert.ok(!shop.includes('shop/tiles')&&!shop.includes("art + '-mobile.webp'"),'tiles and phone banners use the brand photo');
  assert.equal((shop.match(/alt=\{brand\.name \+ ' eyewear'\}/g)||[]).length,2,'banner and brand photo alt');
  assert.ok(photo.includes('<source media="(max-width: 640px)" srcSet={narrow} />')&&photo.includes('onError={fail}'));
  for(const c of collections)assert.ok(readFileSync(new URL('../public/images/brands/'+c.slug+'.webp',import.meta.url)).length>0,c.slug+' brand photo exists');
  for(const c of collections.filter(c=>c.layout==='banner'))assert.ok(readFileSync(new URL('../public/images/shop/banners/'+c.slug+'-desktop.webp',import.meta.url)).length>0,c.slug+' desktop banner exists');
  for(const f of ['../components/shop.js','../components/landing.js'])assert.ok(read(f).includes('<small>Photograph to follow</small></span></Photo>'),f+' shows the placeholder while a photograph is missing');
  assert.ok(css.includes('aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; max-height: 80vh;'));
  assert.ok(css.includes('.houses { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0;'),'banners touch each other and the tile row below');
  assert.ok(css.includes('.houses .house-row { padding-block: clamp(40px, 4vw, 64px); }\n.houses .house-row + .house-row { padding-top: 0; }'),'room above and below each tile row, one gap between two rows');
  assert.match(css,/@media \(max-width: 640px\) \{[^}]*\.houses \.house-row \{ padding-block: 32px; \}/,'32px on phones');
  assert.ok(!/\.shop-banner \+ \.shop-banner|\.shop-banner \{[^}]*margin: (?!0;)/.test(css),'banners still touch');
  assert.ok(css.includes('.house-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 24px);'),'desktop gutter about 1.5vw, never more than 24px');
  assert.ok(css.includes('.house-tiles { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding-inline: 16px;'),'phone swipe row gutter 12px');
  assert.ok(css.includes('.house-row { width: min(1250px, calc(100% - 3rem)); margin-inline: auto; }'),'tile rows centred at the page content width');
  assert.match(css,/@media \(max-width: 640px\) \{\s*\.houses[^}]*\}[\s\S]*?\.shop-banner-media \{ aspect-ratio: 4 \/ 5; max-height: none; \}[\s\S]*?\.shop-banner-text \{ position: static;[\s\S]*?\.house-tile \{ flex: 0 0 74vw;/);
  assert.match(css,/@media \(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce\) \{\s*\.house-media img \{ transition: none; \}/);
  assert.ok(css.includes('.frame-card { position: relative;')&&css.includes('.house-tile { position: relative;'),'cards contain their screen-reader labels, so a scroll row never widens the page');
});

// The logo mark
test('the logo mark is a decorative gold outlined 3:2 rectangle, deeper gold on light backgrounds',()=>{
  const read=f=>readFileSync(new URL(f,import.meta.url),'utf8');
  const ui=read('../components/ui.js'),css=read('../app/site.css'),icon=read('../app/icon.svg');
  const start=ui.indexOf('export function Logo'),logo=ui.slice(start,ui.indexOf('</Link>;}',start));
  assert.ok(logo.includes('aria-label="Eyecon Optometry home"'));
  assert.ok(logo.includes('<svg className="logo-mark" viewBox="0 0 30 20" aria-hidden="true"'),'decorative inline SVG, 3:2');
  assert.ok(logo.includes('<rect x="1" y="1" width="28" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2"/>'),'outline, no fill');
  const rule=css.slice(css.indexOf('.logo-mark {'),css.indexOf('}',css.indexOf('.logo-mark {')));
  assert.ok(rule.includes('color: var(--gold-text)'),'deep gold on light backgrounds');
  assert.ok(!rule.includes('#'),'no new hex code');
  assert.ok(css.includes('.site-header.overlay:not(.scrolled) .logo-mark, .login-editorial .logo-mark { color: var(--gold); }'),'accent gold on dark backgrounds');
  assert.ok(icon.includes('<rect x="14" y="20" width="36" height="24" fill="none" stroke="#b49a67"'),'tab icon is the gold rectangle');
  assert.ok(ui.includes('aria-label={bookingLabel}'),'the short phone button keeps its full accessible name');
});

// Eyecon's real reviews
test('the real reviews are the ten supplied Google reviews, word for word, shown in both modes',async()=>{
  const { reviews, mentions, siteContent } = await import('../lib/config.js');
  assert.equal(reviews.length,10);
  assert.deepEqual(reviews.map(r=>r.name),['Charise S.','Nirvana','Thinh T.','Lilian E.','Matthew A.','Intermilan07','Liubov P.','Lynna J.','Kevin T.','Ram V.']);
  for(const r of reviews){assert.equal(r.source,'Google');assert.equal(r.stars,5);assert.ok(r.service);assert.ok(/^[A-Z][a-z]+ [A-Z]\.$/.test(r.name)||!r.name.includes(' '),'first name and last initial, or a username: '+r.name);}
  // Exactly as written, including the reviewers' own typos.
  assert.ok(reviews.find(r=>r.name==='Thinh T.').text.includes('repaired no one time, and no hassle I was helped'));
  assert.ok(reviews.find(r=>r.name==='Ram V.').text.includes('pleased with with the service'));
  assert.ok(reviews.find(r=>r.name==='Lynna J.').text.includes('finding the me some cool'));
  assert.ok(reviews.find(r=>r.name==='Nirvana').text.includes('professional — he fixed them'));
  assert.equal(reviews.find(r=>r.name==='Kevin T.').service,"Children's exam");
  for(const demo of [true,false]){const c=siteContent(demo);assert.equal(c.reviews.items,reviews);assert.equal(c.reviews.sample,false);assert.equal(c.mentions.sample,false);}
  assert.deepEqual(mentions,['Thorough eye exams','High-end selection','Friendly, knowledgeable staff','Great with kids','No wait time','Free adjustments']);
});
test('the featured quote opens on Kevin T., then Lilian E., then Ram V.',async()=>{

  assert.deepEqual(ordered.slice(3).map(r=>r.name),['Charise S.','Nirvana','Thinh T.','Matthew A.','Intermilan07','Liubov P.','Lynna J.'],'the rest keep their order');
});
test('long featured reviews show a whole-word excerpt ending in an ellipsis; short ones are unchanged',async()=>{
  const { reviews } = await import('../lib/config.js');
  for(const r of reviews){
    const e=excerpt(r.text);
    if(r.text.length<=EXCERPT_LENGTH){assert.equal(e,r.text);continue;}
    assert.ok(e.endsWith('…'));assert.ok(e.length<=EXCERPT_LENGTH,r.name+' '+e.length);
    const body=e.slice(0,-1);assert.ok(r.text.startsWith(body),'a prefix of the full text');
    assert.ok(/[\s,;:.—-]/.test(r.text[body.length])||/[,;:.]/.test(r.text.slice(body.length,body.length+1)),'ends on a whole word: '+r.name);
  }
  assert.equal(excerpt('Short and sweet.'),'Short and sweet.');
  assert.ok(reviews.filter(r=>r.text.length>EXCERPT_LENGTH).length>=5,'several reviews need the toggle');
});

});
```

# README.md — complete setup instructions

Save the following full contents as `README.md`. These instructions follow the source as requested.

# Eyecon Optometry — Module 1

A complete Next.js project for the affiliate referral and appointment-booking experience. Open it in VS Code and deploy it to Vercel. The default is an interactive **demo**: no accounts, API keys or database are needed to explore it.

## What is included

- Premium public landing page and personalised affiliate landing pages, with “Shop Frames” in the header on tablets and desktops, the appointments section and a “Shop all frames →” link under the collections carousel. They go to `shopUrl` in `lib/config.js` (or `NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOP_URL`), which is `/shop` by default.
- On phones (640px and narrower) the site header is a menu button on the left and the Eyecon logo with its mark centred; the menu opens a drawer from the left with Book appointment, Shop Frames, the clinic phone (tap to call) and the address (opens Google Maps). Tablets and desktops keep Shop Frames, the phone and Book appointment in the header.
- Shop Frames page at `/shop`, a boutique page for the houses Eyecon carries and featured frames. It opens with a photo header (`public/images/shop/hero-desktop.webp`, and `hero-mobile.webp` on phones): white words in the left third over a dark panel with the photograph on the right two-thirds, under the white overlay site header; on phones the words sit above the 4:5 photograph. If the photograph is missing the plain centred heading shows instead. Then comes a “Featured this week” row: a scroll-snap row of frame cards (4 with the next peeking on desktop, 1½ on phones), arrows and arrow keys, a “New” tag, a heart that saves the frame in this browser, and “Reserve to try”, which books a styling visit with the brand chosen. Photographs go in `public/images/shop/frames/[slug].webp`; until then each card shows “Photograph to follow”, and demo mode labels the row “Sample selection”. Below it come the houses, in `collections` order: each `banner` brand is a full-width photograph (`public/images/shop/banners/[slug]-desktop.webp`; phones use the brand photograph `public/images/brands/[slug].webp`) with its tagline and “Shop the collection”, and consecutive `tile` brands form rows of three (`public/images/brands/[slug].webp`, the carousel photograph) with “Discover”; both fall back to the carousel photograph. On phones banners put their words below a 4:5 photograph and tile rows swipe with a “1 / 3” counter. Short tile rows are filled by, and the page always ends with, “Book a styling visit” and “Visit the boutique” (Get directions opens Google Maps once the clinic address is set). Each brand has its own page at `/shop/[slug]` (built ahead for every brand; it reads `?affiliate=` in the browser so the pages stay static) with “← All frames”, the banner, the blurb, a grid of that brand’s frames (4 columns, 2 on tablets and phones; “New pieces arriving soon” while it has none) and “Want to try [Brand] in person?”. the brands (`collections`, with a tagline, blurb and banner or tile layout each) and six sample frames (`frames`, to replace with frames Eyecon stocks; a price shows only once filled in) are in `lib/config.js`. Opened with `?affiliate=SLUG`, every booking link on the page carries the same affiliate (`withAffiliate` in `lib/affiliate.js`), and an affiliate landing page passes its referral on to the shop links.
- Non-Invasive Skin Tightening as a service, with its technologies (`skinTechnologies` in `lib/config.js`, bracketed placeholders until the clinic supplies them) shown as a swipeable, keyboard-friendly row of cards in the home page panel and booking step 1. Choosing a technology is optional and is saved with the booking.
- “In their words” on the home page and the booking page’s left column show Eyecon’s real Google reviews (in `lib/config.js`, word for word, featured ones first). Long featured reviews show an excerpt with “Read full review”; review cards clamp to four lines and open on click. Until the clinic sets its real Google rating and review count, demo mode shows a sample rating labelled “Sample rating”; live mode shows none.
- Four-step booking: service, optometrist and time, patient details and confirmation. Every appointment belongs to one optometrist. Patients either choose an optometrist first (their photo, name and focus, then that optometrist's days and times) or a time first (each time shows which optometrists are free; when more than one is, the patient picks). Two optometrists can see patients at the same time; one optometrist cannot be double-booked.
- “Complete your file” after booking: residency status, one valid government ID and optional tagged documents (diploma, certificate, high school diploma, English language test result, other). PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB each and 8 files, checked by file signature on the server. Patients can skip and finish later from the single-use, expiring link in their confirmation email (`{documents_link}`). Files go to a private storage bucket; staff open them through links that expire after 5 minutes; affiliates never see them. In demo mode only file names and sizes are kept, in the browser.
- “Find my booking” at `/my-booking` for patients without an account: booking reference (8 characters, e.g. 7K2M9QXB) plus the booking email. Shows the booking card, add-to-calendar buttons, the gift card number, a “Complete your file” link while the ID is missing, and a line to call the clinic for changes. Turnstile, a honeypot and 10 attempts per IP per hour; not found and wrong email give the same answer. Linked from the footer and the confirmation email (`{reference}`, `{lookup_link}`).
- EMR placeholder (`lib/emr.js`): an adapter with `getAppointment(reference)` and `syncBooking(booking)` that returns null until the clinic confirms its EMR vendor. The lookup already lets EMR data override status, doctor and time.
- Referral identity throughout booking; the $50 gift appears only with an active affiliate referral.
- Google, Apple `.ics` and Outlook calendar options. The event, the confirmation card and the confirmation email (template field `{doctor}`) name the optometrist.
- Affiliate dashboard (completed referrals this month and all time, upcoming bookings as a count that “counts once completed”, commission earned and paid), referrals, referral link/QR, earnings, profile editing and photo upload. A referral counts, and earns commission, only once its appointment is completed (Attended).
- Staff booking list/calendar showing each booking's optometrist, patient details, attendance status, manual bookings (free times grouped by optometrist), availability per optometrist, affiliate performance dashboard (per-affiliate bookings, completed, upcoming, billed and commission, sortable; a page per affiliate with every appointment amount, inline commission calculator, date and status filters, staff CSV, and “Preview as affiliate”; “Top affiliates this month” on the overview), leads, procedure pricing, calculated commission, payout recording and message templates.
- Supabase database schema, authentication and server-side role checks for live mode.
- Turnstile booking verification, optional Resend email, Twilio SMS with opt-in, and an authenticated reminder endpoint.
- Responsive layouts, keyboard controls, native form labels, focus handling, reduced-motion support and optimised local WebP images.

## Scope and launch status

This implements **Module 1**, the referral/booking platform. It does not implement the later e-commerce, lens builder, virtual try-on, AI concierge, patient portal or MyVisionExpress modules.

The grayscale photography is concept imagery from the design mockup. Doctor panels are explicitly marked as preview content; use approved real portraits, credentials, biographies and photography before launch. Clinic contact details, hours, verified reviews, insurance wording, appointment durations and gift eligibility need confirmation. No invented ratings or testimonials are included. Commission is calculated, never typed: the affiliate’s commission rate × net, where net = amount billed to the patient (gross − discount) − the procedure’s operation cost, never below $0. Example: $400 billed, $200 operation cost → $200 net → 10% → $20. Retail prices and operation costs start at $0 and must be entered in Staff admin > Pricing. Payout recording is a ledger update, not a bank transfer.

Demo data is stored in the current browser and is neither secure nor shared between users. Use fictional details only. Live mode uses Supabase and must be configured and verified with your own services before collecting real patient information. This delivery does not certify privacy compliance, WCAG conformance, production security or a PageSpeed score. No live service credentials were available during development.

| Address | Page |

| `/book/alex-morgan` | Example affiliate landing page in demo mode |

| `/shop/[slug]` | A brand’s page, e.g. `/shop/cartier`: its banner, blurb, its frames and “Book a styling visit”. Built at build time for every brand in `collections`; other slugs are not found |

An unknown or inactive affiliate page presents a direct-booking alternative. Affiliate workspaces show only each referral’s patient name, appointment date, status, the affiliate’s own commission and its payout (`lib/affiliate.js`). Contact details, service type, insurance, documents, residency status and every procedure amount (gross, discount, operation cost, net) and per-booking rate are never sent to affiliates; the live API selects only the allowed columns and the demo applies the same filter.

## 1. Create/open the project in VS Code

1. Install the current Node.js **LTS** release from [nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/download). The project requires Node 20.9 or later; use a currently supported LTS release.
2. Install [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/download) and [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads).
3. Download and extract `Eyecon_Module_1_Nextjs.zip`. You will see a folder named `eyecon-module-1` containing `package.json`.
4. In VS Code choose **File → Open Folder**, then open that folder. Do not open the folder above it.
5. In the VS Code file list, duplicate `.env.example` and name the copy `.env.local`. Keep `NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true` for now. No other values are needed for the local demo.

If you prefer to create files manually: make an empty folder named `eyecon-module-1`, open it in VS Code, create each path from `SOURCE_CODE.md`, and paste the complete file contents from its matching code block. Paths and capitalisation must match exactly. The guide includes a complete Base64 asset restoration command for the four WebP images. `package-lock.json` is supplied; do not create `node_modules` or `.next` yourself. The ZIP is the easiest option.

## 2. Terminal commands

Choose **Terminal → New Terminal** in VS Code. It should open inside the project folder. Run one command at a time:

```bash
node --version
npm --version
npm install
npm run dev
```

- `node --version` and `npm --version` confirm the required tools are installed.
- `npm install` downloads the dependencies listed in `package.json`. It creates `node_modules`.
- `npm run dev` starts the local development server and updates the preview when you save a file.

Leave that terminal running. Press **Ctrl+C** when you want to stop it.

Other useful commands, run after stopping the development server:

```bash
npm test
npm run build
npm run start
```

`npm test` checks booking validation, per-optometrist booking and overlap protection, affiliate data filtering, payout guards, CSV handling and calendars. `npm run build` prepares and checks the production build. `npm run start` runs that production build locally. To reproduce the pinned installation later, use `npm ci` in place of `npm install`.

## 3. Preview and explore locally

1. Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser, or use the URL printed in the terminal if port 3000 is occupied.
2. Visit [the example affiliate page](http://localhost:3000/book/alex-morgan), choose a service and finish a booking with **fictional** patient details.
3. Open `/login`, click **Explore affiliate demo**, then explore Referrals, My link & QR, Earnings and Profile.
4. Open `/login` again and click **Explore staff demo**. Set a retail price and operation cost in Pricing. Change a booking to Attended, open **Calculate** in Payouts, enter the amount billed and any discount, save, and record a payment. These actions change only sample data in your browser.
5. Use **Reset demo data** at `/login` to restore the examples and refresh the demo availability dates.
6. To inspect mobile layout, narrow your browser window or use your browser's device toolbar. Check the public page, each booking step and both dashboards.

The demo is intentionally not an authentication system. Each browser has its own records. No emails/SMS are sent, and real staff credentials are not used.

## 4. Put the project on GitHub

The simplest route is [GitHub Desktop](https://desktop.github.com/): choose **File → Add local repository**, select the project folder, create a repository if prompted, then **Publish repository**. Choose a private repository if that suits your project.

For the terminal route, create a new empty repository on [GitHub](https://github.com/new), named `eyecon-module-1`. Do not initialise that remote repository with a README, licence or `.gitignore`; those files already exist locally. Copy its HTTPS URL. In the VS Code terminal run:

```bash
git init
git add .
git commit -m "Build Eyecon Module 1"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/eyecon-module-1.git
git push -u origin main
```

Replace `YOUR-USERNAME` with your actual GitHub username. `git init` starts version history; `git add` selects the files; `git commit` saves a version; `git branch` names the branch; `git remote` connects the repository; `git push` uploads it. Complete GitHub's sign-in prompt. Do not use your account password as a Git HTTPS password.

Check the uploaded file list: `.env.local`, `.next` and `node_modules` must not appear. The included `.gitignore` excludes them. `.env.example` contains no secrets and is safe to commit. To upload later edits:

```bash
git add .
git commit -m "Update Eyecon pages"
git push
```

## 5. Connect GitHub to Vercel and publish

1. Sign in to [Vercel](https://vercel.com) with GitHub.
2. Choose **Add New → Project** and import `eyecon-module-1`. Grant access to that repository when requested.
3. Confirm the framework is **Next.js**. The root directory should contain `package.json`; if your repository wraps the project in another folder, select `eyecon-module-1` as the Root Directory. Keep the normal Next.js build settings; do not use a static export.
4. For the first **design preview**, add `NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true`. This publishes a demo, not a real appointment system. Add the confirmed public clinic values if available.
5. Click **Deploy**. When the build finishes, open the generated deployment URL.
6. Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` to that exact HTTPS deployment URL in Project Settings → Environment Variables, then redeploy. This makes shared referral links and QR codes point to the published site.
7. Later, add your domain in Project Settings → Domains and follow the DNS instructions Vercel displays. Update `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` and the authentication/Turnstile allowed domains when you change domains.
8. Push future edits to GitHub to trigger another deployment. Environment-variable changes require a new deployment; public variables are compiled into the frontend.

Leave preview deployments in demo mode. Only turn the **Production** environment to live mode after the configuration below and staging checks. This project has server API routes, so it cannot be deployed as a plain static website.

## Live mode configuration

These are deployment steps, not required for exploring the demo.

### A. Create the Supabase backend

1. Create a new Supabase project. Choose a region and service agreements appropriate for the clinic's privacy/data-residency decisions.
2. Open **SQL Editor**. Paste the complete `supabase/schema.sql` and run it **once on an empty project**. It creates tables, access rules, booking/payout functions and the affiliate-photo bucket. Running it again will produce "already exists" errors; use reviewed migrations for later changes.
   Then run each file in `supabase/migrations/` once, in number order. `004_doctor_availability.sql` makes slots and bookings per optometrist; it assigns any existing slots to `doctor-1`, so staff should review them afterwards. `005_documents.sql` adds “Complete your file”: the residency status, the document records, hashed upload tokens and the **private** `booking-documents` storage bucket. Do not add storage policies to that bucket. `006_booking_lookup.sql` gives every booking a unique reference (existing bookings included) and adds the rate-limited lookup. `008_services.sql` adds the skin tightening service and the optional `service_option` column. `007_commission.sql` adds procedure pricing and calculates commission in the database (`complete_appointment`); after running it, set each affiliate’s real commission rate.
3. In **Authentication**, create the initial staff user with a confirmed email and a strong password. Copy that user's UUID.
4. In SQL Editor run the following, replacing the UUID with the actual user ID:

```sql
insert into public.profiles(id, role)
values ('THE-ACTUAL-AUTH-USER-UUID', 'staff');
```

5. Set Authentication's Site URL to your live URL. Allow the exact login redirect URLs `https://YOUR-DOMAIN/login?set-password=1` and `https://YOUR-DOMAIN/login?mode=reset`. Add the corresponding localhost URLs only for your development environment.
6. Configure Supabase's auth email delivery/SMTP so invitations and password resets reach real users. Public account signup is not required; staff invite affiliates from the dashboard.
7. Copy the project's URL, anon key and service-role key into the matching `.env.local`/Vercel variables. The browser uses the anon key; the server uses the service-role key. **Never expose the service-role key in a NEXT_PUBLIC variable.**

### B. Public booking verification and insurance storage

Create a Cloudflare Turnstile widget for your domain(s); set `NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` and `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`. The server checks the verification result, hostname and `booking` action. If verification is not configured, public live bookings are rejected.

Generate a private insurance encryption key in a local terminal:

```bash
node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"
```

Set its full output as `INSURANCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY` in your private environment. Keep a secure backup. Changing or losing it makes existing policy numbers unreadable. Policy numbers are encrypted using AES-256-GCM; other booking fields remain ordinary database records, protected by database/server access rules. Without the key, bookings with a supplied policy number are rejected; the optional field can be left blank.

### C. Confirmations and reminders

- For email, configure a verified sending domain in Resend and set `RESEND_API_KEY` and `RESEND_FROM`. Confirmation emails attach an `.ics` calendar file.
- For SMS, configure a Twilio sending number and set `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN` and `TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER`. The application sends only when the patient has opted into SMS. Confirm the actual consent wording and provider setup for your clinic.
- Generate `CRON_SECRET` using the same random-key command. Configure an **hourly authenticated HTTPS scheduler** to call `GET https://YOUR-DOMAIN/api/reminders` with header `Authorization: Bearer YOUR-CRON-SECRET`. Keep the secret in the scheduler's protected header/secret field, not a URL or a public repository. The scheduler itself is not provisioned by this project.
- Reminder windows are 22–26 hours before and within 2 hours of the appointment. A unique job per booking/message type prevents normal duplicate dispatch. Provider acceptance is recorded as `sent`; it is not proof of delivery. Failed, unfinished or unconfigured jobs require staff review and are not retried automatically. No-show templates are triggered by changing status to No-show.

### D. Activate and verify

1. Set every confirmed clinic value, the live URL and service keys. Change **only the configured live environment** to `NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=false`, restart locally or redeploy.
2. Sign in with the real staff account. Add appointment slots for each optometrist using **Add available time**. The input explicitly uses the staff browser's local timezone; patient displays use `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLINIC_TIMEZONE`. Confirm both before adding slots.
3. Add an affiliate and complete the email invitation. Verify their photo, link, QR, active/inactive state and restricted workspace.
4. Book a test appointment from that affiliate link. Verify database persistence, referral attribution, email/SMS, calendar timezone, staff status updates and the calculated commission.
5. Try simultaneous bookings with the same optometrist for an overlapping interval and confirm only one succeeds; then book two different optometrists at the same time and confirm both succeed. Test both roles with separate accounts and verify anonymous requests cannot access patient data.
6. Check notification failures, audit records, provider bills, backup/recovery and data retention with the team's deployment owner. Approve real copy, portrait rights, gift terms, privacy wording and clinical scheduling before accepting patients.

Each optometrist has their own calendar of explicit staff-created slots. Durations are assigned to slots, not automatically determined by service. It does not sync MyVisionExpress, offer self-service rescheduling/cancellation, manage multiple locations or implement a rules-based commission engine. The staff API currently loads at most 2,000 bookings and 100 recent delivery jobs; add server pagination for larger use. Document uploads pass through the website’s `/api/documents` route, so each upload is one request of up to 80 MB. **Vercel limits a function’s request body to about 4.5 MB**, so on Vercel larger uploads are refused before they reach the site; host it where the request limit allows 80 MB, or move uploads to signed direct-to-storage URLs before collecting real documents. Uploaded documents are not deleted automatically; set and apply a retention period. Staff have a shared staff role, not per-action permissions or MFA enforcement. Account deletion, data retention, consent withdrawal and retry workflows require the clinic's operational processes or later implementation. For a partial affiliate invitation failure, review the auth user and inactive/missing affiliate/profile in Supabase before retrying; the server does not delete auth accounts automatically.

## Editing the design

| Change | File |
| --- | --- |
| Colours, spacing, mobile breakpoints, typography | `app/globals.css` |
| Public landing page copy/sections | `components/landing.js` |
| Services, brands, sample frames, pre-visit instructions | `lib/config.js` |
| Shop Frames page | `components/shop.js` (rules in `lib/shop.js`) |
| Booking steps and questions | `components/booking-flow.js` |
| Affiliate and staff screens | `components/workspace.js` |
| Reusable header, footer, buttons and fields | `components/ui.js` |
| Database schema and booking/payout rules | `supabase/schema.sql` |
| Demo records | `lib/demo.js` |
| Local concept images | `public/images/` |

Replace images using the same filenames, or update the references. Keep appropriate permissions and descriptive alt text. Clinic contact values belong in the environment, not hardcoded fictional text. Update the draft privacy page in `app/privacy/page.js` with the clinic's approved notice. The current typography uses local system fonts and a serif display stack; there is no external font dependency or animation library.

## 6. Common errors and fixes

| Problem | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| `npm` / `node` is not recognised | Install Node LTS, close/reopen VS Code and run the version commands again. |
| `ENOENT` / missing `package.json` | Open a terminal inside `eyecon-module-1`, the folder that actually contains `package.json`. |
| Unsupported Node version | Install a current supported LTS release and select it in Vercel's Node settings too. |
| Port 3000 is busy | Open the port printed by Next.js, or stop the other local server. You can run `npm run dev -- --port 3001`. |
| Browser changes look stale | Save the file, reload, check terminal errors. Restart after `.env.local` changes. Public environment changes require a rebuild on Vercel. |
| Old demo dates / sample changes | Use Reset demo data at `/login`; demo data persists in browser storage. |
| Supabase "already exists" error | The supplied SQL is an initial schema, not a repeatable migration. Use a fresh project or review migrations before modifying existing data. |
| Live sign-in succeeds but workspace denied | Verify the user's UUID and role in `public.profiles`. Affiliate accounts must have a matching active affiliate row. |
| No live appointment times | Sign in as staff and add future slots. Only available non-overlapping slots within 90 days are returned. |
| "That time is no longer available" | Select another time; check the database/service logs if every valid slot fails. |
| Turnstile verification rejected | Confirm matching key pair, allowed hostname, exact deployment domain and site URL, then redeploy. |
| Insurance storage not configured | Supply the exact 64-character hex key, or leave the optional policy number blank while configuring it. |
| Email/SMS does not arrive | Check the delivery log and provider dashboards, sender verification, credentials, phone format and SMS consent. Demo never sends messages. |
| Git requests your identity | Run `git config --global user.name "Your Name"` and `git config --global user.email "YOUR-GITHUB-EMAIL"`, then repeat the commit. |
| Git says `remote origin already exists` | Inspect `git remote -v`; if wrong, use `git remote set-url origin YOUR-ACTUAL-REPOSITORY-URL`. |
| GitHub authentication/push rejected | Sign in using GitHub Desktop or Git Credential Manager. Verify you own/have write access to the repository. |
| Vercel cannot find the project | Set Root Directory to the folder containing `package.json` and select the Next.js preset. |
| Vercel build fails | Read the first actual error in Build Logs; check Node version, exact filename case, committed files and env variables. Run `npm run build` locally. |
| Secrets accidentally committed | Revoke/rotate them at the provider immediately, remove them from Git history with a reviewed process, and update deployment variables. |

## Validation

Run `npm test` and `npm run build` after changing the project. The production build and eight core tests passed. Browser checks covered the demo booking, calendar download, referral filtering, attendance, commission, manual booking, affiliate creation and mobile layout with no page errors. An automated axe scan of 17 desktop/mobile screens and states reported no findings for the selected WCAG 2 A/AA, 2.1 A/AA and 2.2 AA rule tags after fixes. This automated scan is not a full accessibility audit. Live Supabase, email/SMS delivery, Turnstile, reminders and Vercel deployment must still be verified with your accounts. No live patient data was used.
